tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rnal rgyal lha dgu'i sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /rnal rgyal lha dgu'i sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnal rgyal lha dgu'i sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /

oṃ swā sti/ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa na mo na maḥ ye shes lha mo ngo mtshar cha shas ni// rnam pa du mas yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku/ /nang gi mun sel bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar can/ /gang khyod 'dir ni rnam par rgyal gyur cig /de la gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rig sngags 'di/ gang gā'i klung khrag khrig chen po brgyad cu rtsa brgyad snyed kyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs shing*/ byin gyis brlabs pas/ ngan 'gro dang las kyi sgrib pa mtha' dag yongs su sbyong ba/ bde 'gro dang bde ba'i lam ston pa/ 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par byed pa yin par gsungs pas/ blo ldan sngags kyi sgor spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis/ mchog tu nan tan du bya ba'i 'os so/ /de la 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa gzhan du 'bri bar 'gyur la/ lha dgu'i rnal 'byor la brten nas khrus chog dang stong mchod sogs/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len du mdzad pa gang yin pa de bri bar bya'o/ /'di la cho ga'i sngon du 'gro ba'i bya ba ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa spyi dang mthun par bshams/ bum pa'i steng du gzungs 'di'i snying po can gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhugs su gsol/ mañji sogs stegs mtho ba la/ dung chos sam/ zangs chos su mchod yon chu gtsang la 'o ma dang me tog dkar po btab pa bzhag /mchod pa gzhan rnams gshom tshul ni/ phyis kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig gi phyag len ltar/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang mchod yon nas/ zhal zas kyi bar bdun po/ shar nas byang gi bar du g.yas bskor du byed pa'i lugs bzhin bshams kyang chog/ mdun du mchod yon zhabs bsil/ g.yas su me tog bdug spos mar me gsum/ g.yon du zhal zas dri chab/ yang mar me de gsum/ rgyab tu mtshams 'dzin gshom pa'am/ yang na g.yas su nyer spyod lnga dang*/ g.yon du chu gnyis sogs bshams pas chog pas/

gcig tu nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma dang*/ cha gsum rnams spyir phyogs la nges pa med kyang*/ 'das gtor dkyil 'khor gyi mdun gyi phyogs dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhi/ cha gsum ji ltar bde bar sgrig /yang de ltar mi bde na/ shar du 'jig rten 'das gtor gyi sne mthud nas rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma sgrigs/ cha gsum ci bde ba'i phyogs su bzhag pas chog gi /lho nyid du dgos zer ba la ni lung rigs med do/ /spyir btang la bum pa dang rten gyi zhal yang 'jig rten shar la blta/ ci ste stong mchod byed na/ lha bshos stong dang*/ mar me stong dang*/ bdug spos stong rnams nges par dgos shing*/ gzhan yang gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa 'grub na stong du tshang ba dgos shing*/ ma 'grub na ji ltar rigs pa bya ba las/ ras sam dar gyi tshal ba phra mos kyang rung mod/ dug can gyi shog bu la 'bri ba dang*/ ras bris rnying pa dri ma can gyis ni go mi chod do/ /de 'dra byed pa de ni/ gang la bya ba'i bsgrub bya la phan mi thogs pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la brnyas par 'gyur ba dang*/ lag len ngan pas lag len bzang po sun 'byin pa'i spyod par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ring du dor bar bya'o/ /mchod pa de rnams ni bum pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la bskor kyang rung*/ stegs bu gzhan la bkod nas/ phyogs bzhi nas bskor kyang rung ngo*/ /gtor ma stong phrag kyang de ltar bkod na rung mod gyi/ gtor snod gzhan du sgrig pa'i lag len gtso che la/ gzhan yang rol mo sogs dgos pa'i yo byad tshang bar byas te/ de rnams lag len mthong ba las kyang shes par bya'o/ /de nas thams cad khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sogs nam mkha' gang ba la dmigs nas/ phyag 'tshal rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba re bya ste/

de yang las dang po pa'i rim pa chos spyod khrigs chags su bshad zin to/ /de nas bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya ste/ me tog dam pa zhes sogs mchod pa'i tshigs gcad gsum la rol chen byed/ de nas bsnyen gnas rang gi blang ba'i cho ga byed pa zhig snang ba la/ cho ga byed pa po thams cad dge tshul yan chad kyi sdom pa thob la ma nyams pa yin na/ bsnyen gnas blang dgos pa ma yin zhing*/ dge tshul dge slong gi sdom pa ma thob pa sha stag yin na/ nges par blang bar bya la/ rab byung gi sdom pa thob ma thob 'dres ma yin na/ len pa dang mi len pa'i dbye ba so sor byed dgos pa yin kyang*/ dus kyi tha ma 'di lta bur/ lag len ltar snang gi cho ga gra sgrig dgos pa 'di 'dra'i rigs la/ rab byung gi sdom pa ma thob pa rnams kyis bsnyen gnas len pa'i zhor la/ dge tshul dang dge slong rnams kyang ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rang rang gi sdom pa brtan por dam 'cha' ba'i bsam pas/ cho ga de kha ton du byed pa tsam la 'gal ba med do/ /de la cho ga ni 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing*/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid pa kun du sbyar ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de rnams kyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang*/ phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/

gso sbyaung nges par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ gso sbyong nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing*/ /gzhan gyi nor ni blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing*/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon ni mang po nyer bsten pa'i/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ /khri gdan che mtho mi bya zhing*/ /de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang 'phreng ba dang ni rgyan/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni// srog gcod la sogs mi byed pa/ /de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spang*//bla med byang chub thob par shog /sdug bsngal mang dkrugs 'jig rten 'di/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog / ces lan gsum brjod/ oṃ a mo gha shī la sam+bha ra/ sam+bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ mahā shud+dha/ satwa pad+ma bi bhu ṣi ta/ bhu dza dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs/ bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing*/ / zhes sogs kyi smon lam gdab/ de dag ni cho ga'i sngon du grub na legs pa'i yan lag yin gyi/ ma byas kyang cho ga chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas mchod pa byin brlab ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dhār+m+ma swa bhā wa shu d+dha ོ྅haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyi mi khyab pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas te/

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pād+yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū paṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dī paṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dha ེ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nai be d+yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta sogs dang*/ rol mo ji snyed pa 'bud dkrol byas te byin dbab/ 'di ma gtogs pa'i mchod pa byin rlabs 'og ma rnams la dharma ra ṇi dang rol chen mi dgos so/ /dngos gzhi la/ bdag bskyed sgom bzlas/ mdun bskyed sgrub mchod/ gtor ma dbul ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= zhes gsum nas nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar ci rigs kyi mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dpal ldan lha mo ston ga'i zla ba'i mdog / zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/

de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai be d+ya/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ phyag rgya yang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas thal mo sbyar te rgyun bshags bya ba ni/ 'jig rten dag gi phyogs kun na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang bzhugs dang*/ /dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dag/de dag bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /tshe rabs gang yang rung ba na/ /bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan dag dang*/ /tshe rabs 'di dang 'khor ba na/ /'dod chags dbang dang blun pa dang*/ khro ba dag gis 'khrugs gyur te/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun nam/ /bla ma dag dang pha ma dang*/ / dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /sbyin gnas gang yang rung ba dang*/ /de las gzhan pa'i sems can dag /yon tan ldan dang mi ldan la/ /sdig pa'i las rnams gang bgyis dang*/ /gang yang bgyid du rtsal ba dang*/ /gang yang cung zad yi rang ba/ /bag med pas ni phra mo yang*/ /lus ngag yid kyis bgyis pa rnams/ /de dag ma lus blos bsdus nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras bcas la/ /bdag gis da ni mngon sum bzhin/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal te/ / skyo ba'i yid du gyur pa yis/ /thal mo sbyar te nongs pa rnams/ /yang dang yang du so sor bshags/ /bdag gi mi dge bgyis pa rnams/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen pa bzhin/ /de ltar bdag gis so sor bshags/ /slan chad de ltar yongs mi bgyid/ /mi rtog blo gros bskyed pa'i phyir//chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba dang*/ /gdul bya ji srid tshim bar du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// srog chags sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag gi ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /gus pas yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /sems can khams ni mtha' yas pa'i/ /sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba dang*/ /ngan 'gro rnams las bsgral ba dang*/ /nyon mongs rnams las dgrol ba'i phyir/ /srid pa mi bde dogs pa na/ sdug bsngal sna tshogs ci mchis pa/

/de ltar yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /sems can 'phongs pa thams cad kyi/ /skyabs su bdag nyid rtag tu shog /bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon/ /rten med rnams kyi rten du bdag /skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs 'gyur zhing*/ /sdug bsngal bde bar byed pa dang*/ /bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs zhi bar byed par shog /dge ba'i las rnams gang dang gang*/ / 'di dang gzhan du bsags pa rnams/ /bsod nams ye shes zhes bya yi/ / tshogs ni rnam pa gnyis su shog /pha rol phyin pa drug sgo nas/ /bdag gis brtson 'grus gang brtsams pa/ /de yang sems can ma lus pa/ /thams cad la ni phan par shog /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis/ /smon lam ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang dge ba'i sems kyis su/ /de bzhin du ni smos lam 'debs/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang*/ /thams cad nad kyang med par shog /bdag ni bya ba kun nus shing*/ /yon tan dang yang ldan par shog /nor ldan gtong phod shes rab can/ /bzod ldan dge la dad pa dang*/ /sems can tshe rabs thams cad du/ /skye ba dran zhing brtse ldan shog ces lan gsum/ shin tu bsdus pa la dga' na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags byed/ de nas tshad med bzhi sgom ste/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs spyi dang 'dra/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i mchod rten du gyur pa ni/ rin po che'i rang bzhin seng khri'i steng du pad+ma/ de'i steng du khri zlum po bang rim gsum brtsegs/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i bum pa zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba sgo dang bcas pa/ steng du rin po che'i khri/ gdugs bcu gsum/

char khebs tog dang bcas pa/ me tog gi 'phreng ba/ dar gyi lda ldi sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i bum pa'i nang du/ /pad+ma dang zla ba'i gnad la/ bhūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma/ sku mdog dkar mo/ zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ser ba/ g.yon sngo zhing yid tsam khro ba/ zhal re re zhing zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas pad+ma'i steng du 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa bsnams pa/ gsum pas mda'/ bzhi pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon dang po zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas gzhu/ gsum pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ bzhi pas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ phyogs g.yas rnga yab dang*/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i sdong po 'dzin pa/ g.yon du phyag na rdo rje sngon po/ phyag g.yas rnga yab dang*/ g.yon ut+pal la gnas pa'i rdo rje sngon po 'dzin pa/ de gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs shing*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho la bab pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa'i skur gyur/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi phyogs bzhir khro bo bzhi gnas pa ni/ shar du mi g.yo ba g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba/ lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar ba/ nub tu dbyug sngon can g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar ba/ byang du stobs po che g.yas rdo rje rtse gsum 'phyar ba/ thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing kha rab tu khros pa/ phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod cing*/
spyan gsum/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra nag po thor tshugs su byas pa/ stag lpags dang*/ sbrul gyi brgyan can/ rol ba'i khro bo chen po ste/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/

/gtso mo'i steng gi nam mkha' la gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ gtso mo la sku khrus gsol ba/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying khar hūṃ sngon po/ dpral bar traṃ ser po/ lte bar hrīḥdamar po/ brla gnyis la aṃ aḥljang khu/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ sarba thā ta ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin du sbyar/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gis lha de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las/ gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med/ phyag na rdo rje dang khro bo bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri swā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ nas/ badz+ra shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā 'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog zhes sogs kyis bstod/ snying khar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la/ bh+rūṃ yig bsrung bya sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hrīḥ.aṃ a/ bdag dang bsgrub bya la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swāhā/

zhes cung zad bzlas/ lag pa gnyis thal mo mnyam par sbyar ba'i mdzub mo'i tshigs bar pa bcag /mtheb mdzub rtse sprad de/ gzungs ring tshar gcig brjod la dam la bzhag /de rjes gzungs ring nyid gtso bor bzla zhing*/ sngags thung gnyis kyang ci rigs su bzla'o/ /oṃ a mṛ te/ a mṛ tota bha be/ a mṛ ta bi krān te/ a mṛ ta ga tre/ a mṛ ta gā mi ni/ a mṛ ta ā yur dad te/ ga ga na/ kir ti ka re/ sarba karma kle sha k+ṣa yaṃ ka rī ye swāhā/ zhes pa'ang tshe spel ba'i don du ci nus bzla'o/ /mthar/ snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas yongs su drangs te/ bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor rang gi snying khar thim/ zhes brjod/ ye shes pa gshegs 'dod cing bdag bskyed kho na yin na/ 'og nas 'chad pa'i rjes bsdu ba de bya zhing*/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel na/ rjes chog gi mthar byas pas rung ba yin la/ spyir bya rgyud kyi lha sngags la/ rgyud sde gong ma'i thun mong gi cho ga sbyar ba 'di rigs la/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs pa mtha' gcig tu yang mi dgos la/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar de ltar byed pa yang mi 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdun bskyed la dmigs te/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba*/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul ba bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du/ bh+rūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i zhes pa nas/ bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma zhes pa'i rang nyid ces pa dor/ sa mā dzaḥ 'i rjes la/

ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ / zhes pa nas/ yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ zhes spro na dbyangs dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ yang mchod pa nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan gyi bar yang gong dang 'dra ba las/ bdag la mngon par zhes ba/ 'di la mngon par zhes par spo/ de nas mchod pa gsar pa'ang bshams shing*/ snga ma rnams kyang kha gsos la/ gong bzhin by-in rlabs bya/ chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin du/ /ar+gha'i rgyun yang mi 'chad de/ /bla med mchod pa 'di 'bul na/ /thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tshi swā hā/ dri zhim reg na bde ba yi// zhabs bsil rgyun yang sogs/ pād+yaṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam nyid kyis//de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba/ /de ltar bdag gis lha rnams la/ /gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba de ba ta artsi ta a mṛ ta swāhā/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*/ /gang la rig na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ sarba sogs/ badz+ra pas+t+ra ye= 'phreng ba rin chen se mo do shal dang*/ /rgyan gyi dam pa ma lus phul pa yis/ /byang chub mchog gi rgyan dang ldan gyur nas/ /bla med thar pa mchog la gnas par shog/theg mchog bla re mgon skyabs gdugs dang ldan/ /bdud bcom rgyal mtshan ba dan ting 'dzin 'phan/ /bdag dang 'gro ba'i don du 'bul lags kyi/ /dbang mchog dam pa dus 'dir stsal du gsol/ /u bas+tha na = sna tshogs rol mo snyan pa'i sgra dag dang*/ /lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i glu dbyangs kyis/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes par rab brgyan pa/ /theg pa mchog gi nges pas bgrod par shogaspa ra na da = gtsang zhing gtsang ma las byung ba'i/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i dri 'di dag/bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/

/bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /gan+dhe = ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bid+yā dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar skyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i me tog 'di/ /bdag ni sogs/ puṣ+pe = ā ha ra = dri yi rgyas pa lha yis rdzas/ /nags tshal bcud ni yid 'ong 'di/ /bdag la = dhū ba = ā ha ra/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yid gar 'ong*/ /sngags kyi zhal zas mchog 'di dag /bdag = nai be d+ya = ā ha ra/ gnod pa 'joms shing bkra shis pa/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel 'di/ bdag = ā lo ke = ā lo kā ā lo kā bid+yā dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/ zhes pa ni mchod pa dkyus so/ /stong mchod kyi skabs ni/ zhal zas sogs stong phrag du spel ba la/ mchod pa sgos su bsngau bar 'dod na/ stong tshan lnga po la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ zhal zas/ mar me/ spos rnams la sngags spyi 'gro dang*/ gdugs la tsha traṃ ka /ba dan la pa taṃ ka zhes sbyar ba lan mang du bzlas pas mchod/ snga ma'am/ stong mchod gang yin yang rung*/ mthar/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*/ /mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la/ /rin chen me tog la sogs char/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas/ /rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod/ /bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag las/ /nges par kun du 'byung gyur cig / tshigs bcad bzhi po de dag re re'i mthar rol chen dang*/ rol mo byin 'bebs kyi sngags dang*/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs gang rung re brjod/

de nas bstod pa ni/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa 'di bya ste/ gtso mo bcom ldan 'das ma ni/ /puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i me tog ltar/ /skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /zhal gsum phyag brgyad spyan gsum mnga'/ /dbu rgyan mgul rgyan snyan cha'i tshogs/ /rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pas brgyan/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dbus dkar g.yas ser g.yon zhal sngo/ khro mo'i zhal ni mche ba gtsigs/ /phyag g.yas sna tshogs rje rje dang*/ /pad steng rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ /mda' dang mchog sbyin phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang*/ /gzhu dang mi 'jigs phyag rgya can/ /rin chen bum pa legs par bsnams/ /bai ro tsa nas dbu rgyan zhing*/ /'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du// stod g.yogs lha yi na bza' can/ /mchod rten nang na legs par bzhugs// blo dang tshe 'phel mdzad pa mo/ /bcom ldan 'das ma nyid la bstod/ /g.yas na rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /sku mdog dkar po skyon ma gos/ /g.yon pas pad+ma g.yas pa na/ /rnga yab 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon na gsang ba'i bdag po ni/ /ut+pal mdog 'dra rdo rje g.yon/ /g.yas pas rin chen rnga yab 'dzin/ /mthu stobs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi/ khro bo'i rgyal po bzhi po ni/ /mdun na khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon/ /sngo sangs g.yas pa ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad pa yis/ /ma rungs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni/ /sngo sangs lcags kyu 'bar ba bsnams/ /ma rung 'dul ba'i cha lugs can/ /thams cad 'gugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ khro chen dbyug pa sngon po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa na// dbyug tho g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /sngo sangs kun 'dul khyod la bstod/ khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che/ /ut+pal mdog 'dra phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa rjo rje sdigs mdzub g.yon/ /bdud 'dul drag po khyod la bstod/ /kun kyang sbrul dang stag lpags rgyan/

/zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo/ /g.yon brkyang pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs/ /steng gi phyogs su bzhugs pa yi/ /gnas gtsang lha yi bu gnyis po/ /lha yi rgyan dang na bza' 'dzin/ /phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams/ /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun kun la snyoms/ /dag pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig nang par sngar langs nas/ /bstod pa 'di yis dus kun tu/ /'khor dang bcas la bstod byas na/ /blo dang tshe rnams 'phel par 'gyur/ /dpal dang 'byor ba'i dngos grub ster/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ gus pa'i yid kyis bsam bya zhing*/ /rtse gcig sems kyis bstod pa bya/ / bdag bskyed kyi dmigs pa mdun bskyed la go brje zhing*/ sngar gyi phyag rgya des me tog bzung ste gzungs ring tshar gcig bton nas/ swāhā zhes brjod pa'i me tog mdun bskyed la dor ro/ /de nas bzlas pa byed pa yin la/ de la gzungs ring ngam/ rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sar+b+ba trai lo kya pra ti bi shiṣ+tā ya/ bud+dha ya te na maḥ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ a sa ma sa man+ta a ba bhā sa spa ra ṇa ga ti ga ga na swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe/ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga tāḥ su ga ta ba ra ba tsa na/ a mṛ ta a bhi ṣe kai ra/ mahā mu drā man+t+ra pa deḥ ā ha ra ā ha ra/ ma ma ā yus+san+dā ra ṇi/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ ga ga na swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe/ uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya pa ri shud+dhe sa ha sra rasmi sañco di te/ sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki ni/ ṣaṭ+pa ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ṇi/ sarba ta thā ga ta mā te/ da sha bhū mi pra tiṣ+ṭhi te/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ mu dre mu dre/ mahā mu dre/ badz+ra kā ya saṃ ha ta na pa ri shud+dhe sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi shud+dhe/ pra ti ni brta ya/ ma ma ā yurbi shud+dhe/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya a dhiṣ+ṭhā na adhiṣ+ṭhī te/

oṃ mu ni mu ni/ mahā mu ni bi mu ni bi mu ni/ mahā bi mu ni/ ma ti ma ti/ mahā ma ti/ ma ma ti/ su ma ti/ ta thā tā/ bhū ta ko ṭi pa ri shud+dhe/ bis+phu ṭa/ bud+dhe shud+dhe/ he he dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ sma ra sma ra/ s+pha ra s+pha ra/ s+pha ra ya s+pha ra ya/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bud+dhe bud+dhe/ badz+re badz+re mahā badz+re/ su badz+re/ badz+ra gar+bhe/ dza ya gar+bhe/ bi dza ya gar+bhe/ badz+ra dz+wa lā' gar+bha ེ / badz+rod+bha be/ badz+ra sam+bha be/ badz+re badz+ri ṇi/ badz+re m+bha wan+tū/ ma ma shā rī raṃ/ sarba satwa nāñca kā ya/ pa ri shud+dhir+bha wan+tu me sa dā/ sarba ga ti pa ri shud+dhish+tsa/ sarba ta thā ga tā sh+tsa māṃ/ sarba sa twaṃṣ+tsa/ sa mā shwā sa yan+tu/ bud+dh+ya bud+dh+ya/ sid+dh+ya sid+dh+ya/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ bi bo dha ya bi bo bha ya/ mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ bi mo tsa ya bi mo tsa ya/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ sa man+tā mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ sa man+ta rasmi/ pa ri shud+dhe/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ a dhaṣ+ṭha na a dhaṣ+ṭhi te/ mu dre mu dre/ mahā mu dre mahā mu drā man+d+ra pa daiḥswāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /de ltar na/ de nyid bzlas pa'i gtso bor bya zhing*/ gong du bshad pa ltar tshe sgrub kyi gzungs dang*/ oṃ bh+ruṃ swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ a mṛ ta ā yur dad+te swāhā/ / zhes pa'ang ci nus su bzla'o/ /de yang*/ thugs dam bskul ba'i gzungs tshar gcig brjod rjes su/ bzlas pa byed pa tsam dkyus ma'i lugs yin la/ stong mchod kyi skabs yin na/ slar yang tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ / dpal ldan lha mo sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas bzlas pa dngos la/ oṃ na mo zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ thob thang la phyag dngos su 'tshal ba yin na'ang*/ lag len la thal mo sbyar nas mgo 'dud par re byed/

gzungs bzla mkhan bcu yod pa'i dbang du byas na/ gzungs ring tshar bcu song ba'i rjes su mchod bstod bsdus pa re bya/ de ltar lan bcus gzungs stong phrag gcig 'gro ba yin pa las/ gzungs bcu tshan lnga tsam song ba/ gzungs re re la bskor ba gnyis gnyis 'gro bar byas pas/ bskor ba yang stong 'gro/ 'di'i rigs sgres te/ gzungs bzlas mkhan mang nyung gi rtsis gdab ma 'khrugs par bya dgos te/ dper na bzlas pa byed mkhan nyi shu yod na lnga tshan bcu dang*/ bzlas pa byed mkhan lnga las med na nyi shu tshan bcu byed dgos pa bzhin no/ /gtor ma stong phrag bsngau ba ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ de nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron thams cad la dmigs nas/ / a kā ro 'i sngags kho na stong phrag gcig gis bsngo ba las/ sngags brgya brgya song ba'i mtshams su/

mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'dis/ /'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig/dam can thugs dam skong gyur cig /rigs drug gtor mas tshim gyur nas/ /lan chags bu lon khyer ba dang*/ /bla med byang chub myur thob shog /de rjes 'bud dkrol gyi sgra dang bcas/ 'dod don gang yin pa de gsol ba drag tu gdab bo/ /gsum pa ni/ gtor ma dang po/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ gis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañca ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa kyis sbyangs/ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ/ sarba dharma ṇaṃ/ ad+ya nut+pan+na twa ta kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /gzungs ring tshar gcig gi mthar/ uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byas la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma'ang gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ dhṛ ta ra ṣ+tā ya oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum/ oṃ bi ru ḍha kā ya dang*/ oṃ bi ru pāk+ṣā ya dang*/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇā ya zhes pa rnams la'ang*/ a kā ro sbyar ba lan gsum gyis phul/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ /mar gad mdog can pi waṃ 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba//yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod thams cad shar phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ /grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i// 'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig/ mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ kha dog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub phyogs su= ded dpon chen po gser mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin// gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ / byang phyogs su=

mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don zhu/ de nas bar 'dir gtor ma cha gsum btang*/ /rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ mchod yon phal cher sogs kyis tshigs bcad dang spel ba'am/ ma spel kyang rung ste/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi/ 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang zhing dag nas/ 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod don gsol btab/ bdag bskyed kyi lha gshegs su gsol bar 'dod na/ rjes chog gi sngon du bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod la/ mchod bstod man chad lhan gcig tu byas na zor yang zhing so sor byed na mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams gshegs su gsol ba'i rjes la byed pa yin kyang*/ rgyud sde gong ma'i sgrub pa pos ni/ gshegs su mi gsol ba nyid bzang bar mthong ngo*/ /de nas yig brgya mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can sogs kyis mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ /mchod rten dang ras bris la dmigs nas brtan bzhugs bya/ dge ba bsngo ba dang shis brjod rol mo dang bcas pa bya/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu zhing bum chus sems can la phan gdags par bya ba las bsgrub bya dmigs gsal can la/ /khrus kyis rjes su bzung dgos na/ dang por zhi ba dang*/ zhi drag phyed ma dang*/ drag po'i sgo nas bgegs sbyangs/ de rjes til lam nyungs kar gyis sdig sgrib sbyang ba yang byas na legs/ de nas snying kha'i 'od zer gyis/

dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis spyan drangs/ mchod bstod bsdus pa dang*/ bsgrub bya'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa tsam byas nas/ nam mkha'i lha rnams kyis cho ga mdzad par mos nas/ dngos su bkru byab bsrung gsum/ bkra shis dang bcas pa bya/ nam mkha'i lha mchod nas rang bzhin gyi gnas su bzhugs par sgom/ bkru byab bsrung gsum gyi bya ba 'di gzhan dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ 'dir zhib par ma smos so/ /byin rlabs mchog gi gzi byin zla bral bas/ /sdig 'phrog mi 'gyur tshe yi dpal ster ba//gang gi cho ga'i lag len gsal por bshad/ /dge 'dis tshe dpag med pa'i gnas thob shog/// ces pa'ang shin tu nyer mkhor mthong nas/ 7 rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// bkra shis// ༄༅/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ na mo gu ru bud+dhā bo dhi satwe bh+yaḥ srid gsum las rgyal sgrub pa'i dga' ston can/ /rab 'bar 'od zer stong gi gzi brjid kyis/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms gang der phyag gi gnas/ /sngags kyi 'phrin las cung zad tsam zhig spel/ /'dir rdo rje rnam 'joms ljang khu dpa' bo gcig pa'i bum chog nyer mkho ni/ stegs bu'am gzhi gtsang ma la/ rdul tshon nam ras bris pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar/ bum pa mgul bcings kha rgyan dang bcas pa/ steng du dung chos mchod yon dang bcas pa dang*/ gzungs thag rdo rje yang bshams/ mtha' bskor du mchod pa dang*/ 'jig rten 'das gtor gcig /cha gsum dang bcas pa rnams kyang lag len bzhin bshams/ khrus sngon du 'gro bas/ gtsang sbra'i spyod pa la gnas bzhin du/ spro na rnam rgyal lha dgu'i bum chog tu bshad pa ltar/ phyag 'tshal dang yan lag bdun pa bya/ khyim pa zhig yin na bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa yang bzung ngo*/ /mdor bsdus pa'i tshe de dag mi dgos la/ mchod pa byin brlab ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pād+yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū paṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dī paṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi t+ya swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya bya/ mthar rol mo ji snyed pa 'bud dkrol byas ste byin dbab/ de dag ni sngon 'gro yin no/ / bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes gsum nas nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar ci rigs kyi mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bya'o/ / lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying khar pad nyi la hūṃ ljang sngon/ de las 'od 'phros/ lus gang sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sna bug nas phyir spros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

grub pa rigs sngags kun gyi gtso/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms dkyil 'khor ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems tshogs dang*/ /bla mar bcas pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig / sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba dra ba/ gur bla re/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang sngon/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhal khro ma 'dzum gyi rnam pa can/ mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tsugs can/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gzi brjid mtha' yas pa mnga' zhing*/ ma lus pa'i sprul pa 'chang ba'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra spo ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha a/ slar yang snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/

dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pā ri wā ra zhes pa sbyar te/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ slar yang*/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi/ /rdo rje rin chen kun nas 'bar ba'i mthus/ /bdud bzhi'i stobs rnams rnam par 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / rang gi thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba'i nang du/ hūṃ gi tha mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs nas/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa = nas/ rab tu smras sa ོ'i bar tshar gcig /dngos gzhi sngags gsum po ci nus su bzla ba las/ gsum kar sbrags te tshar gcig nges par 'don la/ de nas rang gi mos pa dang sbyar te/ gsum kar sbrags pa kho na bzla ba'am/ gsum po gang rung gcig bzla bar bya'o/ /de la na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ dang po nas/ dz+wa la swāhā 'i bar rtsa sngags/ na mo rat+na dra yā ya/ 'og ma nas/ bhin+dha bhin+dha badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar snying po'o/ / na ma ṣ+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dha ya hu lu hu lu man chad nye snying ngo*/ /rtsa sngags kyi a mu kaṃ ma ra ya = zhes pa ni/ gnod byed 'byung po ma ra ya = zhes 'don pa spo/ bzlas pa'i mthar/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas/ zhes pa man chad phan yon tshar gcig 'don/ bdag bskyed kho na byed na/ skabs 'dir lha 'od gsal du bsdu ba'am/ mchod cing bstod nas gshegs su gsol ba gang rung byed pa yin na'ang*/ mdun bskyed dang sbrail nas byed pa la/ skabs 'dir de gnyis ka mi bya'o/ /de dag ni bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'o/ /de nas bum pa a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/

a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul ba bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la hūṃ las/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ ma lus sems can kun gyi sogs sho lo ka gsum gyis spyan drangs/ yang ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod pa sogs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan gyi bar yang bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil la sogs shap+ta 'i bar du sbyor/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mthu stobs gcig tu gyur pa ni/ /rdo rje khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yis/ /mi phyed bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /kun nas 'bar ba'i me dpung gi/ bskor ba'i gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par rgyas pa pad+ma yi/ /snying po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /'gyings pa'i tshul gyis legs bzhugs pa/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms la 'dud/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sku mdog mar gad ltar gsal ba/ /rgyun rnams kun gyis rnam par spras/ /sprul pa'i 'od zer 'phro la 'dud/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ /zhi dang khro dang 'dzum pa dang*/ /dpal dang brtse ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /dbang phyug dam pa khyod la 'dud/ /sna tshogs rdo rje phyag g.yas kyis/

/nyid kyi thugs kar 'gyings nas bsnams/ /g.yon pa dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ /rnam rol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung gi rigs sngags nga ro'i dbyangs/ /'brug sgra stong bzhin rab bsgrags pas/ /bdud dpung ma lus rnam gnon zhing*/ /'dod dgu sbyin par mdzad la 'dud/ khyod thugs zab pas nyer zhi yang*/ /rgya che rol bas kun khyab mdzad/ /mi g.yo kun khyab rtag brtan pa/ /ye shes dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ /yon tan 'phrin las rin chen gyi/ /mi mdzad gter gyur mgon khyod la/ /rtag tu gus pas gsol 'debs kyi/ /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ zhes bstod/ bum bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sna tshogs rdo rje sbub stong du yod pa'i nang du/ bsgrub bya gang yin de gsal btab la/ thugs kha'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las spros pa'i 'od zer bsgrub bya'i lus la phog pas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib mtha' dag zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsam/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/

gzungs mdo 'don zhing*/ sngags bzla tshul ni bdag bskyed dang 'dra bas/ rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye snying rnams rim pas phyi ma mang bar bzla'o/ /mthar ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gang thugs sogs kyis bstod/ gzungs thag bsdu/ gtor ma dang po rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ gis bgegs sbyangs/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang*/ hūṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañca ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa kyis ma dag pa bsregs shing*/ gzi brjid rgyas par byas/ rdo rje bsdams pa 'debs tshul bya zhing*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ a d+ya nut+pan+na twad/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho byin gyis brlabs/ nye snying gi mthar/ a kā ro sbyar ba lan bdun gyis phul/ yang gong bzhin mchod bstod bsdus pa byas la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la = zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis gsol ba 'debs te/ mdun bskyed 'khor dang bcas pa'i cho ga'o/ / de nas cha gsum gyi cho gas 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma btang*/ mchod pa kha gso/ byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs par 'dod na/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod pa byed dgos pa las/ spro na/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ zhes sogs kyang brjod/ bstod pa bsdus pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod du gsol/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ sdig sgrib dang nad gdon dang 'khon grib dang*/ mi gtsang ba thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/

myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid bstsal ba/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ / lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pas dung chos kyi chu bum par blug / bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes gtor mgron rnams gshegs shing*/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa yang gshegs par 'dod na/ de rnams dang lhan cig tu'o/ /smon lam dang bkra shis rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'tshams pa bya ste/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma man chad de rnams rjes kyi bya ba'o/ / 'dir yang rgyas pa la mos na/ legs grub las 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor bsngo yang bya ste/ rnam rgyal lha dgu'i bum chog tu bkod zin to/ /'di dag tu rten sku gzhan yod na/ bum pa'i £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+£© lha 'od du £© zhu zin pa'i skabs der/ rten la brtan bzhugs bya ste/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du ¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ rtag tu £© rgyal ba rnams myang ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi 'am/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs 'di rnams thams cad/ ji srid 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can = zhes sogs bya'o/ /de nas bsgrub bya 'ga' zhig la/ bkru byab bsrung gsum bya dgos na/ mtheb rgyu ting lo dang changs bu gsum gsum la/ lag len bzhin chab btang*/ badz+ra yak+ṣa sogs sngags tshan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ las kyi rdo rjes gtor ma bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān bh+yaḥn maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba ling ta ye swāhā/ se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pa lan gsum gyi zhi ba'i sbyang ba dang*/ ting lo dang*/ 'chang bu sbyar la bskor zhing rdo rje gsor bzhin pas/ / oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha wān bid+ya rā dza hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyi mthar/ tshe dang ldan pa'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam/ rdo rje slob ma'am/ sbyin pa'i bdag po'am/ bsgrub bya 'di zhes bgyi ba la bar du gcod par brtson pa'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad gtor ma 'di lam brngan/ ting lo 'di lam sgron/ 'chang bu 'di lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig / ces brjod de zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba dang*/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ ces pa nas/ 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ / zhes pa'i bar brjod/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya/ s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ nai we t+ya 'i bar phul/ spros pa la dga' na/

chos nyid stong pa sogs kyi yang bstod/ bsdu na/ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol pa'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas te/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi= gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi= bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs gyis/ bsgrub bya 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin rdo rje khro bo'i bka' thos pas sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ / zhes lha'i nga rgyal shugs drag pos rdo rje gsor zhing yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul sogs kyis bdug cing*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring thung rnams drag tu bzla la/ spros pa la dga' na rol mo'i sgra byed cing*/ rnam 'joms kyi snying po dang*/ nye snying bzla ba'i srol snang ba yang 'gal ba med par sems/ rgyas pa la dga' bas khro bo la mchod bstod bden brdar bgegs bskrad rnams lan gsum byed pa'i srol yang snang ngo*/ /de nas til lam yungs kar gyi sbyang ba ni/ bsgrub bya rang nyid kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad/ snying gar yi ge kaṃ yig nag po'i rnam par gnas pa/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur nas/ mdun gyi til lam yungs kar la thims/ de nyid g.yas su ye shes kyi mes bsregs/

g.yon du chos nyid kyi rgya mtshor dor bar 'gyur/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmi ku ru ye swāhā/ lan gsum bzlas/ til lam yungs kar bskor zhing me dang chur dor/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sā ma dzaḥ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa nas/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar tshar cig brjod la/ sarba pā paṃ bh+yaḥ shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ sarba bigh+nān bh+ya= sarba duṣ+tan= sarba gra he= sarba dz+wa re= sarba byā ti= sarba u pa drā be= sarba a ka la mrit+ya= sarba du+u ra so ba ni= sarba du+u ra mi te= sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+yaḥshan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing khrus byar gzhug /nad pa'i rigs 'ga' zhig sogs dngos su khrus bya mi 'dod na/ me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la bkru'o/ /byabs pa ni/ rma bya'i sgro mdongs kyi dbus su zla ba la sngags kyi 'phreng ba 'khod/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgrub bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad rdo khab len gyi lcags phye len pa ltar blangs te phyir dor bar mos la/ gzungs yongs rdzogs sam nye snying gi mthar/ sarba pā paṃ bh+yaḥ sogs la/ shan+tiṃ ku ru'i tshab tu/ a pa na ya swāhā/ zhes pa btags la byab/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs de rnams slar mi ldog par bya ba'i ched du bsrung ba bya ba ni/ bsgrub bya'i spyi bo dang*/ mdun rgyab dang*/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon dang*/ dpyi g.yas g.yon te/ gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram re re/ de las de 'dra ba'i rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros nas/ lus la rdo rje'i go bskon par gyur/ gzungs yongs rdzogs sam nye snying gi mthar/ sarba pā paṃ bh+yaḥ sogs la/ rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥ zhes btags la bsgrub bya'i gnas bdun dang*/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag /mthar/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/

/rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i nus mthu yis/ / 'gro ba 'di ni bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis/ /'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig / de nas/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas te/ / zhes man chad tshar cig ston la/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rnams la dmigs nas mchod bstod cig byas te/ oṃ khyod kyi sems can sogs/ gshegs su gsol/ bsgrub bya la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod do/ /yang bsgrub bya dbang bskur thob pa sogs 'ga' zhig la/ las kyi rjes ma bsdus par/ bum pa'i lha zhu zin ma thag tu/ bsgrub bya'i bya ba rnams byas la/ mgron dang khrus kyi lha lhan cig tu gshegs/ de nas las rjes bsdus te/ smon lam dang bkra shis rgyas pa brjod pa'i lugs kyang yod do/ /kun la grags shing yig ge mang yod kyang*/ /gzhan gyi bskul phyir mdo tsam bris pa yin/ /gang des dge bas mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ /rdo rje rigs kyi gtso bo thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang don gnyer ba mang po'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba ste/ dpal jo mo nang gi ri khrod du'o/ /dge legs 'phel/ bkra shis/ skos byed dge slong mchi med sor rtses skrun/ /dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang myur du thob pa dang*/ rgyal khams kun du dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /maṅgalaṃ// ༄༅/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdul tshon klu la gtod pa'i lag len bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdul tshon klu la gtong pa'i lag len ni/ mchod pa'i yo byad sogs tshogs par byas nas/ rdul tshon bkur sti dang bcas te/ chu rgyun rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bo'am/ mtsho sogs gting zab cing skam par mi 'gyur ba'i chu 'gram du rdo leb bam maṇ+ḍal la rdul tshon gyis pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad legs par 'bri ba'am spar btab kyang rung ste/ lte ba dang 'dab ma la rdul tshon nam me tog gi tshom bu bkod/

de'i mdun du mchod yon la sogs pa'i chu dang*/ g.yas su nyer spyod lnga/ mdun nas 'go brtsams te rgyab kyi bar du bsham/ g.yon du dkar gtor 'o mas bran pa dang*/ snod gcig tu 'o thug gam/ ma 'byor na 'o ma phal pa blug /de'i mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon gang bde ba zhig tu cung zad stegs bu mtho bar bum pa la sogs pa'i snod bzang por rdul tshon bzhugs su gsol/ gla rtsi sogs klu la gnod par 'gyur ba spangs pa'i bdug spos brtul zhing*/ las bum gyi lha'i sngags bdun tsam bzlas la/ mchod pa sogs/ a mṛ ta 'am sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhes pa nas/ rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ yang bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ paṃ las byung ba'i rgya mtsho kha dog dkar po rin po che dang*/ me tog gis gang ba/ rlabs 'phreng dang bcas pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la/ hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang snang gi yum gyis 'khyud pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgya mtsho chen po nas klu chen po brgyad la sogs pa klu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sum+bha 'am a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥgadan la 'khod par gyur pa ni 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du mtha' yas/ lhor ni pad+ma dang*/ nub tu 'jog po/ byang du nor rgyas dang*/ me ru dung skyong bden bral karko ṭa/ rlung du rigs ldan dbang ldan pad+ma che/ thams cad kyang lha'i lus can sku mdog dkar po sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/

sbrul mjug 'khyil zhing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag thal mo sbyar zhing rang rang gi rig ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ mtha' skor du klu'i rigs thams cad kyis bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ sarba nā ga a dhi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab 'joms shing*//bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / lag pa g.yon pa gdengs ka'i tshul dang*/ g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang*/ /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan dang*/ /lha mo lha mo chen po dang*// zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*/ /sog ma med dang hu luṇ+ḍa/ /dga' bo dang ni nye dga' 'o/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ /tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*/ /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*/ /gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang*//lto 'phye chen po shī li dang*/ /shī li chen po rnam dag go /oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa a gats+tsha ā gats+tsha mahā nā ga a dhi pa ti sarba bhur+bhu wa phruṃ phruṃ swāhā/

zhes pa lan gsum mam lnga'am/ lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ deng de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdul tshon rin po che 'di rnams bdag gir mdzad nas/ yang dag par mchod pa byed pa sogs mdor na sa phyogs 'di nyid nas brtsams te/ rgya mtsho chen po'i gting mthar thug pa'i bar du gnas pa'i sems can rnams la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang*/ sa phyogs 'di skor du lo legs shing nad med pa la sogs pa/ dge zhing bkra shis par mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyi zhes pa'am/ gtsug lag khang na gnas pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi/ zhes sogs ji ltar skabs su bab pa'i tshig sbyar la/ chos spyod 'phel ba dang*/ bar chad zhi ba dang*/ bstan pa rgyas pa dang*/ yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad gegs med du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig / sems can thams cad skyon med pa/ /gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /yig brgya'i mthar/ gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pas sogs dang*/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs kyi mthar/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swas+thā nāṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas klu rnams gshegs par mos/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes rdo rje sems dpa' rang la bsdu ba'am mi dmigs par sbyangs/ thog mar rdul tshon chu bor blug /mchod pa yang zhal zas nas mchod yon gyi bar rim gyis bsdus nas chu bor dor/

de ma thag klu brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor nyid kyang chu la dor/ gzhi ma maṇ+ḍal yod na der 'khru zhing*/ rdul tshon gyi snod bum pa'ang legs par bkrus nas chu gtsang mas dgang ste/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru sogs sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags bzla bzhin du dkyil 'khor khang par 'ong bar bya'o/ /'di la klu brgyad po rang rang gi kha dog so sor byed pa'ang yod de/ mtha' yas sngo la pad+ma dkar/ /'jog po nor rgyas dmar dang ljang*/ /dung skyong dung mdog stobs rgyu'ang ljang*/ /rigs ldan sngo la pad chen ser/ / zhes 'dod pa ltar byas kyang rung*/ gsang 'dus skor dang gshin rje gshed skor nas khro bo'i rgyan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar yang rung*/ phyogs dang sku mdog rnams dur khrod kyi skabs 'byung ba ltar byas na'ang 'gal ba med/ gzhan yang rdo rje gur las gtor ma'i skabs su gsungs pa lta bu la sogs pa ji ltar 'os par sbyar yang rung ngo*/ /phyogs g.yon skor du byed na/ dbang por mtha' yas byang phyogs nor rgyas dang*/ /chu bdag 'jog po gshin rjer pad+ma'o/ / zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ gzhan yang mtshams kyi skor lugs dbang ldan thog mar byed pa'ang yod pas/ ji ltar 'os pa rig pas dpyad do/ / dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' mi byed par/ chu lha dkar po sbrul zhags dang ut+pal 'dzin pa/ rig ma dang bcas pa sgom pa'ang yod cing*/ phuḥyig brgyad las klu brgyad bskyed pa sogs sna tshogs yod de/ de dag ji ltar 'os pa skabs su gang bab tu sbyor shes na so sor sbyar bar bya la/ min na yang gong dkyus su bshad pa nyid gsang ba spyi'i cho ga yin pas rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor gang la yang sbyor du rung bar shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis bskul pa'i ngor/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// gcig zhus/ maṅgalaṃ/ / ༄༅/ /rab gnas kyi cho ga 'gro phan rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / na mo badz+ra dha ra ya/

dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi thun mong du spyod pa gsang ba spyi'i cho ga las brtsams pa'i rab gnas 'bring po 'gro phan rgyas byed ces bya ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma mchog dang lhag pa'i lha/ /dkyil 'khor gtso la gus btud nas/ /sku gzugs la sogs byin rlabs pa'i/ /cho ga bsdus pa bri bar bya/ /de la slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pas dus gza' tshes skar ma sbyor ba byed pa sogs bzang ba la rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi 'byung bar bya ste/ de la rdul tshon nam/ ras bris sam/ blos bslang la sogs pa phyi'i dkyil 'khor la rten pa'am/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor 'ba' zhig la rten pa yin yang rung ste/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa gcig la rten na nges par bzang zhing*/ lha dpa' bo gcig pa la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor la rten pas kyang rung ba tsam ni yin no/ /de yang skabs 'dir bsdus pa la mos pa'i lugs phyi'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa mi byed pa ltar na/ sa phyogs gang yang rung bar stegs bu'i steng du maṇ+ḍal/ /dbus su me tog gi tshom bu dgu tshom/ de'i phyi rol du/ phyogs bzhir tshom bu gnyis gnyis dang*/ mtshams bzhir re re/ de'i phyi rol phyogs bzhir cung zad che ba'o/ /bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ spro na mtshams bzhir chung ba re yang 'god/ steng 'og gi khro bo'i tshom bu de'i shar nub tu bkod/ de'i steng du mañji la rnam rgyal bum pa bca' ba'am/ yang na de'i g.yas g.yon gang rung du bcas kyang rung*/ las bum ni maṇ+ḍal bcas phyin chad de'i g.yon du nges par 'cha'/ de'i mdun du mchod gtor yang spyi dang mthun par bshams/ go skabs yangs pa'i phyogs gang yang rung ba gcig tu gdan pad+ma 'dab brgyad rdul tshon nam ras bris gang yin yang bzhag /de yang ma 'byor na gzhi gtsang ma ji ltar 'os pas chog /de'i steng du 'byor zhing spro na khrus kyi bum pa brgyad phyogs mtshams brgyad du bshams shing*/

dbus su mañji'i steng khrus gzhong dang*/ me long gos zung dri bzang sogs kyang bzhag par bya/ brgyad ma 'byor na bum pa bzhi'am/ de yang ma 'byor na gcig gis kyang rung ste/ bzhi yod na phyogs bzhir bum pa dang*/ dbus su mañji 'god/ gcig las med na dbus su bum pa 'god do/ / sku gzugs la sogs pa gang rab tu gnas par bya ba rnams kyang mngon du phyogs par bya'o// de la rab gnas nyin gcig pa'i cho ga la spyi sdom ni/ yo byad tshogs dang bkod pa legs par bshams/ /sngon 'gro gnyis dang bdag bskyed bum pa sgrub/ /sbyang ba khrus gsol rten bskyed ye shes dgug /dbang bskur mchod pa spyan dbye mnga' dbul bya/ /gsol gdab rjes mchog gtor ma yon bdag bsgo/ /shis brjod rjes bsdu sbyin sreg zhes pa ste/ /cho ga'i rim pa bco brgyad nyid du 'dus/ /dang por bya ba gnyis dang nyi shu'o/ /mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yod na bsnan//med na bum pa maṇ+ḍal lhan cig sgrub/ /sbyang ba la gsum khrus gsol gnyis su bshad/ /ye shes dgug la spyan 'dren bgegs bskrad dang*/ /mchod dang gsol btab :sre £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· ste £© ba zhes te lnga// mchod pa'i skabs su mchog gyur sbyin sreg yin/ /zas mchog byug pa so rtsi mchod bstod dang*/ /yo byad sngags kyi mnga' dbul zhes pa bdun/ /brtan bzhugs gnyis dang sngags dang ched brjod de// gsol btab yan lag bcas la rnam pa bzhi/ /mdun bskyed mchod dang bzod gsol gshegs gsol te/ /rjes mchog rnam pa gsum du 'gyur ba yin/ /yo byad bsdu dang lha bstim bdag nyid srung*/ /smon lam bkra shis rjes bsdu'i bya ba bzhi/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa la/ /cho ga'i yan lag lnga bdun drug tu bshad/ /de lta na/ cho ga spyi'i sngon 'gro gnyis dang*/ bdag bskyed dang*/ bum bskyed dang*/ brten sbyang ba dang*/ khrus gsol te sngon 'gro lnga'o/

/rten dam tshig par bskyed pa/ ye shes pa dgug pa/ dbang bskur ba/ mchod pa/ spyan dbye/ mnga' dbul/ gsol btab ste/ dngos gzhi cho ga bdun no/ /rjes chog /gtor 'bul/ yon bdag bsgo ba/ shis brjod rgyas pa/ rjes bsdu/ sbyin sreg ni rjes kyi bya ba drug ste/ de ltar bco brgyad do/ /dang po cho ga spyi'i sngon 'gro gnyis ni/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang*/ gnas dang yo byad byin 'bebs pa ste/ bdag bskyed gang byed pa'i cho ga de'i lugs sam/ yang na spyi 'gro yin pa'i phyir/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las/ gnas khang bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gi dbus su/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ pād+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa nas/ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta sogs rol chen bya/ gnyis pa bdag bskyed ni/ de nas gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar rdzogs par bya/ dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa'i rigs yin na rang la bsdu/ lha rkyang re bsgoms pa yin na bsdu ba mi dgos so/ /gsum pa bum bskyed ni/ lha'i bum pa la rdo rje gzungs thag dung chos sogs lag len spyi dang mthun pa bshams/ maṇ+ḍal dang bum pa la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ gis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ maṇ+ḍal gyi gnas su paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang ra gur phyi nang thams cad du ye shes kyi me 'bar bar gyur/ de'i dbus su bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/

mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa'i gnas su paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul bcing dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang lha'i chu bo dang bdud rtsis yongs su gang bar gyur/ maṇ+ḍal gyi gzhal med khang dang rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa na/ dbus su hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol bas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum rdor dbyings dbang phyug ma'am/ reg bya rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa/ shar du oṃ las rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu/ lho ru swā las rin 'byung ser po nor bu dang dril bu/ nub tu āḥ las 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu/ byang du hā las don grub ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu de rnams phyag gnyis thugs kar bsnol pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing rig sngags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba chen po'i cha lugs can/ shar lhor laṃ las sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu maṃ las mā ma kī sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nub byang du paṃ las gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang shar du tāṃ las sgrol ma ljang khu ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa/ de rnams phyag g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ de'i phyi rol kyi shar gyi g.yas su maiṃ las byams pa dang*/ g.yon du k+ṣiṃ las sa'i snying po gnyis dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lho ru dz+riṃ las phyag na rdo rje dang*/ khaṃ las nam mkha'i snying po ser po rin po che 'dzin pa/ nub tu maṃ las 'jam dpal dang*/ gaṃ las 'jig rten dbang phyug gnyis dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du saṃ las kun tu bzang po dang*/ skaṃ las sgrib pa rnam sel gnyis ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa/

de ltar brgyad po ni g.yas phyag mtshan thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon khu tshur dkur brten pa/ shar lhor hūṃ las sgeg mo dkar mo/ lho nub tu traṃ las 'phreng ba ma ser mo/ nub byang du hrīḥlas glu ma dmar mo/ byang shar du āḥlas gar ma ljang khu/ de lta na spyan ma la sogs pa de rnams thams cad sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ / yang na sgeg mo la sogs pa'i dod du/ rdo rje ma bzhi bskyed kyang shin tu legs so/ / gzhal yas khang gi sgo bzhi'am/ sgo bzhi sogs phyogs bcu dang*/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang gi phyogs bzhi'am/ phyogs bcur hūṃ las khro bo bzhi'am bcur gyur pa ni/ shar du gshin rje mthar byed nag po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lho ru shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po rdo rje rwa gdengs pa 'dzin pa/ bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ spro na/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can nag po gshin rje'i dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du stobs po che dud kha rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug gtor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ de rnams thams cad kyang khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad cing*/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /las bum gyi nang du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa nag po g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon sbrul gyi zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can spyan gsum dbu skra gyen du brdzes shing*/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ pad nyi la g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po mnan pa/

me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ gshegs ma/ sems dpa' dang sems ma/ khro bo dang khro mo'i lha tshogs thams cad dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yang snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkha' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu ma ཾ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / sogs kyis bstod/ gzungs thag las bzung ste/ bum bzlas kyi dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzika oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā:rat+na dh+rika swa hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.a ro lika āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā dh+rika hā hūṃ/

zhes pa rnams so/ /so sor brgya rtsa re las mi nyung ba bzla/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥtāṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmaiṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥk+ṣiṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdz+riṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥgaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥskaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥsaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥtraṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.aḥhūṃ/ zhes pa rnams kyang so sor bdun bdun tsam bzla/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpad+man+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa rnams nyer gcig re bzla/ khro bo gzhan rnams kyi sngags bzla mi dgos shing*/ bzla bar spro na'ang 'di bsdus pa yin pa'i phyir/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ zhes pa kho na bdun bdun re bzlas pas chog go /las bum la dmigs nas bigh+nān+ta krita 'am/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa sogs cirigs bzla/ shes shing spro na/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rtsa sngags kyang bzla'o/ /mthar oṃ āḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa lan nyer gcig tsam bzla/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ a las thod pa/ de'i nang du hūṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ hri khaṃ las bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ baṃ bh+ruṃ hūṃ hri taṃ las sha lnga/ ha ho hrīḥde rnams zhu ba las dam tshig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ las 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te gnyis su med par 'dres pas/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ spro na gong du smos pa'i bzlas pa'i sngags re re'i mthar/ a kā ro = btags pas 'bul/ de tsam mi lcogs na/ a kā ro lan bdun gyis dkyil 'khor dang*/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha dang*/ lan gsum gyis las bum gyi lha la 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/

mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che = sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / bum bskyed kyi lha la dmigs nas yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod gsol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes mchod yon phul/ lha rnams rjes chags kyi mes byang chub kyi sems su yongs su zhu ste/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par gyur/ dri ma khrus kyi bum pa rnams la dmigs te/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul bcing dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang dri ma sbyong ba'i mthu dang ldan pa'i lha'i chu bos gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes pa nyid brgya stong la sogs pa ci nus su bzla zhing mthar sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags brgya rtsa'am/ gtsug gtor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs lan bdun sogs ci rigs pa bzla'o/ /brtan par bya ba'i don du rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa dang*/ las thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i don du rten 'brel snying po'ang cung zad bzlas te khrus bum gyi gzungs thag bsdu'o/ /yang lag len bsdus pa'i skabs 'dir bdag bskyed dang bum bskyed kho na la brten pas kyang rung bas/ maṇ+ḍal bshams pa dang*/ bskyed chog mchod pa 'di kun bor kyang chog pa tsam yin la/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub mchod rgyas pa dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na/ lha bum dang las bum sgrub tshul so so'i lugs bzhin du grub na mchog yin mod/ gong du bshad pa de yang gsang ba spyi'i cho ga yin pas/ 'di kho na sbyar na yang shin tu legs par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang 'brel na/ rten rnams dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga rgyas pas 'jug dgos par gsungs kyang*/

cho ga rgyas pa'i dbang du byas nas de ltar byas na shin tu legs mod/ mtha' gcig tu nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin la/ khyad par phyi dkyil rgyas pa med na 'jug pa'i cho ga mi dgos so/ /gzhan yang 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'di yan du tshags su chud par bya'o/ /bzhi pa rten sbyang ba ni rnam pa gsum las/ dang por bgegs sbyang ba ni/ skabs 'dir rten la mchod pa cung zad bshams/ sngags tsam gyi phul/ mtheb kyu gsum dang*/ chang bu ting lor bcas pa gsum lag len bzhin bshams/ mtheb kyu rten la bskor ba'i tshul du byas te/ slob dpon gyis mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇa daṃ ba ling ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ 'dir rab tu gnas par bgyid pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad gtor ma rgya chen po 'dir tshim par gyis la phan pa bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig / ting lo chang bur bcas par bskor zhing*/ oṃ sum bha ni sum bha hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wān bid+ya rā dza hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing rdo rje gsor/ deng 'dir rab tu gnas par bgyid pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i rigs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/

/log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ / log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren gyi/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ hūṃ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*/ /thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa'i/ khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras/ /ma lus dbang du bsdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol ba ston mdzad cing*/ /sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /dpa' bo'i stang stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi sgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ lung dang rtogs pas bsdus pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi=

gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi= gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi= chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab cing rnam par dag pa'i = kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen pos byin rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir rab tu gnas par bgyid pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs gang yin pa de dag thams cad/ dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i bka' thos pas phyogs 'dir ma gnas par myur ba nyid du gzhan du songs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de thams cad dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba khro bo'i rdo rje'i me lce 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba shin tu lhag par 'bar ba 'dis/ khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /suṃ bha ni dang*/ a mṛ ta sogs drag sngags drag tu 'don zhing*/ rdo rje gsor/ yungs kar brdegs/ gu gul dang bdud rtsi lnga sogs dud pas bdug rol chen dang bcas te bgegs gtor bzhi mdor dor/ de nas sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad snying khar yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam par gnas pa/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur te/ mdun gyi til la thim/ de nyid g.yas su ye shes kyi mes sreg cing*/ g.yon du chos nyid kyi rgya mtshor dor bar gyur/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de dag ni bgegs sbyang ba dang sdig pa sbyang ba ste/ bod kyi slob dpon rnying pa rnams kyi lag len yin no/ /de nas byur bsal ba ni/ yungs kar dang chu lag pa g.yas g.yon gyis bzung ste bskor/ gzhan rnams lag pa gcig gis skor nas rten dang yon bdag gi byur bsal bar bsam ste/ de yang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swāhā/

zhes pas yungs kar me nang du dor/ de phyin chad rdzas 'di rnams la bsdu na sngags bigh+nān+ta kṛta kho nas kyang rung la/ spros pa la dga' na sngags tha dad du bya ste/ oṃ hūṃ ḍa ḍhi ta phaṭa/ ces chu yang me nang du dor/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes kham phor dkar po dang*/ oṃ sarba ma la a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ya swāhā/ zhes dur ba dang bcas pa'i lci chang dang*/ oṃ pu+u n+ya dz+nyā na dha ra ṇa saṃ bha ra ḍho pa ka ya swāhā/ zhes pas ting lo zan chang dang bcas pa dang*/ oṃ saṃ sho sogs sam/ oṃ bha ra bha ra saṃ bha ra swāhā/ zhes pas seng ras sam/ zan ril rnams te/ kham phor man chad snod du gsog gi me la mi dor ro/ /de lta na rdzas sngags drug po de rnams lan bzhi bzhi dgos pas drug bzhi ldan gyi sbyang ba zhes bya'o/ /'dir yang mthar gong bzhin bden pa bdar/ rol mo dang bcas pas phyi rol tu 'dor ro/ /rten gyi mdun du dung chos kyi chu bzed zhal du ldugs bzhin pas/ oṃ ā hri pra ba ra sat+ka ra ar thaṃ badz+ra añca ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ añca ma naṃ gyi gnas su pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūṃ gis dri bzang sku gzugs kyi thugs kar byug oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ gis dbu la me tog dkar po bzhag oṃ badz+ra a lo ke āḥhūṃ gis mar me g.yas su bskor/ hūṃ bdun gyis sardza rā dza bdug spos g.yon du bskor/ rab tu gnas par bya ba'i rten de sku gzugs yin cing spro na nye reg kyang bya/ glegs bam mchod rten sogs la mi dgos shing*/ sku gzugs la'ang mtha' gcig tu ni ma yin no/ /de rnams ni byur bsal ba'i cho ga rgyas pa gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin yin te/ cung zad lag len rgyas pa'i skabs yin na/ gong gi sbyang ba gnyis song ba'i rjes su byur bsal ba 'di yang bya zhing*/ bsdus pa la mos na/ sbyang ba gnyis po tsam bya ba'am/ byur bsal :gdon

£¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· gong na £© byas pas rung ngo*/ / lnga pa khrus gsol ba ni/ thog mar rten gyi mchod pa snga ma bsal/ gsar pa cung zad bshams la/ yid kyis byin rlabs tsam bya/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes khrus chal gyi snod dang*/ bsku mnye'i snod dang*/ dril phyis kyi snod rnams mtshar du dngar zhing*/ me long dang*/ chu gtsang gi bum pa dang*/ sku phyi ba'i ras gtsang ma rnams thogs la/ thog mar dman pa'i khrus bya'o/ /de yang khrus chal ni rnam pa lnga ste/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ ba byung lnga dang*/ dri bzang dang*/ skyu ru ra'i phye ma dang*/ yung ba'i phye ma rnams te/ de rnams thams cad 'dzom na rab/ thams cad ma 'dzom na ji tsam rnyed pa de tsam gyis chog go /bdud rtsi lnga ni/ 'o ma/ zho/ mar/ sbrang rtsi/ ka ra dkar po rnams yin la/ ba byung lnga ni/ ba dmar zal gyi 'o ma/ zho/ mar/ lci ba/ chu rnams so/ /'di rnams thog mar byug rgyu mi gtsang ba gzhom pa'i phyir gyi 'dag rdzas la khrus chal zhes bya ba yin/ bsku mnye ni byug pa ste dri bzang gi til la mar ro/ /dril phyis ni shun lpags lnga'i phye ma la bshad kyang*/ bod du ma rnyed pas sran phyes bya la/ 'di yang 'dag chal lo/ /de'i lag len ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'am/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta krita hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa tshar gcig oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hriḥ.a/ zhes bzla zhing me long la khrus chal gyis byugs/ kā ya bi sho 'i sngags kyis drud/ yang a mṛ ta sogs kyi chu gtsang gis bkrus/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥkhaṃ kha zhes bzlas pas til mar gyis byugs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni ye swāhā/ zhes pas dur ba'i pir gyis drud/ sngags de nyid kyis dril phyis btab/ yang sngags de nyid kyis drud/ a mṛ ta 'i sngags dang*/ kā ya sogs sbyar bas chu gtsang gis bkru'o/ / de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a kā ya bi sho dha ni ye swāhā/
