de ltar bsdu na tshar gcig po des chog la/ rdzas rnams 'dzom zhing long skabs yod na/ khrus chal rim pa lnga'i dbye bas de nyid tshar lnga bya'o/ /de rnams bsal la/ de ma thag tu bzang khrus bya ba ni/ sku phyis kyang bzang ba gcig ltar la/ slob dpon gyis bum pa brgyad kyi bum chu dung chos sam snod gtsang mar bsdus la/ lag tu thogs te/ khrus gsol gyi tshe 'thor tshul tsam byed/ de yang*/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥ lan gsum dri bzang byugs/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo khro mo bcu la sogs pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rten la khrus gsol ba'i don du mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rten 'di rnams kyi dri ma sbyang ba dang*/ sku khrus gsol bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ ri bo ltar ni mdzes pa yi/ /yon tan dam pa'i rgyan ldan pa/ /mchod gnas rin chen 'di dag la/ / bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyis/ /

zhes snyan mnan zhing*/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba ltar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla re bris pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu// yid 'od legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta asna na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa mā ya swāhā/ rol chen bya/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes dri ma khrus kyi bum pas khrus gsol/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a kā ya bi shwo dha ni ye swāhā/ bsdu na de tsam gyis kyang chog la/ spro na/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba nas/ shrī hūṃ/ de dag sku la nas/ dha ni ye swāhā/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang tshigs bcad re re'i bar du/ nges par khrus sngags dang*/ sku phyis sbyar dgos la/ rgyas pa la dga' na khrus kyi khang pa zhes sogs kyang re re'i mgor sbyar na shin tu legs so/ / 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ /gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chu/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /oṃ nas swāhā/ 'di ni tshul khrims = khrims 'chal/ tshul khrims dri yis / oṃ sogs/ bzod pa/ khong khro'i/ bzod pa dri yis/ brtson 'grus/ le lo'i/ brtson par/ bsam gtan/ rnam g.yengs/ bsam gtan/ shes rab/ shes 'chal/ shes rab dri/ khrus legs/ oṃ nas swāhā/ de ltar tshigs bcad tshan pa brgyad la/

bum pa brgyad yod na rim pas sbyar/ bzhi yod na lan gnyis sbyar/ gcig las med na/ de kas thams cad la sbyar ro/ /de nas tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su khrus re gsol zhing*/ 'di skad ces/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas/ /bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ /gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas/ /dri ma rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa/ khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'/ /dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi/ /yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du/ /dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ / de ltar khrus gsol ba rnams kyi dus/ las kyi rdo rje gzhan zhig gis las bum nas kyang yal 'dab kyis gtor bas bgegs dang mi shis pa thams cad sbyangs par bsam/ mthar de dag sku la sogs snga ma bzhin sku phyis bya'o/ / de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /rgyan mchog brgya phrag rnams kyang de la 'bul/ /stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi//dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra wa sa se swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a bha ra ṇaṃ bi bhu ṣa ṇe swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swāhā/ 'di gsum gyi go rim la/ byug pa na bza'/ brgyan zhes pa'i tshul du sbyar na'ang rung ngo*/ /shin tu spro na rab gnas rgyas pa nas byung ba ltar shis brjod rgyas par bya mod kyi/ gong du bshad pa'i phar phyin drug po'i tshigs bcad nyid shis brjod yin pas de tsam gyis chog go /de ltar khrus gsol grub ma thag tu ye shes pa spyan 'dren par gzhung nas bshad cing*/ bod kyi slob dpon rnying pa rnams kyi lag len ltar na skabs 'dir rjes dran gsol btab dang*/

sems bskyed bzung ba byed pa'i srol yod pa/ byed par spro na cho ga rgyas pa rnams las shes par bya'o/ /drug pa rten dam tshig pa'i lhar bskyed pa ni/ slar yang*/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sku gzugs rnams kyi gnas su paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du*/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs mnyam pa nyid kyi rdo rje dpal bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje 'chang chen po dang po'i mgon po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang dang 'dra ba'i yum rdo rje snyems ma la yang dag par 'khyud pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rab tu rgyas pa'i spyan gdangs shing dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs chen po'i cod pan can/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ do shal/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ 'og pag se mo do la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ snyan gong at+pa la'i gdengs ka dang dar dpyangs kyis mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar zhing 'phro ba'o/ / zhes brjod/ mchon rten yin na/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma rang dang mtshungs pa la 'khyud pa/ zhabs rdo rje sogs gong bzhin/ po ti yin na/ dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pad+ma dang*/

g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo sogs phyag 'tshan yin na/ hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo/ sogs/ yang na mchod rten ni rnam snang yongs su gyur pa las mchod rten nyid du gyur te/ de'i dbus su rnam snang gi gzugs brnyan shar bar bsgom pa yang bshad do/ /gang ltar yang de ltar bskyed zin pas rjes su/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ rnams dang*/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ dkar po/ rna bar dz+riṃ sngon po/ sna la khaṃ ser po/ lce la gaṃ dmar po/ skra mtshams su skaṃ ljang khu/ lte bar saṃ sngon po/ dpral par oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po ās mtshan pa/ snying khar rigs lnga'i sa bon gyi 'og tu hūṃ las rdo rje nag po hūṃ gis mtshan pa rnams su gyur/ bdun pa ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ ye shes sems dpa' la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing*/ /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*/ /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/

/chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*/ /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drangs bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rjes che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan/ /oṃ tshur byon tshur byon zhing dag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod par 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod/ ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gzhan du song zhig /sum+bha bzlas te rol mo'i sgra bsgrags la bgegs bskrad/ ye shes pa la ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' mchog /rig pa'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse don dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod phyir dang*/ /sems can bsod nams spel don dang*/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ khyod kyi rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*/ /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang*/ /sems can bstan la mngon dga'/ /gang gzhan rdo rje'i spyan ldan dag /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /lha 'di rab tu gnas pa ni/ /bgyi 'o des na khyed rnams kyis/ /nye bar gnas par mdzad par 'os// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/

oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha a/ zhes mang du brjod la dam ye bsre'o/ /gzhung nas gsal bar bshad pa med kyang*/ yang snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros te ye shes pa sngon bzhin spyan drangs te bstim pa'i bar lan gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun la sogs par byed par 'dod de/ dmigs pa gsal zhing yid ches pa'i phyir yin pas mi 'gal zhing legs par mngon la/ spyir cho ga ma tshang ba med pa'i yan lag tu ni tshar gcig po des chog go / brgyad pa dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus pa gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug /khro bo khro mo bcu la sogs pa dkyil 'khor pa thams cad lha la dbang bskur ba'i don du mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ / rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yod na ni/ sngar sbyang ba'i sngon du 'jug pa'i cho ga rgyas pa zin na des chog cing min na skabs 'dir na bza' dmar po gsol/ me tog gi 'phreng ba btags te/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa bsdus pa tsam mam/ shin tu bsdus pa/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor du zhugs par mos/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor rgyas pa med cing*/ gong du bshad pa'i maṇ+ḍal tsam la brten pa yin na'ang*/ dpa' bo 'bru lngas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa de dang 'dra zhing*/ ci ste maṇ+ḍal bshams pa de'ang med na dbang lha rnams gzhal yas khang bsrung 'khor dang bcas par spyan drangs la/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs par mos pa tsam gyis chog go /gang ltar yang de nas 'di skad ces bya ste/

rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*/ /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de bzhin 'di la stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i zhal du sku gzugs la sogs pa'i rten rnams rab tu bcug ste/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi pad+mar phyin pa rang gi lha'i gzugs kyi rnam par gnas pa la/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rjes su chags pas byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rnams bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang tha mi dad pa'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis yongs su bkrus pas rten gyi dri ma sbyangs shing*/ shes rab kyi pad+ma'i mtha' las spros nas dbang stegs kyi steng du 'khod par gyur/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rdul phra rab mtha' dag rnams kyang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mtha' yas par gyur pa pad+ma las phyir spros te/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su gang bar bzhugs pa rnams rten la dbang bskur bar mngon du phyogs pas shis pa brjod par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bskyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng 'dir dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /oṃ phun gsum tshogs pa sogs shis brjod ji ltar 'os pa bya/ hūṃ las byung ba mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin rnam rgyal bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī ye hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ oṃ las byung ba rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rnam pa can dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/

oṃ badz+ra rat+na aṃ/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrī āḥ dz+riṃ ngam hriḥlas byung ba 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i dbang bskur/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje yi/ /dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur// 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje rab tu grub phyir bzung*/ khaṃ las byung ba don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin dril bu dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ba ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca ma ཾ / tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi bdag nyid ming gi dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca ma ཾ / badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gis rig ma la 'khyud par gyur/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag / chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan/ nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang ye shes sems dpa'i tshul gyis rten rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor zhing sngags de lan brgya phrag sogs bzla'o/ /

oṃ hūṃ hrī bh+ruṃ khaṃ badz+riṃ bha wa ḍi ḍha tiṣ+ṭha bh+ruṃ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ hūṃ hrī tāṃ zhes pa rnams kyang ci rigs par bzla'o/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang bcas pas/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de bzhin khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang bcas pas/ shes rab sbyor bas dpal ldan ni/ /'di nyid yang dag mtshon par bya/ /rdo rje skyil krung dag gi sems/ /nor bu'i nang du gnas blta bas/ zhes brjod/ sku gzugs la sogs pa rang bzhin zung 'jug gnyis su med pa bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su mos nas/ 'di nyid ye shes chen po ste/ /thams cad lus la rnam par gnas/ /gnyis med gnyis su med pa'i tshul/ /brtan dang g.yo ba khyab nas gnas/ / zhes brjod cing cung zad mnyam par bzhag ste/ lha la dbang bskur ba'o/ /de ltar na lha rnams dam tshig par bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes pa bstim pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba gsum po de ni rab gnas dngos yin la/ gong 'og gi cho ga gzhan rnams ni yan lag yin no/ /dgu pa mchod pa rgyas pa ni/ de ma thag tu lha so so'i snying pos na bza' 'bul bar bshad/ snying po ngos zin pa dka' na/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya zhes sogs rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa brjod bzhin du na bza' la sogs pa mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'bul/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ba sa se hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhu pe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dī pe hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gan+dhe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra nai wi t+ye hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥsarba a bha ra ṇa bi bhu ṣa ṇe swāhā/ zhes pas nyer spyod dang rgyan la sogs pa phul/ oṃ āḥsarba saṃ sho dha ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas 'bras bu dang*/

me tog la sogs pa mchod pa rnams bsangs/ oṃ dz+riṃ swāhā/ zhes pas 'bras bu la sogs pa phul/ oṃ badz+ra satwa a/ zhes sku gzugs kyi mdun du me long gtsang ma zhig bzhag go /de nas mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gong gi gnas yo byin rlabs dang 'dra ba las/ gnas khang bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gi dbus su zhes pa dor ba'o/ /mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ dbyangs dang bcas pa med kyang rung ste/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la mchog stsol mdzod/ /oṃ āḥhri pra wa ra sat+ka ra ar thaṃ badz+ra añca ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ zhabs bsil/ pā d+yaṃ/ 'thor 'thung*/ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ/ mchod yon/ ar+ghaṃ/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas khyod la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas khyod la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /dhu pe/ mun pa 'joms byed snang ba'i mchog /mar dang til gyi mar me 'di/ /yang dag ye shes spel ba'i phyir/ /bdag ni dad pas 'bul bar bgyi/ /ā lo ke /lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung*/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i dri chab 'di/ /mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /ci bde bar ni so sor bzhes/ /gan+dhe/ bza' dang bca' ba phun sum tshogs/ kha dog dri ro rnams dang ldan/ /thams cad ldan pa lha yi bshos/ /bdag gis 'bul gyis so sor bzhes/ /nai wi t+ye/ bla med theg pa chen po'i don ston zhing*/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra/ /bdud kyi 'khor lo gzhom phyir dbul bar bgyi// don gyi dbyings la mnga' brnyes bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ dharma ra ṇi ta sogs rol chen bya/ de nas bstod pa ni/

mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad// yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub mchog rnams sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam nyid dam pa'i mchog chos can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bsgrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas dpag med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung*/ /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don grub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid bdag tu rnam par snang*/ /tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang*/ khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yongs mi 'gyur/ /e ma ho shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgya chen ldan/ /lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang*/ /gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ /nus shing spro na skabs 'dir sbyin sreg 'bul/ bcu pa spyan dbye ni/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*/ /gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes spyan nyid thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi shwa dha ni swāhā/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing*/ sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa mnga' brnyes par gyur cig

spyan dbye 'di ni bsdus pa yin la/ rgyas par na sku'i sgo thams cad dag par bya ba'i tshul gyis dbye bar bya ba yin no/ /bcu gcig pa mnga' dbul ni/ 'dir gzhung las/ 'o thug sgrub pa'i mnga' dbul sogs cung zad las ma gsungs kyang*/ mchod pa'i bye brag ji tsam rgyas kyin bzang bas/ bod kyi bla ma snga ma rnams kyi lag len mnga' dbul rgyas pa byed pa yang skabs 'dir sbyar na legs pa yin no/ /de yang 'o thug gam zas mchog na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ di bya an+ne sa ma dhi dh+ya na pri ṇa ne swāhā/ zhes lan nyer gcig las mi nyung ba bzlas/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa 'i sogs brjod/ oṃ badz+ra lip+pe swāhā/ tsan+dan gyi lde gu byug oṃ taṃ bo lā ya swāhā/ zhes pas so rtsi phul/ slar yang mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang*/ /mchod yon bkod pas 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar du sbyar/ de nas bstod pa ni/ ji tsam mang kyin bzang*/ bsdu na/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sngug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas/ /thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sems can smin zhing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang*/ /chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa/ /'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sems can bkren pa chos kyi 'phongs gyur pa// ma rig thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams*/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa/

/ye shes sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa rnams/ /thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur bcug nas/ /zhi ba rin chen gling mchog skyel mdzad pa/ /kun gyi ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can las kyi chu bor nub gyur rnams/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing*/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*/ /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing*/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang*/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang*/ /skur bcas sku ni med pa yi/ /mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ de nas mngal dbul gyi rdzas rnams dngos sam/ gzugs ri mor bris pa'am/ 'bur du brkos pa sogs rim gyis star la/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra re ge āḥhūṃ swāhā/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi/ /spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku/ / gser sbyangs gtso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byugs par bgyi/ /oṃ badz+re gan+dhe āḥhūṃ swāhā/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde/ / srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yi/

/na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ /bsgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swāhā/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin brgyan ldan phyir/ /rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang*/ /rin chen brgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra a laṃ ka ra bi bhu ṣa ni āḥhūṃ swāhā/ rgyal ba zag med 'byor la mnga' bsgyur yang*/ /'gro ba'i don du 'dod yon rnam lnga yis/ /mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/ /bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra sa man+ta bha dra pū dza me gha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la/ /bsams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis/ /'gro ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ mahā sab+ta rat+na pū dza me gha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyi lham mer bzhugs/ /bsod nams ye shes sku lnga brnyes pa la/ /lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul/ /'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra pañca pañca bi ma la pū dza me gha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ brtse ba'i khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan dang*/ /ting 'dzin bla re spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba/ / mchog rkyen 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag 'bul/ /skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra mahā pū dza me gha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ 'di rnams la bod snga ma rnams la spyi'i mnga' dbul zhes grags pa yin zhing*/ 'di dag mnga' dbul du 'os pa'i mchod rdzas bzang por snang ba'i phyir shin tu 'thad la/ bye brag gi mnga' dbul du grags pa rnams ni lugs 'di la mi sbyor te/ spu gri la sogs pa mnga' dbul ba'i rdzas su mi 'os shing*/ na bza' la sogs pa sngar phul ba'i nang du tshang ba dang*/ mchod rten gyi ni srog shing 'khor lo gdugs la sogs pa mchod rten bzhengs pa'i dus kyi cho ga yin gyi/

skabs 'dir dgos pa'i mnga' dbul ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ / 'on kyang sku gzugs la 'dreg bcad la sogs pa rnams dang*/ glegs bam la glegs shing sogs spyan dbye'i skabs dang cung zad 'brel ba yin pas na/ lag len shin tu spros pa la dga' bas spyan dbye'i skabs der phul na cung zad legs pa yin no/ /de nas sngags kyi mnga' dbul te/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥ zhes pa dang*/ ye dharma dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha rnams mang du bzla zhing rab tu gnas bya'i lha de nyid kyi sngags shes shing bzla bar spro na ci nus su bzla'o/ /de nas skabs 'dir zhal bsgyur dgos pa'i rigs yod na bya ste/ po ti rnams la/ 'od dpag med zhu ba las byung ba'i glegs bam du gyur/ de bzhin du/ mi bskyod pa zhu ba las byung pa'i phyag mtshan du gyur/ rnam par snang mdzad zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rten du gyur/ zhes pa lta bu'am/ mchod rten la sogs pa'i dbus su lha bskyed pa rnams ni de nyid de la thim par mos/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha so so'i bskyed chog shes nas/ so so'i bskyed chog byas pa yin na zhal bsgyur mi dgos la/ gong du bstan pa ltar thun mong du rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa yin na/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhu ba las byung ba'i lha so so rang rang gi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ /bcu gnyis pa gsol btab ni yang mchod pa tshar gcig bshams la/ sngon bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis phul/ mgon po thugs rje sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi bstod pas bstod/ me tog la rten 'brel snying po mang du bzlas nas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

bye brag du yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhug nas kyang*/ bdag dang yon bdag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang*/ dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ gnas dang rten dang gling mdzad de/ phan bde ma lus pa'i bka' drin stsal du gsol/ mdor na 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du 'gro ba sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes rol mo'i sgra bsgrags/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang*/ ye dharma bzlas shing rten la me tog dor/ de ltar lan gsum gyi rjes su/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kun/ /dga' ldan du ni rab bzhugs rnams/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhum bzhugs ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu/ /'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang*/ /sems can kun gyi don slad du/ /bdag gi 'byor ba nyid kyis ni/ /ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa bshams/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /kun gyis 'di la byin rlabs shing*//'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ /

zhes pas lan gsum du gsol ba btab/ a mṛ ta 'am/ bigh+nān+ta krita kyi sngags bzlos shing sku gzugs kyi steng 'og bar gyi cha thams cad du g.yas pas rdo rje lan gsum du bskor zhing gsor bas byin rlabs shin tu brtan par byas par bsam/ de nas dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ min kyang rung ste/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ / gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje ྄gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes ched du brjod do/ /bcu gsum pa rjes chog ni dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang 'brel na/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzod gsol gyi bar byed dgos pa yin la/ bsdus pa maṇ+ḍal bca' ba dang 'brel ba'i tshe na yang*/ mchod pa kha gsos/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis phul/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo ma 'am/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ bum pa tsam las ma bcas na yang mchod bstod 'di dgos te/ rten dang mgron la dmigs nas bya'o/ /mdun bskyed dang*/ rab tu gnas pa'i lha dang mgron gyi lha thams cad la dmigs nas yig brgya lan mang du bzlas/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ / sogs bzod gsol ci nus su byas la/ mgron rnams gshegs su gsol te/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams dag/gang dag cho ga'i bya ba la/

/nongs gyur de dag bzod mdzad rigs/ /kun tu zhi dang rgyas pa ru/ /yon bdag rnams la rab mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad su gsol/ / zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na/ sa dang chu dang me rlung las/ /lha rnams kyi ni sku gzugs la/ /bskal pa brgyar ni bsrung ba dang*/ /mchod pa chen po mdzad du gsol/ /dgyes shing yid bzang gyur nas su/ /slob dpon slob mar bcas pa yi/ /bu dang tsha bo bsrung ba dang*/ /gang gnas dge bar gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ zhes brjod/ bcu bzhi pa gtor chog ni/ bar 'dir sgos kyi chos skyong rnams kyi gtor bsngo sogs kyang bya la/ cho ga rgyas pa dang 'brel zhing phyi rol gtor ma'i bya ba yod na'ang skabs 'dir bya/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel yang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ram/ phyogs skyong bcu'i gtor ma sogs gnas khang de'i phyi rol tu song ste btang na shin tu legs so/ /chos skyong bsgo ba byed na'ang de'i gtor ma la sogs su bshams te gtor chog ltar phul la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /gal te dam las 'das gyur na/ /'jig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /oṃ mahā sa ma ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di la khyod kyi bsrung ba dang*/ mchod pa rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar mdzod cig /bdag dang yon bdag sogs la mi mthun pa'i phyogs las bsrung ba dang*/ bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzod cig ces brjod/ /bco lnga pa yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ de nas yon bdag rten la phyag 'tshal du bcug /gdan bzang po la bzhag nas/ khyod kyis nga la gang gsol ba'i/ /sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du/ /ji ltar gsungs pa ji bzhin du/ /de dag don ni ngas byas te/ /de rnams don ni grub zin gyis/

/ci bde bar ni mchod par gyis/ khyod kyis nga la gsol ba btab pa'i rab tu gnas pa de legs par tshar bar byas kyis/ rten 'di la zhag bdun gyi bar du mchod pa rgya cher gyis shig /de nas kyang ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad pas mchod par gyis shig / bcu drug pa shis brjod rgyas pa ni/ yon bdag dang*/ rdzas dang*/ gnas khang rnams la las bum gyi chu nas cung zad gtor te/ a mṛ ta 'i sngags lan mang du brjod/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad rim can du star la/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po ste/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib par dag gyur cig /gi haṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur te/ /nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste// snying po rnam dag ye shes rnams rtogs te/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi gyur cig /dur ba'i tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab grub nas/ /nyon mongs skye zhi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel gyur cig /bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang don kun grub gyur cig / dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrog pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te// chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma lus dbang du bsdus byas nas/ /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig

/yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ / bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi gyur cig / rgyal srid sna bdun rim gyis star la/ lha rdzas las grub lte ba shin tu zlum/ /rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang*/ /sdang ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal gyur pa'i/ / 'khor lo rin chen dam pa'i bkra shis shog /rin chen ngo bo lha rdzas baiḍūr+ya/ / kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing*/ /dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan ji bzhin/ /nor bu rin chen dam pa'i bkra shis shog /gzugs mdzes blta na sdug cing tshul bzang ma/ /pags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan// yid 'ong 'dod dgu'i reg bya dang ldan pa'i/ /btsun mo= gang yang rgyal la mu tig dang ldan pa'i/ /gser sogs mang po thub la phul pa ltar/ /bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag nor ldan pa'i/ /blon pau= yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ /rab gnas gangs can ri 'dra glang po che/ /rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i/ /glang po rin chen= tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i/ /sa rnams bskor te slar yang ldog nus shing*/ /rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar yid 'ong pa'i/ /rta mchog rin chen= 'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ongs gyur pa'i/ /ma lus bdud dpung 'jig par byed pa ste/ /dpa' brtan 'byor pa'i dpung dang bcas pa yi/ /dmag mi rin chen dam pa'i bkra shis shog / gzhan yang*/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa = sogs dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs/ mi 'gyur lhun po sogs/ sbyin pa gtong zhing sogs / ston pa 'jig rten khams su sogs/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad bcu zhi ba dang sogs/ lo brgya thub cing sogs/ 'bad dang sogs/ sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das sogs/ zab cing rgya che sogs/ nyin mo bde legs sogs/

rol chen dang bcas shis pa brjod do/ /de dag ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ shis brjod 'tsham zhing rgyas pa ji ltar rigs pa brjod do/ /bar 'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am/ tsā ru'i bza' ba sogs dga' ston rgya cher btang*/ rab gnas kyi slob dpon la yon yang dbul bar bya'o/ /bcu bdun pa rjes bsdu ni/ de rjes su dkyil 'khor ram maṇ+ḍal yang rjes bsdu'i cho gas bsdus nas/ smon lam dang bkra shis cung zad bya/ bco brgyad pa sbyin sreg ni 'grub na slar yang rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga la 'jug par bya'o/ /de ltar sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyis rab gnas nyin gcig ma'i cho ga bshad zin to/ /cho ga 'di nyid la brten te nyin gnyis pa byed na/ khru gsol yan chad sngar bzhis byas nas/ snying kha'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pa la/ mchod bstod rgyas pa phul/ lce hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rjer mos nas/ bcom ldan rdo rje nas mdzad par 'os kyi bar gyis snyan gsan phab/ yang mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas nas/ oṃ badz+ra pū ṇa rā ga ma nā ya mūḥ zhes gshegs su gsol nas/ sku gzugs kyi spyi bo mgrin pa thugs ka spyi gtsug phyag rnams la dri bzang gis byug / a mṛ ta bzla zhing rdo rjes sku la reg pas bsrung ba byas par mos la khebs kyis g.yogs/ phyi rol du 'byung po'i tshogs la spyi gtor btang*/ mdun bskyed yod na rjes chog skabs 'dir bya ste sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /nang par bum bskyed yan chad bskyar nas bya zhing*/ bgegs dang sdig pa sbyang ba de ma byas kyang chog /byed par spro na sta gon gyi skabs bzhin song mtshams dam tshig pa bskyed pa sngar bstan pa ltar byas nas/ de rjes byur bsal ba dang*/ khrus gsol bya/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa man chad sngar ltar byas pas/ lugs 'di nyid kyi cho ga nyin gnyis pa legs par 'grub

pa yin zhing*/ ci ste nyin gsum pa byed na/ dngos gzhi dang rjes kyi nyin mo gnyis la sbyin sreg nges par bya zhing*/ de'i cho ga yang 'od kyi snye ma'i dgongs pa kho na las/ mdor bsdus su sbyar ba zhig yod pas der shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na brtan bzhugs yan chad nyin ma gnyis pa la :tshar £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· tshang £© bar byas nas/ dkyil 'khor ram maṇ+ḍal gyi rjes chog bkra shis kyi bar du'ang bya'o/ /nyin ma gsum pa la snga bar langs te/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed/ mchod gtor rnams sngar bzhin bya/ bum pa'i bya ba med kyang mchod pa'i don yin pas/ bum pa yang sngar bzhin sgrub na legs/ rab tu gnas zin pa'i rten lha sku dngos su gsal bar dmigs nas/ so so'i snying po ci rigs pa bzla/ so so'i sngags bzla bar spro na rdo rje sems pa'i yi ge brgya pa nyid lan mang du bzla'o/ /de nas mchod bstod rgyas pa zhig byed dgos pas/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ sngon bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rjes mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*/ /sems can don kun mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa mā ya hūṃ/ de bzhin du rol mo dang*/ shap+ta 'i bar du sbyar la/ dharma ra ṇi ta la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs rnams bzla zhing rol chen dang*/ bdug spos rgya cher 'bul ba sogs bya/ bstod pa yang de nyid lnga pa sogs gong du bstan pa ltar ram/ gzhan yang ji ltar 'os pas bstod/ shes na sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor nas 'byung ba'i rigs drug gi bstod pa sogs kyi klu dbyangs blangs na shin tu legs pa yin no/ /de'i rjes su mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa sogs bya ste/

de man chad sngar dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar na 'phags yul gyi shing rta chen po/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa mchog tu gyur pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i gzhung las 'byung ba'i lag leg rnams go rim ma 'khrugs par sbyar zhing*/ bod kyi lag len dang bstun nas/ tshigs bcad sogs dbyangs su gyer dgos pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ shis brjod la sogs pa gzhung dang mi 'gal ba rnams ci rigs par kha bskang ba yin no/ /mi 'jigs pa'i lugs 'dir rab gnas kyi rgyud dang*/ bla med rgyud sde rnams las rab gnas thor bur gsungs pa rnams dang*/ 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa yin pas don thams cad tshang zhing rgyas la/ mchog tu legs shing*/ spros pa la dga' ba'i blo bzos kun nas blangs pa'i lhad dang bral ba'ang yin pas/ rgyud dang tshad ldan gyi gzhung thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos re re tsam yod pa rnams bsnan na legs par 'gyur ba'ang srid/ gzhan cho ga'i lus 'di kho na ltar byas na legs pa yin no/ /cho ga rgyas pa ni gzhan du 'bri bar 'dod do/ /tshad ldan gzhung gi rjes 'brang zhing*/ /rang bzo spangs las dge thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten ma lus kun/ /myur du sangs rgyas sar 'khod shog /ces pa rab gnas kyi cho ga 'gro phan rgyas byed ces bya ba 'di yang don gnyer mang po'i bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// dge legs 'phel/ bkra shis// ༄༅/ /rab gnas 'gro phan rgyas byed kyi lhan thabs ches rgyas pa bzhugs so/ / shre yāstu/ spros la dga' ba dgyes pa'i phyir/ /'gro la phan pa rgyas byed pa'i//cho ga'i rgyan gyur 'di na ko /'brel med ma yin khungs dang ldan/ /de la sbyang ba'i sngon du/ rgyab chog dkyil 'khor gang byed dang 'brel ba'i khro bo'i rgyal por bskyed cing go cha 'god pa'i lugs kyang yod/

yang bde dgyes sdom chen sogs khro rgyal mchog rang yin pas khro bo gzhan du bsgyur mi dgos/ dper na rang dpal sdom pa'i skur skyed na/ go cha'i mchog lus dkyil yin/ dus 'khor gyi khro bor skyed na/ phyag rgya rgyan bkod dang*/ 'phreng sngags gnyis mkha' 'gro ma'i sa bon gyi sngags sogs bzlas na yang dgos don dang 'brel bas legs pa yin/ kha skongs dang po'o/ khrus phal pa'i skabs su 'di skad ces bya ste/ oṃ mi mthun bgegs dang log 'dren bsal byas nas/ /byur dang skal ngan ma lus zhi gyur te/ /srid gsum sgrib gnyis mi gtsang sbyang ba'i phyir/ khrul chal rnams kyi dril phyis sku la 'bul/ /oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ lan gsum/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swāhā/ gsum/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ gsum/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥkhaṃ kha/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*/ /sems can lus kyi sgrib pa sbyangs slad du/ /chu gtsang sman spos 'dag chal 'di phul bas/ /bdag cag dam pa'i sku mchog thob par shoga.oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi shwa dha na ye swāhā/ gsum/ dge byed lha dang lha mo'i tshogs/ /dag byed bdud rtsi bum pa'i chus/ /dge zhing bkra shis glu ྄dbyangs bcas/ /mi bskyod chab kyis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi shwa dha na ye swāhā/ de dag sku la

sogs bya'o/ khrus chal gyi dbye bas lan lnga byed na/ thog ma'i sngags/ a mṛ ta 'i dod du/ ya mān+ta kṛta dang*/ pradz+nyān+ta kṛta dang*/ pad+mān+ta kṛta dang*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra hūṃ ka ra hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes sbyar gzhan 'dra/ phal khrus dang bzang khrus kyi mtshams su/ bod snga ma rnams rten gsum rnying pa la sku khrus re mdzad kyin 'dug pa'ang shin tu spros pa la dga' na 'gal ba med do/ /de ltar na de'i khrus chu yang bum pa brgyad du ldugs so/ /de nas bzang khrus kyi skabs la/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sku khrus gsol/ oṃ āḥbai ro tsa na hūṃ swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du/ 'di ni khrus mchog la/ oṃ āḥrat+na sam+bha wa hūṃ swāhā/ dang*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i la/ oṃ aḥ.a mi ta bhā hūṃ swāhā/ 'di ni tshul khrims/ la/ oṃ āḥ.a mo gha sid+dhi hūṃ swāhā/ 'di ni bzod pa / la/ oṃ āḥlo tsa ni hūṃ swāhā/ 'di ni brtson 'grus/ la/ oṃ āḥmā ma kī hūṃ swāhā/ 'di ni bsam gtan/ la/ oṃ āḥpaṇ+ḍa ra ba si nī hūṃ swāhā/ 'di ni shes rab/ la/ oṃ āḥtā re tā ra ṇi hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā= dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o rjes la/ oṃ āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+ya hūṃ swāhā/ gsum/ oṃ sarba ta thā zhes sogs brjod/ gzhan yang khrus gsol gyi tshigs bcad sna tshogs brjod pas rung ngo*/ de nas de ma thag tu slob dpon nam las byed kyis las bum gyi chu nas cung zad 'thor stangs byed cing*/ sho lo ka re re'i mthar rol chen thung ba re byed bzhin du gzhan rnams kyis me tog 'thor zhing*/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo nas gsungs pa'i shis brjod 'di bya'o/ / gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /rnam 'joms dri ma med mdzad cing*/ /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam la 'jug mdzad cing*/

/chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gang zhig bde bar mnga' mdzad des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi/ /thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur zhing*/ / gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur/ /gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' yang*/ /gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pas/ /phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor zhing*/ /don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing*/ /sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /byang chub snying por gshegs pa na/ /sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur zhing*/ /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs pas/ /thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/ / thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*/ /chos kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*/ /'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/ khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*/ /lha rnams kyis ni bsam pa yi/ khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa/ /don de de ring grub gyur cig / rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs gyur/ /rkang bzhi khyed la bde legs shog khyed cag lam 'gro bde gyur cig

/phyir 'ongs rnams kyang bde legs gyur/ / nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*/ khyed la kun tu bde legs shog khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig / de nas slar yang las bum gyis sku khrus gsol te/ ji ltar bltams pa= 'di ni khrus mchog= de bzhin gshegs dang = sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ de dag sku la= de'i rjes su/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ zhes pa nas/ gan+dhe swāhā 'i bar bya'o/ /spros pa 'dod pa la rab gnas nyin gang la byed na dngos gzhi las gzhan thabs med/ nyin gnyis ma dang*/ nyin gsum ma la sbyang khrus rgyas pa 'di/ sta gon gyi nyin mo byed pa thob thang yin no/ /de nas yid kyis bsrung ba bya'o/ kha skongs gnyis pa'o/ / dngos gzhi khrus gsol grub nas rjes dran gsol btab dang sems bskyed bya ste/ so so'i lag tu me tog thogs/ thal mo sbyar la/ bdug spos 'bul bzhin du/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis/ rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang yang dag par ldan pa dang*/ stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum dang*/ thugs rje chen po la sogs pa mdor na slob pa dang mi slob pa'i sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos rnams dang ldan pa/ de'i skyon gyi nyes pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/

/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi bla na med pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa'i phung po lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa dang cho 'phrul gsum dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ bslab pa gsum dang*/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang yang dag par ldan pa/ de'i yang dag pa phyin ci ma log pa'i ye shes dang*/ shes bya'i yul thams cad brnyes pas/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pa rnams ma lus par spangs pa dang*/ bdud bzhi las rab tu rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par bsags pa dang*/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus rnam par mdzes pa dang*/ skyes bu chen po'i sku lta bas chog mi shes pa dang*/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa ste/ de'i gzugs kyi sku'i 'byor ba mthar thug pa/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ / zhes brjod cing*/ rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ / zhes pa'i skabs su thams cad kyi tshigs mthun par brjod la/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten la me tog gi char dbab/ spos kyis bdug rol mo dbul zhing*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyaka saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ne mu ne mahā mu na ye swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha gang yin gyi sngags dang 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i sngags bzla ba ni/ tshig sde tshan re re'i mthar bya'o/ /de nas sems bskyed pa ni/ mnyam par bzhag nas chos thams cad la mi gnas pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas/ 'gro ba mtha' dag dang gang gi don du bya ba de la byams pa dang*/ snying rje byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgoms la/

'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ / ngo mtshar chen po grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyis pas de'i mthus/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi dbugs dbyung ngo*/ / 'khor ba'i gcong rong chen po las bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /phas kyi rgol ba bdud dang log 'dren thams cad pham par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rtogs pa thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil par bgyi'o/ /sems can rnams kyi skye ba'i ljon shing rtsad nas bcad do/ /'chi bdag gi nyi ma phye mar brlag go /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bgyi'o/ /ma dad pa dang phyi rol pa dag dang*/ lta ba phyin ci log pa dag yang dag pa'i lta ba la gzud cing dad par bsgyur ro/ /las kyi chu bo bzlog par bgyi'o/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho skem par bgyi'o/ /chos kyi sgron me sbar bar bgyi'o/ / byang chub kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /bzod pa dang des pa la btsud do/ / bsam gtan gyi bde ba la cher stsal to/ /'dod chags kyi me dpung zhi bar bgyi'o/ /zhe sdang gi mtshon cha rnon po gzhom par bgyi'o/ bden pa la gzud do// phrag dog gi 'tshub ma zhi bar bgyi'o/ /ser sna'i mdud pa dgrol bar bgyi'o/ / sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o/ /'jigs pa ma mchis pa dang*/ bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug cing gnas par bgyi'o/ /de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog stsal zhing gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab cing*/ mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i dus su tshogs pa thams cad kyis kyang*/ de skad brjod cing me tog dor bar bya'o/ kha 'gengs gsum pa'o/

/ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren gyi skabs/ ma lus sems can sogs sho lo ka gsum dang*/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon sum mdzad/ /mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa/ /rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te/ /sems can sny-ing po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig / ces pa'i sho lo ka gcig gang byed 'dam ka yin/ rab gnas nyi ma sbrel ma byed na/ sta gon gyi nyin mo/ ma lus sems can sogs/ dngos gzhi'i nyin mo/ ma lus 'gro ba' = sogs bya/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad pa'i rjes la/ ye shes pa la mchod pa rgyas pa byed na/ 'di skad ces/ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ ho bha ga wān e h+ye hi mahā kā ru ṇi ka dri sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya staṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal ba ldan/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ya hūṃ swāhā/ mchod yon dbul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul/ lha la sogs pa dri yi rdzas// phyogs dus kun na ci yod pa/ /tshims byed yid 'ong dang ldan pa/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ zhing 'di'am rgya chen zhing rnams na/ /lha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ba/ /chu dang thang skyes yid byung rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/

/oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= phyogs dus kun na bdug spos dang*/ /lha rdzas spos kyi shing la sogs/ /dri zhim yid 'ong gang yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra dhu pa= 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu yi/ /rin chen mar me la sogs pa/ /snang ba'i khyad par gang yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke= 'jig rten 'di'am zhing gzhan na/ /lha dang mi la sogs pa'i zas*/ /yon tan kun ldan gang yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra nai we d+ya/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs= oṃ badz+ra shap+ta/ rol mo bya/ yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /bstod dbyangs yon tan rgya mtshos bstod/ /bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag las/ /nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig / yang rol chen bya/ de rjes/ bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' mchog = sogs sbrel lo/ kha 'gengs bzhi pa'o/ / lha la dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ chu dbang gi thog mar brjod pa'i bkra shis ni/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ / des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rdo rje'i rigs dang ldan/ /sdang bas zil mnan skye bo rnam par sbyong byed pa// mi bskyod mgon po zhes byar mtshan gsol de yis ni/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyed la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig mtha' dag 'khor lo'i rigs dang ldan/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtag 'phrog cing*/ /rmongs pas zil mnan skye bo yongs su sbyong byed pa/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyed la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rin chen rigs dang ldan/ /'phongs pa'i sdug bsngal sgrol bar yongs su rab brtson zhing*/ khengs pas zil mnan 'gro ba yongs su sbyong mdzad pa/

/bkra shes des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus pad+ma'i rigs dang ldan/ /'jig rten dbang phyug srid pa'i dra ba 'joms pa po/ /chags pas zil mnan 'gro ba yongs su sbyong mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus las kyi rigs dang ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid log par lta ba nges par spong*/ /de sbyongs thabs ston de ni kun nas sel mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ / zhes pa 'di 'jug par bya'o/ kha skongs lnga pa'o// spyan dbye ba'i skabs su/ dang por mchod pa bsdus pa zhig sngags dang phyag rgyas phul/ de nas gser thur dngul gyi kong bur bzhag nas/ mar dang sbrang rtsi bskus pa thogs la/ thur ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis lha tshogs kyi/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal/ /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes brjod cing*/ mig sman gyis spyan phye nas rdo rje'i mig tu byin gyis brlabs la/

kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*/ /gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ / sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ dī bya ne tra ya swāhā/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing*/ sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig / ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa na/ snyan sogs dbye ba'i tshig sngags dang bcas pa rgya gzhung ji lta ba'i mthar/ bod sngon rabs pa'i gsung las 'byung ba'i smon lam sngags bcas kyi tshig kyang sbyar ba ni 'di ltar/ gser ram dngul gyi rna brud thogs la/ 'gro rnams chos kyis 'phongs pa la/ /rgyal bas chos kyi dung bud ltar/ /de bzhin sems can don gyi phyir/ /rgyal ba'i snyan ni dbye bar bya/ /oṃ dī bya kar+ṇā ya swāhā/ zhes snyan phye nas/ rdo rje'i snyan du byin gyis brlabs la/ bsnyen bsring mi mnga' kun tu gsal bar ldan/ /thub pa'i sgra 'dzin ngo bos dag na yang*/ / dag byed 'di ni bdag gis 'bul lags kyis/ /skye bos rtag tu dam chos thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra kar+ṇa sho dha ya āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes bya'o/ /des mtshon te/ rmang tsher thogs la/ zag bcas phung po'i dri spangs bas/ /'gro ba sems can don gyi phyir/ / rnam par dag pa'i dri brnyes ltar/ /rgyal ba'i shangs ni dbye bar bgyi/ oṃ dī bya gha ṇā ya swāhā/ dri 'dzin rnam dag tshul khrims las 'khrungs pa/ /dge ba sgrub phyir skyon las nges grol yang*/ /mos pas 'dzin bcad dam pa phul ba yis/ / 'gro bas ye shes bla med thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ro ma dha ra ṇa āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes bya'o/ /zhal thur thogs la/ chos kyis ro mchog dga' ba yis/ /'gro ba thams cad tshim mdzad ltar/ /ro mchog brgya ldan zhal zas rnams/ /'bul phyir rgyal ba'i zhal dbye'o/ /oṃ dī bya mu kha ya swāhā/ 'od zer stong gis phye ba'i pad+ma dang*/

/ bim+pa ltar dmar yid 'ong zhal gyi sgros/ /legs par phye bas mkha' mnyam sems can gyi/ /thar pa'i grong khyer sgo mchog dbye bar shog /oṃ badz+rod+gha ṭa ya āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes bya'o/ /tshems shing thogs la/ rgyal ba'i tshems dkar bzhi bcu la/ / mi gtsang rdul gyis ma gos kyang*/ /bkur bsti rin chen ljon shing 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i tshems ni dbye bar bgyi/ /oṃ dī bya dan+ta ya swāhā/ dkar la thags bzang bzhi bcu tshang bas tshems/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos la mnga' bsgyur yang*/ / bdag cag dad pas tshems shing 'bul lags kyi/ /'gro bas sangs rgyas gsung dbyangs thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra dan+ta sho dha ya āḥhūṃ swāhā/ bum pa'am dung chos til mar sku phyis dang bcas pa 'bul/ rgyal ba ye shes sku can la/ /las dang nyon mongs dri bral yang*/ /'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyang ba'i slad/ khrus gsol bsku mnye 'bul bar bgyi/ /oṃ dī bya gā trā ya swāhā/ mtshan dang dpe byad mtha' yas mnga' ba'i sku/ /skyon kun bral zhing yon tan kun rdzogs kyang*/ /bdag blo dang mtshungs yo byad 'di 'bul bas/ /'gro kun gnyis med ye shes sku thob shog / oṃ badz+ra a ba ya ba ya sho dha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ de'i yan lag tu spu gri 'braig bcad so mang gsum sbyor bar 'dod na/ sku gzugs chags bral gyi rnam pa can la/ spu gri'i dbu skra 'breg tshul bya zhing*/ rgyal ba'i dbu skra mthon mthing skyon bral yang*/ /gzhan don bsgrub phyir khyim pa'i rtags spangs phyir/ /dad pas gser gyi 'breg bcad phul ba yis/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ka tsa mu le āḥhūṃ swāhā/ khro bo ma yin pa rnams la sku sen 'breg tshul bya/ zangs mdog ltar mdzes yid 'ong skyon bral yang*/ /bdag cag dad pas phyag dang zhabs rnams kyi/ /sen mo'i 'breg bcad phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang po thob par shog/

oṃ badz+ra na kha tshe da dzi na āḥhūṃ swāhā/ chags chen gyi cha byad zhi ba rnams la skra bshad phul te/ dbu skra rin chen lcang lo ma 'khrugs shing*/ mdzes shing lta bas mi ngom skyon bral yang*/ /bdag blo sbyangs phyir rkyen dang 'tsham pa 'di/ /phul ba'i 'gro kun dug gsum bral bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ba la sho dha ya āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa rnams so/ kha 'gengs drug pa'o/ / mnga' dbul gyi skabs dang po mchod pa'i mnga' dbul la/ 'gro phan rgyas byed du bris pa nyid kyi rgyas pa la'ang chog pa yin mod kyang*/ spros pa la dga' na dang*/ lar nas mchod pa ji tsam rgyas pa bzang bas/ mchod pa gsar ba mang du bshams shing byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis sngags rgya mang du brjod/ thog mar bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ni/ / oṃ bkra shis lha mo pad+ma can/ /dkar mo dpal gyi be'u 'dzin/ /ye shes lha la bdag 'bul na/ /kun du dge zhing bkra shis shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pā ri wā ra maṅga la shrī btas+ya āḥhūṃ swāhā/ oṃ bkra shis lha mo 'jigs byed ma/ /dkar mo gser gyi 'khor lo 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor= kun tu= maṅga la tsakra= 'od ldan ma= sngon mo pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin/ maṅga la : ka ma la £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· pad+ma £© rnam rgyal ma = mthon ka yid bzhin rgyal mtshan 'dzin = maṅga la dh+wa dza = mdangs ldan ma = dmar skya rin chen gdugs dkar 'dzin = maṅga la tshā traṃ ga = dkar sham ma = dmar skya gter gyi bum bzang 'dzin = maṅga la gha ṭa = dri med ma = ljang gu g.yas 'khyil dung dkar 'dzin = maṅga la shaṃ kha = yid gzhungs ma = margata mdog mtshungs gser nya 'dzin/ /ye shes= kun tu= maṅga la kan kamatas+ya = zhes pas mchod do/ / de nas bar 'dir zas mchog dang*/ byug pa dang so rtsi rnams phul nas/ mchod pa'i khyad par sna tshogs pa 'bul ba'i skabs su/ 'chad par 'gyur ba nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun yan chad ji ltar 'os pa bya ste/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*/

/rab gnas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten rnams la/ /dag byed dri bzang zhal bsil chu rgyun 'di/ / phul bas 'gro kun bde legs thob par shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pā ri wā ra añca ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du tshig rkang gsum pa la/ zhabs kyi pad+ma'i dri bcil rdo rje'i chu/ /pā d+yaṃ/ kun tu 'pho ba'i gdung sel bsangs gtor mchog / pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ/ yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i mchod yon 'di/ /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes bya'o/ / oṃ pa ṭa ha dang cang te sogs/ dung dang rnga sogs sgra dbyangs dang*/ /yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs rnams/ / 'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /shap+ta/ 'di chu bzhi nyer spyod dang bcas pa'i spyi 'gro yin/ de bzhin du mchod yon nyer spyod sogs la/ mchod 'phreng spyi 'gro drug las/ dang po ni/ chu bo gang gā'i rgyun bzhin du/ /mchod yon rgyun yang mi 'chad pa/ /bla ma lha yi tshogs la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes/ /oṃ sarba ta thā sogs sngags spyi dang 'dra/ 'dab rgyas pad+mo'i tshal bzhin du/ /me tog rgyun yang mi 'chad pa/ /bla ma= thugs rjes= oṃ sarba= tsan+dan nags tshal ljongs bzhin du/ /bdug spos= rin chen nyi zla'i 'od bzhin du/ /snang gsal= hu lun+ta ka'i rgyun bzhin du/ /dri mchog= ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog bzhin/ /zhal zas= ka la ping ka'i dbyangs bzhin du/ /sel snyan= bla ma= thugs rjes= oṃ sogs/ spyi 'gro gnyis pa ni/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ= de bzhin du mchod yon zhes par me tog nas/ rol ma ོ'i bar du spro zhing*/ sngags kyang shap+ta 'i bar ro// spyi 'gro gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/

/'khor lo sgyur ba'i rig pas byin brlabs pa'i/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa rnams/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi/ /ar+ghaṃ= de bzhin du rol mo'i bar du sbyar ba'am/ yang na/ 'jig rten 'di'am= kha dog dbyibs legs dri zhim yid 'ong pa'i/ /me tog sna tshogs skye ba'i shing rnams kyang*/ /rgyal ba= puṣ+pa= des 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre bsil zhing dri zhim reg na gdung ba sel/ /yid 'phrog dri chab ji snyed mchis pa yang*/ /gan+dhe = ga bur la sogs legs par sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas bdug pa'i spos sprin 'khrigs pa yang*/ /nghū pe = lha rdzas las byung rin chen sgron me 'bar/ /phyogs bcu'i mun pa kun du sel ba yang*/ / ā lo ke = ro brgya ldan zhing dri bsrung kha dog bzang*/ /swa sti ka sogs zhal zas sna tshogs kyang*/ /nai bi t+ye = pi wang la sogs rol mo'i khyad par mang*//rnar snyan yid 'ong rom mo ci mchis pa/ /shap+ta = spyi 'gro bzhi pa ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yon rnams/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /ar+ghaṃ sogs shap+ta 'i bar la sbyar ro// spyi 'gro lnga pa ni/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa dang*/ /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rjes mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*/ /sems can don kun mdzad du gsol/ /ar+ghaṃ sogs rol mo 'i bar ro/ /spyi 'gro drug pa ni/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang*/ /mchod yon bkod pas 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /mchod yon sna tshogs kun du bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /ar+ghaṃ sogs rol mo 'i bar du sbyar ro/ /de ltar spyi 'gro bdun po de dag las/ gang yang rung ba zhig 'dir bya zhing*/

gzhan dang gzhan dag mchod pa'i rim pa gong 'og ci rigs pa rnams la sbyar ro/ /yang nyer spyod lnga dang sbyar ba lha mo'i mchod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor kun du rgyal ba mnyes byed pa/ /mdzes ldan dkar mo rdo rje dril bu dang*/ /me tog spungs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ /nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ swāhā/ tshigs bcad kyi thog mtha' gnyis dang*/ sngags kyi thog mtha' gnyis 'gre'o/ / yid 'ong dud kha rdo rje dril bu dang*/ /bdug spos 'thul ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ /dhū pe = kun snang dmar ser rdo rje dril bu dang*/ /mar mes gang ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ /ā lo ke /gdung sel ljang khu rdo rje dril bu dang*// dri mchog blugs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ ghan+dhe/ zhal bzang sna tshogs rdo rje dril bu dang*/ /bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ /nai we t+ye/ zhes sogs so/ /de nas 'dod yon lnga la'ang rdzas dang*/ lha mo'i mchod pa gnyis kyi/ dang po ni me long bstan la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /srid pa'i mtsho las rnam par rgyal/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ni/ /sems can kun la bstan par bgyi/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra ā dar+sha hūṃ/ sngags kyis thog mtha' 'gre'o/ /pi waṃ bsgreng zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sgra yi rjes su 'gro ba yis/ /gang gi 'jig rten thams cad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra wī ṇi hūṃ/ dri byug cing*/ gang gi sangs rgyas zhing kun dang*/ /'jig rten pa yi khams kun tu/ / bla med bsam mi khyab pa'i dri/ /rang gi lus las spro bar bya/ /ghan+dhe/ ro bcud phul la/ gang gi sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ /srog chags gyur pa thams cad la/ / lha rdzas dpe med ro yi mchog /sprul nas su ni sbyin par bya/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra rā se hūṃ/ gos zung phul la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun dang yang*/

/byang chub sems dpa' sogs kun la/ /yang dag sbyor ba reg bya'i bde/ /nges par sbyar bar bya ba yin/ /spar+she zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa lha mo ni/ sngags rgya snga ma bzhin la/ rgyal ba rnams kyi 'dod 'byung lha mo'i tshul/ /gzugs mdzes dkar mo me long pad+ma'i snod/ /cang te'i sgra 'khrol kha ṭ+wāṃ la brten ma/ /nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ / 'og ma la rkang pa gnyis pa go brje/ gzhan 'dra ste/ dbyangs snyan sngon mo'i pi waṃ pad+ma'i snod/ / ces dang*/ dri ldan ser mo spos khang pad+ma'i snod/ / ces dang*/ bcud ldan dmar mo bza' btung pad+ma'i snod/ / ces dang*/ bde ldan ljang khu ras bzang pad+ma'i snod/ / ces bya'o/ / sna tshogs bsil khrol snyan pa'i sgra ldan ma/ /nam mkha' gang ba sogs 'don pa bsgyur ro/ / rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod la mngon dga' ba'i/ /gzugs kyi lha mo mdzes pa'i me long g.yob/ / rnam kun gzugs kyi ngo mtshar dang 'dres pa/ /phyogs dus kun 'byung mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /oṃ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pu dzi te aḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du rkang pa thogs mtha' gnyis 'dra ba la/ sgra yi lha mo snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs bskul/ /rnam kun sgra yi sogs dang*/ shap+ta/ dri yi lha mo bde spel dri bzang spro/ /rnam kun dri ya = gan+dhe/ ro yi lha mo ro bda' zhal zas stob/ /rnam kun ro yi ra sa/ reg gi lha mo reg 'jam gos bzang stob/ /rnam kun reg gi = spar+she sogs so/ /yang na 'dod yon lnga'i tshigs bcad spyi 'gro rnams sbyar ro/ /bla med kyi cho ga dang 'brel na de ltar bya la/ gzhan du/ pad+ma'i snod ces par/ nor bu'i snod ces dang*/ gzhan yang sgeg sogs lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa ni/ rnam mang nyams brgya'i 'gyur ba dang 'dres pa'i/ /rdo rje lha mo 'gying sgeg dkar ba'i bzhin/ /zag med bde ba'i snyems pa rang 'chang ma/ /mkha' mnyam rig ma'i bde bas mnyes gyur cig

/oṃ āḥbadz+ra lā s+ya hūṃ/ sna tshogs rin chen 'phreng bas lag sbrel ba'i/ /rdo rje lha mo gser mdog mig bsgyur zhing*/ /rab mdzes 'dzum zhal kun dgar rab spel ma/ /mkha' mnyam rig ma'i bde bas mnyes gyur cig /ma l+ye/ drug ldan rdo rje'i dbyangs snyan glur len pa'i/ /rdo rje lha mo chags ldan lta na sdug /gzhom med nā da'i sgra snyan rab bskul ma/ /mkha' mnyam rig ma'i bde bas mnyes gyur cig /gī tī/ lang tsho rab brtas sgyu 'phrul gar bsgyur ba'i/ /rdo rje lha mo mar gad rdul 'dzin zhing*/ /kun rtog 'pho ba'i sgyu thabs rab bcil ma/ /mkha' mnyam= nā+-i t+ya/ lha rdzas me tog char mang rab 'babs pa'i/ /rdo rje lha mo rab dkar zla bzhin can/ /rnam mang mchod pa'i rgyan du rab spel ba/ /mkha' mnyam= puṣ+pe/ bdug pa'i sprin phung mkha' dbyings kun 'gebs pa'i/ /rdo rje lha mo mdzes sdug du ba'i mdog /rnam dag tshul khrims dri bsung rab rgyas ma/ /mkha' mnyam= dhu pe/ gzhon tshul chos dbyings snang byed 'od 'bar ba'i/

/rdo rje lha mo pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /mun sel sngags kyi de nyid rab gsal ma/ /mkha' mnyam= ā lo ke /lang tshos rab dregs rnyog bral dris sgeg pa'i/ /rdo rje lha mo mtshar sdug dpyid kyi mdangs/ /ma lus srid pa'i gdung sel bde ster ma/ mkha' mnyam= gan+dhe/ zhes pa glu'i sbyor ba dang bcas pas bya'o/ /dpal bde mchog sogs rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'am/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha de gsang sngags nang gi lha yin na/ rig ma bcu drug sbas don dang sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad 'dis mchod par bya ste/ de yang 'di ltar/ mthon mthing lang tshos dregs pa'i yid 'phrog ma/ /rdo rje rgyud mang bsgreng ba'i rol rtsed kyis/ /sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho bskul ba la brtson ma/ /rdo rje rig ma'i bde bas dgyes par mdzod/ / ces dang*/ phyag rgya so sor 'cha' zhing*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra wī ṇi hūṃ/ gser mdog zur mig 'dod pa'i mda' 'phen ma/ /rdo rje gling bu bsgyur ba'i snyan 'gyur sgra/ / gzhom med nā da'i dbyangs dang rab 'dres ma/ /rdo rje= wang+se traṃ/ rab dmar chags pas myos pa'i lus phra ma/ /rdo rje rdza rnga brdung ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ / mda' can drag po'i snying gi myos sel ma/ /rdo rje= mri taṃ ge hrīḥ mar gad rdul gyis byugs pa'i mig yangs ma/ /rdo rje rnga chen sgrogs pa'i sgra brgya pas/ /gsang chen dhu ti'i rang sgra 'bod mkhas ma/ /rdo rje= murdzi a/ in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs ldan bde sbyin mo/ /rdo rje dril bus sgeg pa'i snyems pa yi/ /mchog dga'i ngo mtshar ston pas rab 'gying ma/ /rdo rje= lā s+ya hūṃ/ bim pa ltar dmar kun tu bzhad pa mo/ /ku mud 'dzum zhal kun dga'i zla snang can/ /rdo rje chags pas rab rgod bag yangs ma/ /rdo rje= ha s+ya traṃ/ li khri'i rdul chags 'dod pa'i dbyangs mkhan ma/ /mi zad rdo rje'i tshig 'byin drug ldan glu/ /'phrog byed dga' ma'i dbyangs la rab 'jug ma/

/rdo rje= gī ti hrīḥ sngo ljang 'khri zhing gzhon nu'i lus can ma/ /gnyen lcug 'khril ldem rdo rje gar gyi ros/ /'pho ba'i sgyu rtsal kun tu rab 'gog ma/ /rdo rje= nri t+ya āḥ kha ba dung ltar rab dkar zla bzhin ma/ /zhing kun gang ba'i me tog gsar pa'i char/ /rang byung si h+la'i dri bzang dang 'grogs ma/ /rdo rje= puṣ+pe hūṃ/ dud sprin ltar 'gro a gar dris sgos ma/ /rdo rje bdug pa'i sprin tshogs stug po'i rgyun/ /kun rtog nags tshal bsregs pa las 'byin ma/ /rdo rje= dhū pe traṃ/ gur gum gzhon nu'i lus can 'od 'bar ma/ /nyi zla'i rna cha g.yo ldan rin chen sgron/ /sngags kyi de nyid gsal ba las 'char ma// rdo rje= ā lo ke hrīḥ 'char ka'i zla ba'i mdog can dris sgeg ma/ /rdo rje ga bur tsan dan sbyar ba'i chus/ /lus kun khyab pa'i bsil bde yongs spel ma/ /rdo rje= gan+dhe āḥ kun+da'i phung po ltar dkar gzugs mdzes ma/ /rab gsal gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i me long g.yob/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i mig gi bdud rtsi ma/ /rdo rje= rū pa badz+ri ṇi hūṃ/ thun mtshams 'od dmar 'char ba'i myos ldan ma// rnam pa kun ldan ro brgya sbyar ba'i g.yos/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i nyams brgya legs ston ma/ /rdo rje= rā sa badz+ri ṇi traṃ/ glog phran ltar g.yo dūrba'i mdog can ma/ /lha rdzas na bzas rig pa'i bde stob cing*/ /ci dgar 'khyud pa'i reg gnyen bde mchog ma/ /rdo rje= spar+sha badz+ri ṇi hrīḥ ku mud rgyas 'dra sgyu rtsal rtser son ma/ /chos dbyings bde ba'i 'byung gnas phyag rgya ches/ /mi 'gyur 'bras bu'i gnas la rgyas 'debs ma/ /rdo rje'i rig ma'i bde bas dgyes par mdzod// dharmā dhā tu badz+ri ṇi āḥ bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud kyi cho ga sogs la brten pa yin na/ mchod lha bcu drug gi tshigs bcad byed pa la/ sbas don dang ma sbyar ba'i tshig gzhan gyis bya'o/

/de yang mchod yul gyi lha la thob mi thob dang 'os mi 'os ma yin gyi 'on kyang lugs de dang de'i cho ga dang 'brel mi 'brel gyi khyad par gyis yin no/ /'di ni gtor ma dang*/ dam tshig gi rdzas la sogs pa thams cad la go bar bya'o/ /de nas rgyal srid sna bdun gyi mchod pa byed na/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen/ sogs dang*/ lha rdzas las grub lte ba shin tu zlum/ / sogs spyi khyab tu grags pa rnams kyis mchod/ shin tu spros pa la dga' na 'di skad ces bya ste/ dri med 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser bzang las/ /bsod nams bzo bos mchog tu rnam sprul ba/ /lha mi'i mdzes pa kun las phul byung zhing*/ /lta bas mi ngoms rdzu 'phrul shugs nyid las/ /rang byung rtsibs stong ta la bdun srid du/ /byung tshe phyogs las rgyal ba mchog thob pa/ /rin chen 'khor lo dam pa 'di phul bas// rgyal byed dran pa'i 'khor lo thob par shog /chu zhing phun tshogs thal dkar zla 'od can/ /mche ba drug ldan dul bas spyod pas mdzes/ /sngon chad legs par byas pa'i mthu nyid las/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis mkha' la rab 'gro zhing*/ / mkha' lding sa srungs bu ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /sa chen rgya mtsho 'khor bcas kun tu bskor/ /glang po rin chen phul bas mtshan ma rnams/ /'joms byed shes rab glang po thob par shog /rab mdzes rma bya'i mgrin 'dra'i spu stug can/ / yid bzhin nor bu lta bur 'dod pa yi/ /don kun rdzogs par sgrub byed nam mkha'i lam/ /gus par spyod pa gser gyi rgyal mtshan can/ /cang shes rlung las rgyal ba sprin gyis shugs/ /yid ltar mgyogs pa'i rta mchog 'di phul bas/ / ma lus chos la mngon shes bgrod pa can/ /brtson 'grus bzhon pa mchog gis 'gro bar shog /kun tu mdog bzang mtshungs med baiḍūr+ya/ legs par sbyangs pa'i rin chen cha brgyad pa/ /byed po med cing phun tshogs 'od zer gyis/

/me dang nyi ma'i 'od kyang rnam par gnon/ /dga' mgur 'gro zhing dgos pa mchog ster la/ /'khaur kun khyab pa'i 'od zer mtha' yas can/ /bsam pa rdzogs byed nor bu 'di phul pas/ /chos kyi snang ba'i dga' bas tshims par shog / dga' tshal lha yi bu mo'i gzugs mdzes can/ /'dul ba'i cho ga phun tshogs bstan bcos dang*/ /bzo dang snyan dngags sgyu rtsal kun shes shing*/ /'dzum zhing snyan par smra mkhas mtshungs pa'i gzugs/ /reg pa mchog ldan lus sems bde ba'i rgyu/ /ha cang che chung min pa dri bzang gter/ /phul bas sgrib pa kun las rnam thar ba'i/ /shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde bas 'tsho bar shog /lag na rdo rje sred med bu yi stobs/ /'jam zhing yid 'ong snyan pa'i tshig kyang 'byin/ / mdzangs shing gsal la yid gzhung lha mig ldan/ khor yug gter gyi bdag po'i don kun byed/ /byams dang snying rje mang ba dge ba'i bdag /'dod dgur 'dzud pa'i mi mchog 'di phul bas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i phun tshogs don/ /kun 'byor ting 'dzin mchog la dbang thob shog /dpa' zhing brtul phod yan lag mchog gi gzugs/ /pha rol dpung 'joms mi mthun med byed pa/ /sngar ldang bsam pa dge zhing lta bas go /ma smad rgyas shing rdzogs pa'i legs byas can/ /'dod dgur 'gro ba'i blon po rin chen 'di/ /phul bas ji bzhin ji snyed chos rnams la/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes dam pa yi/ / rtsol med gnas pa'i btang snyoms thob par shog / 'di la pu ru ṣa rat+na zer dgos/ nye ba'i rgyal srid 'bul ba ni/ ral gri nye ba'i rin po che/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams la 'bul/ /bla med byang chub mchog gi chos/ /ye shes ral gri thob par shogakhaḍ+ga u pa rat+na = khang khyim nye ba'i rin po che/ /rgyal ba= bla med= chos dbyings khang bzang thob par shog /gṛ ha u pa rat+na = pags pa nye ba'i= rgyal ba= bla med= dga' bde'i gding pa thob par shog twa ka u pa rat+na/

skyed tshal nye ba'i= rgyal ba= bla med= rnam 'phrul tshal du spyod par shog bā ṭi ka u pa rat+na/ gzims cha nye ba'i= rgyal ba= bla med= bsam gtan bde ba'i yal thob shog/ par+yaṃ ga u pa rat+na/ gos bzang nye ba'i= rgyal ba= bla med= rgyal sras khrel yod gos thob shog /bas+t+ra u pa rat+na/ 'chil lham nye ba'i= rgyal ba= bla med= thar lam bde la spyod par shog /mo tsa u pa rat+na = bsdu na/ ral gri khang pa pags pa skyed mos tshal/ /mal cha gos dang 'chil lham rin po che/ /nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun mtha' yas pas/ /rab tu gnas bya'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ / sap+ta u pa rat+na/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal tshe/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams dang rab gnas lha tshogs la/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ /maṅga la aṣ+ta ang ka / rgyas par na/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ / sogs bya'o/ /bstod pa'i khyad par yang rgyud sde lnga las gsungs pa'i bstod pa rnams dang*/ yongs su grags pa'i bstod pa rnams kyis bstod par bya'o/ kha skongs bdun pa'o/ / gsol gdab brtan bzhugs song ba'i/ rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i bstod pa de'i rjes su/ /shis brjod rmad du byung ba 'di bya ste/ de yang 'di skad ces/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+mo rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// bkra shis des ni skye dgu zhi byed dang po'o/ /de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/

/'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /sems can kun la phan phyir byang chub mnga' ba po/ /don rnams thams cad grub par brtul ba yongs ldan pa/ /tshogs kyi legs skyes thub pa'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ldan lha'i/ /gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /dbang bcas lhas bskor ba yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis= lo ma me tog 'od 'bar nyams dga' lum+bu'i tshal/ /lha mang dag gis bsten par mgon po bltams pa na/ /srid pa mthar phyin pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis= grong khyer ser skya'i gnas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du//lhum nas bltams pa ston pa bde gshegs zas gtsang sras/ /myur bskrun bdud rtsi'i chus gtor ba yi bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis= grong khyer dam pa ser skya'i gnas zhes bya bar ni/ /rmad du grags pa chen po lha yis mngon bstod pa/ / bsam las bde sgrubs bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis= dgyes shing nam phyed grong khyer nas ni mngon byung ste/ /dka' thub tshul du mngon par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis= rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i sku mnga' zhing*/ /bai ḍūr+ya ltar sngo ba'i rtsa bting steng bzhugs te/ /skyil mo krung bcas mi g.yo mchog gi bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis= chu bo'i 'gram na tsarka'i 'phreng bas yongs bskor ba/ /shin tu rmad du byung ba'i srid pa sel mdzad pa/ /klu yi rgyal pos phyag byas pa yi bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis= shing rgyal drung gshegs byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud kyi phyogs/ /mang po brtul tshe sa steng dang ni nam mkha' la/ /bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs gang byung ba/ /bkra shis= sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig phyir rdo rje gdan bzhugs te/

/nam gyi tho rangs bdun bzhi po dag rnams btul ba/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis= grong khyer wā rā ṇā sir drang srong mchog bzhugs nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mchog bstan pa yi bkra shis gang*/ /lha yul deng 'dir shin tu rmad du byung gyur pa/ /bkra shis= bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa dag byed pa/ /bsod nams dag byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa seng ges gang gsungs pa/ /bkra shis= mu stegs byed pa kun gyi nga rgyal gzhom pa dang*/ /'gro la bde ba skyed phyir cho 'phrul dam pa dag /nye bar ston pa rgyal po'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis= 'gro la phan phyir mtho ris gnas nas 'dir gshegs te/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha tshogs lag na rnga yab gdugs/ /sna tshogs thogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis= de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i mchog tu nyer gshegs pa/ /man da ra yi me tog mang pos mngon mchod pa/ /lha mchog rnams kyis mngon bstod pa yi bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la= lha dbang klu dang mi yi dbang pos phyag byas pa/ /mkha' lding gnod sbyin dri za'i dbang pos mchod gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs bcu ldan pa'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog kha skongs brgyad pa'o/ / rjes kyi skabs yon bdag bsgo ba dgos na/ de'i shis brjod kyi skabs su/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phul ba sogs/ /tshig lhug pa'i shis brjod de yang rdzas brgyad thams cad la sbyar bas rgyas par 'gyur la/ de nas kun gyi mthar rjes bsdu ba grub pa'i skabs sam/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg byed na de'i mthar yang rung ste/ stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa'i mdo las 'byung ba'i/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rmad du byung bas shis brjod bya ste/

'jig rten 'di'am gzhan dang mtho ris na/ /rin chen rmad byung rgya chen mchog yod pa/ /des ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen la/ /cis kyang grangs dang bgrangs dang char mi phod/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /zhi 'gog bdud rtsi shin tu gya nom gang*/ /shākya thub pas mnyam bzhag thugs chud pa/ /chos de dang ni mtshungs pa yod min te/ /de mngon byas na phyin chad mya ngan med/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung = dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa'i 'dis ni= rgyal bas gang dag gang zag brgyad gsungs pa/ /de dag rnams ni skyes bu zung bzhi ste/ /sbyin gnas de dag sa steng shin tu dkon/ /de dag rnams la byin na dpag med 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig= ji ltar nga'i= /bden pa 'dis= dam pa gtso bo mchog sbyin gya nom pa/ /'od mchog dpa' bo dam pa mchog gi gnas// shes rab dam pa mchog ni dam pa mchog /mchog min mchog mkhyen 'di ni bcom ldan gcig /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad= rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen=
