ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni= ting 'dzin dam pa bar chad med pa gang*/ / mtha' yas blo ldan de bzhin gshegs gsungs pa/ /ting 'dzin de brtan rdo rje dper byas pa/ /ting 'dzin de dang mtshungs pa'i ting 'dzin med/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad= ting nge 'dzin gyi rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni= ji ltar sgo gtan dam zhing rab dam ste/ /stobs chen rlung bzhi dag gis mi bskyod pa/ /de ltar mkhas pa bden bzhi mthong gnas pa/ /'jig rten smra ba rnams kyis 'dir mi g.yo/ /ngo mtshar shin tu= dge 'dun rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni= thams cad zil gnon kun mkhyen thams cad gzigs/ / thams cad mkhyen pa stobs rnams kun dang ldan/ /kun gyi dam pa 'dzin pa kun dang bral/ /bsam pa kun mkhyen 'di ni bcom ldan gcig/ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni= srid pa 'gog cing mi g.yo 'gyur ba med/ /skyon med 'jigs pa kun las rnam par grol/ /shin tu 'gag cing gya nom nges par 'byung*/ /shin tu dri med zhi ba blos mi 'phrog /ngo mtshar shin tu= dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni= shin tu sdug bsngal ston zhing bde sbyin pa'i/ /bden rnams mthong ste gang dag bag yod pa/ /bden pa rin chen rnams la dogs bral ba/ /de dag skye ba brgyad pa phyis mi len/ /ngo mtshar shin tu= dge 'dun rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni= dam pa rnams kyis dam pa don dam mkhyen/ /mchog dang mchog min mkhyen zhing don dam brtson/ /gzhan gyis mi 'phrog dam pa thugs chud rtogs/ /shin tu sdug bsngal can gyi dpung gnyen mchog /ngo mtshar shin tu = rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen = ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis na= 'dun pa skyed nas rnal 'byor ldan gyur zhing*/ /go tam bstan la rtag brtson rab grol zhing*/

/gzhan gyis mi bkri ba dag zhing der reg /'di la de reg grangs su phyin mi 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin tu= dam chos rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni= bden pa mthong bas brjed pa rgya lam na/ /gal te sdig pa 'ga' zhig byas gyur kyang*/ /de ni de 'chab pa yi 'os min te/ /chos nyid 'di ni mo g.yo gnas phyir ro/ /ngo mtshar shin tu= dge 'dun rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni= lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad na/ /sangs rgyas dang ni lhag pa'i mtshungs pa med/ / lha dang mi yi ston pa bla na med/ /ston pa ded dpon smon pa rnams kyi mchog /ngo mtshar shin tu= rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni= sa ga'i zla ba dang por thub pa yis/ /nags khrod chos kyi dam par rab brnyes pa/ / chos de dang ni mtshungs pa'i lhag pa med/ /'di la de reg grangs su phyin mi 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin tu= dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni= sdig pa rnying zad gsar du byas med la/ /rims nad med pas 'jigs med mya ngan bral/ /rtsa ba 'gags pas srid pa mi bskyed pa/ /bstan pa mar me bzhin du 'bar bar shog /ngo mtshar shin tu = dge 'dun rin chen= ji ltar nga'i= bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog / ces pa'o/ /mchod 'phreng tshigs bcad kyi rigs dang*/ bkra shis kyi rigs rnams gang dang gang du dgos pa de dang der sbyar bas chog pa'i phyir/ gcig tu nges pa med mod/ 'on kyang mi mkhas pas lhongs su gyur rdzu byas na skabs su ma babs pa'i 'don pa yod pas de 'dra 'gog pa'i phyir dang*/ 'tsham zhing 'os pa la the tshom mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ /'dir nges can gyi tshul du bris so/ /de yang cho ga 'di dang 'brel ba'i rab gnas byed par 'dod pas/ gnas skabs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chung ngu'i go 'phang zhig ma mtha' yang thob par bya/ de nas rab gnas kyi cho ga gzhung dang kha skong 'di gnyis ka blo la shin tu byang bar bzung*/

lag len dang go ba la mkhas par bya'o/ /'gro phan rgyas byed nyid rgyud gzhung gi dgongs pa tshang la ma nor ba rgyas pa'i lugs yin pas/ byin rlabs che zhing*/ rgyun gyi lag len du de kas chog la/ spros pa la dga' ba'i ngor shin tu rgyas pa yang res 'ga' nges par dgos kyin 'dug pas/ dpe 'dzin phran tsheg tsam la yang rtsegs pa'i glang chung gi snyoms las ma byed cig /shin tu rgyas pa la kha skong 'di yongs rdzogs bya/ cung zad rgyas pa tsam byed na ji ltar 'tsham pa byas pas chog gi thams cad nag 'ded rang mi dgos/ dper na yangs pa'i grong khyer gyi shis brjod dang*/ rjes dran dang sems bskyed tsam kha bskangs bas kyang legs por 'ong ngo*/ /'gro phan rgyas byed du bshad pa de dag cung zad kyang ma chad par bya ste/ cho ga rgyas pa nyid kyi lugs byed pa'i dbang du byas pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /cho ga rnam pa du ma la/ /dgos pa'i ngag 'don mtha' yas las/ /'brel med smyon gtam la sogs spangs/ /bzang po 'ba' zhig sdebs pa yin// //zhes pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bar skabs su brjod pa'o/ /gcig zhus/ maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /sāts+tsha dang khang bu brtsegs pa sogs la rab gnas mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ sāts+tsha dang khang bu brtsegs pa sogs la rab gnas mdor bsdus su byed na/ yo byad rnams tshogs par byas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'am/ bsdus pa dpa' bo gcig pa'i bar gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ mdun bskyed ras bris la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na/ so so'i lugs kyi dngos gzhi dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang mchod pa yan chad bya/ nang gtor dang bdag 'jug mtha' gcig tu dgos pa'ang ma yin pas/ long skabs dang bstun/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang ma 'brel bar/ maṇ+ḍal tsam la brten nas bsgrubs kyang shin tu go chod/

de'i dbang ltar byas na/ maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyi rol tu yangs shing rgya che ba'i zhing khams dam pas yongs su bskor zhing bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa khang bzang dam pa'i nang du/ bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi gdan bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can ma 'am/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin sogs ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ a mṛ ta 'i sngags lta bus bsangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad 'di zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod dkyil 'khor gang yin pa de'i sngags brgya tsam bzlas/ slar yang mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma sogs/ tshigs bcad 'os pa'i mchod pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor dgos kyi bstod pa dang*/ de nyid lnga pa sogs ji ltar 'os pas bstod/ sā tsa'i skabs yin la sngar sā tsa ma btab na skabs 'dir 'jim pa byin rlabs kyi skor rnams bya ba yin kyang*/ phal cher skabs 'dir byed pa nyung ngo*/ /rab gnas dngos ni/ thog mar bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ sdig sgrib sbyang ba nges par bya zhing*/ spro na byur bsal ba yang byed/ sngar dkyil 'khor so so'i lugs kyi bum pa sgrubs yod na/ las bum gyis khrus gsol bya zhing*/ gal te bum pa ma sgrubs rung*/ dri bzang gi chus gang ba'i bum pa la a bhi ṣe ka ta 'i sngags nyer gcig tsam bzlas nas/ phyin drug gi tshigs bcad sogs khrus gsol cha tshang bar bya/ spro na/ gang la ser sna sogs byon legs kyi tshigs bcad dam/ grwa lnga nas 'byung ba'i dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis chen mo gang rung gi sgo nas khrus gsol bya/

rten rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten yangs shing rgya che bar gyur pa'i bum pa'i nang du/ /oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ shar du mi bskyod pa sngon po/ g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhug shing*/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ seng ge glang po/ rta mchog rma bya/ mkha' lding gi khri rnams la rim par bzhugs pa'o/ / rten gzhan rnams rdo rje sems dpar bskyed de spyi dang 'dra/ de rjes brtan bzhugs kyi bar rab gnas dkyus bzhin byed pa'am/ dbang bskur gyi skabs rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa bya ste/ bstod pa'i skabs su tshigs bcad bzhi pa'i bstod pa dang*/ spro na mchod rten gyis bstod pa gzhan yang 'don/ skabs 'dir cha gsum mam/ phyi rol gtor ma'am/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs btang*/ de rjes shis brjod rgyas par bya'o/ /'jim pa byin rlabs logs su byed na/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ mngon rtogs bsdus pa bzlas pa dang bcas pa zhig bya/ de nas 'jim pa/ sku phor/ 'bru mar/ nang bzhugs/ brdar bu/ tho ba sogs yo byad rnams phyogs gcig tu 'dzoms par/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ āḥbh+ruṃ hūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi phung po nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/

rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol/ mchod pa'i tshigs bcad sogs ji ltar 'os pa sbyar/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga ma sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis 'jim pa byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi yig 'bru dang bcas pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung 'jim pa la thim par gyur/ rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya bsnol ba 'jim pa'i steng du bzhag ste gzungs nyi shu rtsa gcig 'don/ sngags gzhan rnams kyang gsum gsum mam bdun bdun tsam bzla/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha la/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs gsol smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /'di 'jim pa'i tshogs chen po la gal che dang*/ spros pa la dga' ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ bsdu na dngos gzhi'i skabs kyi sngags dang phyag rgya kho na'i byin rlabs kyis chog go /man thang dang*/ rdo lha thor bu dang*/ rigs gsum mgon po'i mchod rten sogs la'ang*/ rab gnas dngos gzhi gong dang 'dra/ rigs gsum mchod rten la so so'i sngags kyi byin rlabs re brtan bzhugs kyi rjes la byed par snang*/ rigs gsum gyi sku brnyan yod na rigs gsum rang du bskyed pa legs so/ /zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /dge'o/ /zhus dag / ༄༅/ /'chi med 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / oṃ na maḥ.ār+ya tā re ye/ rnam bkra'i ye shes 'od brgya yi/ /dra ba 'gyed las gdung sel zhing*/ /kai la sha yi dpal mnga' ba'i/ /'phags ma'i sku la mgos phyag 'tshal/

/ye shes rgya mtsho 'gro la yid bzhin gyi/ /'chi med nor bu'i dga' ston sbyin mdzad pa/ /gang de'i zhabs sen zla ris bdag cag gi /ral ba'i khri la nam yang bsti bar gyur/ /'phags pa de'i bzhed srol las byung ba'i/ /'chi med ār+ya tā re sgrub par 'dod pas/ bsti gnas mchog tu/ kha shar du phyogs lus bsrangs te/ rdo rje snying gar bzung nas/ oṃ a na d+ya dī tsit+ta badz+ra satwā haṃ/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ro da ke hūṃ/ dung phor du chu blug oṃ tap+te tap+te mahā tap+te swāhā/ ye shes pa dgug pa'o/ / oṃ hrī swāhā sa kha/ oṃ khaḥswāhā sa gdong*/ oṃ pañcāṃ ga hūṃ/ yan lag lnga/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā bhi sogs kyis lus kun bkru'o/ / oṃ sarba pā paṃ sa ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ khrus khu dor/ oṃ badz+ra satwa bā yu/ rlung g.yas nas dgang zhing*/ g.yon nas dbyung*/ oṃ badz+ra sā na hūṃ gis gdan/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis sgo gsum/ oṃ āḥswāhā ghaṇ+ḍaṃ/ dril bu/ oṃ hūṃ swāhā badz+raṃ/ rdo rje/ oṃ oṃ swāhā/ mu traṃ gis lus byin rlabs/ de nas rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i snying ga'i 'od kyis lus pa med pa'i skyabs yul spyan drangs/ oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta bo dhi satwai e h+ya hi/ mchod cing bstod nas/ gang gis drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ / dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ oṃ shū n+ya ta/ rdo rje gsor zhing*/ dril bu dkrol la/ hūṃ lan gsum/ rdor dril 'dzin bzhin du hūṃ ka ra'i rgyas phyogs bcings te/ oṃ in+d+ra ya badz+ra rak+ṣa hūṃ/ ag+na ya= ya ma= nai ri t+ya= ba ru ṇa= ba ya bya= yak+ṣa= i sha na= prah+ma= pṛ th+wī = zhes bsgyur/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi rgyas/ oṃ s+thā na me rak+ṣa hūṃ/ yo ga= at+ma= slar yang rdor dril 'dzin/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bskor zhing bstan la/

oṃ sarba rak+ṣa ṇaṃ badz+ra haṃ/ oṃ swa bhā ba= kun rdzob kyi snang ba rdul tsam yang mi dmigs pa gdod ma'i ring nas/ zhing khams rgya mtsho rnam par snang bar byed pa'i pad zla dri ma med pa'i steng du/ rang sems kyi ngo bo tāṃ gi nā das/ srid zhi ma lus pa'i rang bzhin gyi mi shigs pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud thams cad spyan drangs/ ro mnyam du gyur pa/ rang nyid 'phags ma kai la sha ltar dkar zhing dri ma med pa zla ba chu shel lta bu/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar trai lo kya bi dza ya mu dra 'ching ba/ 'og ma zung gis mchog sbyin dang bcas pa'i tsin+ta ma ni dang*/ ut+pal dkar po'i sdong bu dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ ston zla gang ba lta bu'i bzhin ras 'dzum zhing sdug pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing li ba me tog 'phreng bas cung zad bcings shing g.yas ngos su grol ba/ nu 'bur 'phrang zhing rgyas pa/ sgeg cing lang tsho gsar du rgyas pa'i sku 'khril bag chags shing*/ rdo rje'i gdan gyis bzhugs pa/ ka shi'i ras phran gyis stod g.yogs dang*/ dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i dar gyi shams thabs can/ sku la tshe spel ba'i nor bu du mas spras pa las byung ba'i sil khrol rna ba'i bcud len no/ /g.yas su pad zla la maṃ las ma ri ts+yai gser mdog sgeg mo/ rdo rje dang*/ a sho ka'i yal ga 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs gtso mo lta bu/ g.yon du pad nyi la hūṃ las e ka dza ṭi sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa khrag can 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyi shams thabs dang*/ glang lpags kyi stod g.yogs can/ drag mo ral pa dmar ser lan bu gcig pa g.yon du 'phyang ba/ gnyis ka'ang rol pas bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor gsum ka'ang zhing rab 'byams snang bar byed pa'o/ /

gnas gsum du rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya btugs te/ rig pa lan gsum brjod/ rigs gsum byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ gnas bzhi byin gyis brlabs nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sku la zhugs pas/ ye shes 'khor lo sad/ sa bon las 'od 'phros/ lha spyan drangs/ gsol btab dbang bskur chu rgyun dang*/ / sdig bral mi g.yo cod pan dang*/ /brtan par brjod pa rnam pa bcu/ zhes pa dbang ste/ spyi dang mthun la/ rigs bdag ni snang ba mtha' yas so/ / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ de nas rang gi lus nang du snod bcud rab 'byams snang ba la sems 'ching ba zhing gi rnal 'byor dang*/ de dag las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas lus thams cad brtan par gang bas/ nam mkha' ji srid bar rkyen gang gis mi shigs pa'i rtag brtan g.yung drung gi dpal thob par bsam pa 'chi med kyi rnal 'byor ste/ de nas rtsod bral kyi yid rtse gcig pas/ oṃ na maḥtā re na mo ha re hūṃ ha re swāhā/ zhes dza pa ci nus bya'o/ /de nas mchod cing bstod la/ yi ge brgya pa ci nus su bzlas nas/ badz+ra muḥ yis ye shes 'khor lo gdod ma la zhugs/ dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyi rig pa lan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+re badz+re ma he badz+re pra ma tha badz+re āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lha sku sna tshogs rdo rjer bsams/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la mi dmigs pa nyid kyis dmigs te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba lhag par bsngo'o/ /'gro 'di g.yung drung gnas la sngon nyid nas/ /ngang gis 'dug mod tshul de ma rtogs rnams/ /mthar byed sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul gyis ngal ba/ /gsal ba'i thabs 'di yi ger gyis shig ces/ /de skad sa skyong bka' yi chu khur gyis/ /kun dga' snying po'i blo gros dbyar skyes sprin/ /rnam par lci las 'chi med bdud rtsi'i char/ /'gro la zhing pa'i bsod nams bzhin du babs/ /'dir gtor ma dang zas kyi rnal 'byor/

nyal ba dang thun mtshams kyi spyod pa rnams ni bya ba khyad par can spyi las 'byung ba ltar yin la/ gdams pa'i gnad rnams ni rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud sde las rtogs par bya dgos pas/ don la ston pa'i sngags pa dag gis nan tan bgyi ba'i 'os so/ /zhes pa 'di ni mkhyen yangs mi'i dbang pos bka' yis bskul ba las/ shākya'i dge tshul kun dga' snying pos g.yar khral du 'tshal ba'o// // shu bha ma stu/ ༈ bstod pa ni/ oṃ nam mkha' dang mnyam mnyam nyid ro mnyam sku mnga' ba/ /dngos rnams 'gro yang nam mkha' rtag tu 'gro med bzhin/ /'jig dang zhig med 'ong ba med phyir ngo mtshar ci/ /ya mtshan sku mnga' 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal/ /srid dang srid pa rtag tu med par gzigs mod kyang*/ /snying rje las byung smon lam dbang gis 'gro la rtag rjes gzigs/ /rnam par 'phrul pa rtag tu 'chad pa med mnga' bas/ khams gsum kun la bde ba chen po sbyin phyag 'tshal/ khyod kyi 'od 'phreng thun mtshams babs pa'i 'od dmar bzhin/ / yid 'phrog lha dbang gis btud gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od/ /'dre la rnams 'dud dzā ḍa de yang 'gro kun gyis/ /nyin dang mtshan la lan brgyar phyag bya'i 'os su 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / ༄༅ / /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rnam par 'byed pa gsang ba'i sgron ma bzhugs so/ / oṃ sid+dha rastu/ saṅgu ru shrī man badz+rā tsār+ya tsa rā ṇa ka ma la na mastu te/ gang zhig gsung dang sku la pha mtha' mkha' ltar las/ /mkha' dbyings rab mnyam thugs ni ye shes gcig pu ste/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin nyid na'ang brtan dang g.yo kun la/ /go skabs sbyin mdzad 'phags ma 'jig rten yum la 'dud/ /srid pa'i 'brog dgon chen por dub gyur gang*/ /rnam par bcas dang mtshan med ting 'dzin gyi/ /de nyid rnam bzhi'i them skas la 'dzegs na/ /bla med byang chub khang bzang cis mi bgrod/ /de lta bas na thar pa gnyer gang la/

/ci nas lam bzang dga' ston byos shig ces/ /de skad sa skyong bka' yi khur blangs te/ /rmongs pa bdag kyang cung zad spobs par 'dod/ /de la skal ba dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig 'bras bu'i theg pa las brtsams te bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bgrod pa'i lam ni 'di yang ste/ de la 'di bya ba'i rgyud rigs drug las pad+ma'i rigs su gtogs pa yin la/ de yang rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon yid bzhin nor bu sbyin pa'i zhabs kyis rnam par bkral ba'i lugs 'di la/ skyes bu phyi rol la mngon par dga' ba la bya rgyud khyad par can kho na'i lugs dang*/ nang rnal 'byor la mngon par dga' ba la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud go mtshungs kyi lugs gnyis las/ skabs kyi don phyi ma yin yang*/ re shig dang po brjod par bya ste/ lam 'di yi tshul la bslab pa'i don du'o/ /de yang spyir bya ba'i rgyud las ji ltar 'byung tshul mdor bsdus na/ 'jug pa'i dang*/ sbyor ba'i dang*/ sgrub pa'i dang*/ /grub pa'i spyod pa bzhi'i/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gang rung du dbang bskur ba thob pa'am/ gnas 'di tsam la ni 'das pa'i pra sen sogs kyis sngon gsang sngags spyad par shes te/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i cho ga las 'byung ba la sogs pas sdig pa byang ba'i mtshan ma mthong nas byin gyis brlabs pa dag kyang rung ste/ ji ltar legs par grub pas zhus pa'i rgyud las/ dngos grub myur du thob gyur pa/ /sngags bzlas pa yi 'dul ba bshad/ /sgrub pa gsang sngags thams cad dang*/ /lha rnams dag ni thams cad dang*/ /zlos pa bdag nyid chen po la/ /mkhas pas zhe sdang mi bya'o/ /zhes pa nas/ gsang sngags gzhan du spyad mi bya/ /'gran pa dang ni sad phyir spangs/ zhes pa'i bar ltung ba sum cu spang bar gsungs pa sogs brtul zhugs rnams blang ba ste/ mdor na gang zag sgrub pa dang mi sgrub pa gnyis ka'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs dang dbang blang ba yin no/

/gnyis pa sbyor ba'i spyod pa la/ bdag dang*/ lha dang*/ sngags dang*/ bsam gtan gyi de nyid bzhi'i dang po ni bdag ste/ rang gi sems rang bzhin 'od gsal rang rig pa/ stong pa rnam pa thams cad pa'o/ /gnyis pa lha drug po rnams dang*/ gsum pa ni sngags kyi bsam gtan te bzlas brjod kyi de nyid ces kyang bya la/ bzhi pa ni mtshan med kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams te/ de rnams kyang bsdu na/ lha drug ting nge 'dzin rnam bcas dang*/ don dam ting nge 'dzin gnyis su med pa la sbyor ba dang gnyis su 'du ba las/ de'i don cung zad bshad na/ dang po ni/ dgos pa'i yan lag dang bcas pa dpung bzang las dngos grub thob phyir ni rnam pa bcu gsungs te/ sngags pa dang ni rang sngags g.yog dang rdzas/ /brtson 'grus phyogs dang sa gzhi dus dang ni/ /yan lag rdzogs pa'i lha dang sems stobs so/ /gzhan dag kha cig rig 'dzin grogs zhes zer/ /gzhan dag phyogs dang brtson 'grus dus rnams nyid/ /gzhan ni rdzas dang sa gzhi lha dang sngags/ kha cig sems stobs yin zhes rnam par smra/ /sgrub phyir de dag bcu dang brgyad dang lnga/ /de bzhin bzhi dang gsum dang gcig nyid ces/ /sngags rig rang rang blo yis rnam par 'chad/ /sangs rgyas rgyud la cho ga gnyis kyis 'grub/ /sgrub po gang zhig rang gi yon tan rdzogs/ /brtson 'grus mchog dang yang dag ldan pa dang*/ /gzhan gyi rnyed pa la yang phrag dog med/ /'dod la ma chags las kyi nyon mongs bzod/ /gug skyed klad kor tshang ba zur phyin la/ /gsang sngags dag cing shin tu cho gar bcas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' bsten pa yis/ /gnas su gnas na yid 'ong dngos grub thob/ /sngags pa sgrub po/ rang sngags lha/ sgrub grogs g.yog /ldong ros sogs rdzas/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus/ gan+dha ra dang yul dbus sogs phyogs/ ri rtse sogs sa gzhi/ dpyid zla dang*/ snga dro sogs dus/ bris sku sogs yan lag rdzogs pa'i lha/

brtul phod pa'i sems stobs te bcu dang*/ phyi ma gnyis ma gtogs brgyad/ sngags pa/ grogs/ phyogs/ brtson 'grus/ dus te lnga/ snga ma gnyis bor ba gsum/ rdzas/ sa gzhi/ lha/ sngags te bzhi/ sems stobs gcig nyid de/ de rnams 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams kyi gtso phal ma phyed par dngos grub sgrub pa'i yun ring por 'gyur la/ gang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byon nas bstan pa la ni sgrub pa po mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang*/ gsang sngags dag cing cho ga ma nyams pa gnyis gtso bor bzung*/ gzhan rnams phal pa'i tshul du gsungs/ dang po go sla la/ zur phyin pa sogs sngags dang*/ cho ga ma nyams pa lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ sngags kyi bsam gtan gyi cho ga gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ji skad du/ dang po khrus byas rnal 'byor pas/ /rdo rje'i gdan la 'dug nas ni/ /mchod dang gsol ba lha drug bsgom/ /stong dang yi ge sgra gzugs dang*/ /phyag rgya mtshan ma drug tu 'dod/ /de yang*/ thog mar gtsang sbra khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ dpung bzang las/ lus la sa yi dril phyis byas nas su/ /chu chen rnyog pa med par zhugs nas kyang*/ /ji tsam 'dod pa'i bar du khrus byas te/ / : byung £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· byang £© nas shar ram byang du kha bltas te/ /chu yis lag pa rkang pa bkrus nas ni/ /pus mo phyi rol du ni bstan byas te/ /bar du lag bzhag tsog tsog por 'dug ste/ /sgra med dbu ba med par nye reg bya/ /nye reg gi dmigs bsal ni/ so la chags pa lce yis reg pa dang*/ /sbrid pa byung nas kha yang bkru bar bya/ / rab byung skyes pa bud med gzhon nu dang*/ /gzhon nu ma dang bram ze rgan mo dang*/ /de la sngags pas nam yang reg mi bya/ /sngags pas de dag rnams la mi bsam mo/ /sgrub pos de dag rnams la reg gyur tam/ /rgya la de dag rnams kyis reg gyur na/ /slar yang khrus byas mthor 'thung byas nas su/ /de nas phyir yang bzlas la 'jug par bya/

/zhes dang*/ sa phud bshang sgor lnga ste mtshan la gsum/ /g.yas g.yon gsum ste lag pa gnyis la bdun/ /yang na chu dang sa yis ji srid du/ /dri ma bral ba de srid bar du bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje'i gdan ni bdag dang gnas bsrung ba dang*/ de nas bris sku mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung du rang rigs kyi skyil krung bcas te 'dug nas/ ye shes pa spyan drangs la mchod pa byas nas/ dang por bdag gi de kho na nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal ba gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi ye shes bdag med rnam pa thams cad pa la ring du mnyam par bzhag /de nas bdag gi de kho na nyid las langs te lha drug mngon du byed pa yin te/ bsam gtan phyi ma las/ lha yi sku yi gnas de la/ / dang por kho nar mchod nas ni/ /rnal 'byor gnas bcas shes rab can/ /bde gshegs mdun du bsam nas ni/ /phyi nas yan lag rnam grol ba'i/ /mig 'byed 'byed pa rnam par spangs/ /phra ba mi g.yo gsal ba ste/ /blo yi spyod yul mdun na gnas/ /bdag nyid de 'dra bzhag nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nges pa las so/ /de la thog mar bstod pa'i lha/ bdag gi de nyid dang dbyer mi phyed par rang rig stong pa nyid rnam med du mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ mngon sum du gyur gyi bar bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes 'byung ngo*/ /de las langs nas nā da ste sgra'i lha/ gsang sngags kyi sgrar grags pa dang*/ de las sngags kyi yi ge nam mkhar gnas pa yi ge'i lha/ de zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang ro mnyam du gyur pa 'od zer spro bsdu byas nas lhag pa'i lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bskyed pa gzugs kyi lha/ de nas gtsug tor la sogs pa'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab pa phyag rgya'i lha/ de nas mnyam bzhag tu yan lag can dang bcas pa'i lha'i sku dam par gsal ba las sems gzhan du mi 'phro ba ci nus par srog rtsol bsdams la bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor bya ba yin te/ bsam gtan phyi ma las/

sngags kyi rnam par shes pa bsgoms/ /bsdams nas ting nge 'dzin la gnas// srog dang rtsol ba rab tu bsdams/ /zhes so/ /rjes thob tu yang lha'i snang ba dang ma bral bar sgom pa ni mtshan ma'i lha ste de ltar drug go /gnyis pa sngags kyi bsam gtan ni/ lhar bsgom na sngags bzla ba pos/ rus sbal gyi yan lag bskum pa lta bur dbugs rgyu ba dang sems dbang po'i grong nang du bsdus/ nang na gnas pa phyir lta ba'i tshul gyis mig zim byas nas gdong cung zad stod de/ byang rgod chags sdang dbugs 'byung rngub kyi rtog pa sogs spangs pa'i don yin la/ de nas sngags kyi bsam gtan dngos la/ mdun gyi thugs ka'i yi ge la dmigs la/ rang gi de la dmigs pa/ sgra la dmigs pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ sgra sngags 'phreng*/ sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ gzhi sangs rgyas kyi sku rnams dus gcig kho nar dmigs te/ yid bzlas sam shub bu'i bzlas pa bya zhing*/ bar skabs su rlung rang sor bzhag nas/ de nas dbugs 'byung ba na gsang sngags mi 'gyur pa'i gzhi rang lhar gsal ba la bltas nas dbugs rngub ste mdun gyi sgra sems gzhi gsum la dmigs nas dbugs 'byung ba'i mthar thug pa srog rtsol bsdams la bzlas pa bya/ ngal zhing dub na sgra sems la/ sems gzhi la/ rang gi lha'i de nyid kyang gzhi la bsdus nas/ ring du bdag gi de nyid la mnyam par bzhag nas tha mal ba'i gzugs kyis ldang ngo*/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang lha'i de nyid dang ldan pa'i rlung 'byung rngub bkagamig cung zad btsum kyang yid snang ba dang bcas pas mdun du gtad/ ha cang mi ring pa/ rang las cung zad mtho bar sangs rgyas kyi sku'i thugs kar zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa bsams la/ rlung rngub pa dang lhan cig tu mdun gyis thugs ka'i zla ba sngags bcas rang gi snying gar bsdu/ rlung phyir 'byung ba na mdun gyis thugs kar bkod de/ mdor na zla ba'i steng gi sngags phreng la dmigs shing zla ste/

ji srid bzlas brjod kyi bar du spro zhing sgom la/ mthar sgra sems gzhi ste yan lag gsum dmigs nas ldang bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bzlas brjod yan lag bzhi sngar ltar bsgom/ de nas gzhi de bzhin gshegs pa la bltas nas/ slar yang lces chu btung ba'i tshul gyis sems kyi rta rlung dang lhan cig yid nang du phyogs par bya/ dbugs 'byung rngub bkag rang lha dang gnyis su med pa dran tsam byas nas/ de'i rjes su dbyibs dang bral ba sgra tsam la sems bzung nas yid bzlas bya zhing*/ dbugs phyir 'byung ba na gzhi sangs rgyas kyi sku la dmigs nas ngag gis shub bu'i bzlas pa bya ba ste/ mdor na gzhi de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang gsang sngags mi 'gyur ba'i gzhi gcig tu byas te/ bzlas brjod kyi ting nge 'dzin dang po la sgra sems gzhi ste dmigs pa'i yul gsum/ gnyis par rang dang mdun gyi thugs kar dmigs pa ste gnyis/ gsum pa sgra gcig pu de gsum snga ma la goms nas phyi ma la bslabs te/ ji skad du/ sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol/ /gsang sngags mi 'gyur gzhi la gnas/ /yan lag ma nyams gsang sngags brjod/ /ngal na bdag la ngal bso zhing*/ /mi 'gyur ba ni yi ger ldan/ /gzhi las gzhir 'gyur de bzhin nyid/ /rang sngags phyir ni gang brtags pa/ /yid kyi dag pa bsam par bya/ /slar sdud pa yis bkug nas ni/ /srog dang rtsol ba bsdams pa'i yid/ /gsang sngags rig pa sngags la sbyar/ /yid kyi bzlas brjod brtsam par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa don dam ting nge 'dzin ni/ bsam gtan 'ba' zhig gis sgrub pa ni/ phub la sogs pa'i gnas su sngar bshad pa'i gzugs dang sgra dang don dam pa'i lha bsgoms te/ 'on kyang 'dir gzugs kyi lha'i bdag nyid yid kyis brtags pa'i sngags phreng*/ sgra ni rig sngags nyid kyi yi ge sgra'i rang bzhin/ don dam ni yongs su dag pa chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa'i ye shes la mnyam par 'jog pa/

de nas dngos gzhi ni/ gsang sngags mer gnas dngos grub ster/ /sgrar gnas rnal 'byor ster bar byed/ /sgra mthas thar pa ster bar byed/ /'di dag de nyid gsum pa yin/ /zhes bsam gtan phyi mar bka' stsal pa ltar/ gsum gyi dang po ni/ bdag gi de kho na nyid mngon du byas nas/ de'i rjes thob sgra'i bdag nyid lha'i de kho na nyid du bsgom la/ de snying gar me lce'am 'od zer 'bar ba'i dbus na gnas pa la sems bzung nas/ srog rtsol bkag bying rgod spangs te/ bsam gtan du bya ba/ ji srid bkres pa med pa sogs mtshan ma byung ba na/ ji ltar bsam pa sgrub nus pa la sogs pa dngos grub thob kyi bar du ste bzlas brjod kyi 'jug dang*/ rnam pa gzhan du'ang shes par bya ste/ phyi ma las/ mi 'byed las byung dngos po rnams/ /blo chen gyis ni bdag la bsdams/ /sngags pa yan lag 'das la gnas/ /zhen pa med par bsam par bya/ /sgra zhes bya ba phreng ba sbyar/ /yi ge brgyus la mi 'gyur rnams//

dril bu'i sgra bzhin ma chad par/ /yid la zhen par sems pa na/ /me yi nang gnas zhi ba ste/ /tshig rnams dag pa yang dag ldan/ /srog dang rtsol ba bkag pa'i bdag /gnyis spangs nas ni rnam par bsams/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi denyid la gnas pa'i snying gar zla ba rang gi me lce'i nang na gnas pa'am/ zla ba nyid sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab ste/ de nas sngags kyi yig gzugs kyi rnam pa spangs la/ sgra'i dbyangs tsam la rtse gcig pas bsam gtan du bya ste/ phyi ma las/ snying gar gnas pa'i phra ba ni/ /dri med zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ /de nang rab tu zhi ba ni/ /me lce rab tu 'od bzang ba/ /mi 'gyur gzhi ni der bzhag nas/ /bder 'dug nas ni sgra bsam mam/ /mi 'gyur ba ni yi ger bzhag /sgra nyid 'ba' shig bsams par bya/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can shin tu sbom po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis tha mal gyi rtog pa spangs/ de shub bu'i bzlas pa'i sgra la dmigs pa rags pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis spangs/ de yang phra mo yid bzlas kyis ting nge 'dzin gyis spangs la de nyid kyang rab tu gsang sngags kyi rnam rtog gi ting nge 'dzin gyis spangs nas/ de tsam yang spangs te 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin la mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ mdor bsdu na sgrar gnas kyi rnal 'byor te/ ting nge 'dzin sems pa la brtan pa thob nas/ sgra mtha' ni de ltar rim pa lngar gsung pa bsdu na/ sgra de gang nas byung*/ gang du song sogs brtags shing*/ /de nas de 'dra'i rtog pa yang spangs shing*/ ci yang ma rnyed pa de'i ngang du yang yang sems 'jog pa ste/ des thar pa ster zhes pa'o/ /de skad du yang*/ sgra la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan ni/ /'ba' zhig byas pa nyid kyis kyang*/ /dngos po kun rnams dam pa'i dpal/ /sgrub pa'i skyes bu thob par 'gyur/ /ltos bcas yan lag gyur pa snang*/ /sgra zhes bya ba yid kyis ngang*/ /tshig rnams dag pa rig sngags dbang*/

/yan lag spangs pa rgyal ba'i mkhyen/ /de ltar rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa dang brtul zhugs blangs nas sngags kyi tshul khrims ma nyams pa dag gis bzlas brjod la sogs pa de kho na nyid gzhi la brtson 'grus chen po sgrub na byang chub gsum ci yang rung ba dbang po dang 'tshams pas thob par 'gyur te/ rig sngags de nyid ma lus dang*/ bdag gi de nyid cho ga dang*/ bzlas brjod de nyid mchog shes pa'i/ /mis ni dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bsam gtan phyi ma dang*/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa las kyang*/ so ka nags me mched pa'i me lce yis/ /ma sgrib bzhin du tshang tshing kun sreg ltar/ /bzlas brjod me la tshul khrims rlung gis sbar/ /brtson 'grus chen po'i me lces sdig pa bsreg /zhes pa nas/ tshe rabs stong na gnas pa'i sdig pa'i mun/ /bzlas brjod mar mes myur du sel bar byed/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis ste/ de ltar dbang po rnon pos dang*/ dbang brtul gyis ni/ sgrub pa dang grub pa'i spyod pa la yang sbyar bar bya ste/ gsum pa sgrub pa'i spyod pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi de nyid la brtan pa thob nas/ rdzas sngags kyi sbyor bas lha la sogs pa'i lus dang*/ mig sman sogs rdzas dang*/ rin chen bdun sogs longs spyod de thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'o/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa'i spyod pa ni/ dngos grub gsum gang rung ba grub nas rang gzhan gyi don ji ltar spyod tshul dang*/ 'bras bu byang chub gsum po ste/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ mchog la mchog dang grub pa dang*/ /'bring la 'bring du nye bar bstan/ /tha ma phran tshegs grub pa ni/ /rgyal ba mchog gis mngon gsungs so/ /zhes dngos grub dang*/ yang de nyid las/ gang zhig rgyal dang rgyal sras sngags/ /sems can phyir ni gsungs pa rnams/ /gang zhig de thos mngon brtson pa/ /de ni nges par sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /gang yang sngags ni bags ma dag/gang zhig zlos pa de zlos byed/

/rang sangs rgyas su yang dag bstan/ /nges par de yi rigs kyang yin/ /sngags ni tha mar rab zhugs pa/ / nyan thos dgra bcom gyis bshad dang*/ /'jig rten ma lus kun la yang*/ / sngags zlos pa la mngon brtson pa/ /nyan thos rdzu 'phrul chen po yi/ /nges par rigs su de gnas yin/ /mchog dang tha ma bar ma yi/ /der yang las ni rab sbyar bya/ /zhes byang chub gsum du bstan to/ /de ltar mdor na spyod pa bzhis bya ba'i rgyud kyi don kun bsdus pa ste/ rgyas par gsang ba spyi rgyud dang*/ khro bo legs grub kyis zhus pa dang*/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud dang*/ bsam gtan phyi ma la sogs par shes par bya'o/ / da ni lam gyi rim pa de dag dang ldan pa'i rje btsun ma 'phags ma'i sgrub thabs nyams su blangs pa'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ nang par tho rangs chu klung gi drung du song ste/ oṃ badz+rodakasnān hūṃ/ zhes dag byed du byin gyis brlabs la/ chu klung der zhugs nas snyims pa gsum nam mkhar gtor/ oṃ ur+dha badz+ra rak+ṣa hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ phyogs mtshams kun tu gtor la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ka ma la badz+ra ku lī sa pa ri ba rā dz+nyā ya tsa tur di ga rak+ṣa hūṃ/ zhes dang*/ rkang pa rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i tshul du byas nas/ oṃ bruṃ badz+ra bh+ruṃ mi swāhā/ zhes phyogs bsrungs te/ oṃ kā ya bāk+tsita sarba pa la snā na hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā bhi ṣe ke ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā pad+ma badz+re ṇā dhiṣ+ṭha na badz+ra hūṃ/ zhes khrus dang nye reg bya/ de tsam ma nus na ril pa'i chus khrus bya ste/ de nas gnas khang gi sgo drung na 'dug ste/ oṃ sarba gau pañci ka sa ma dzī lo ka ku lī da bā naṃ ka l+yā naṃ kurban+tu/ zhes brjod nas/ sgrub khang sogs kyi dbus su bris sku'am lugs sku sogs bzhugs su gsol/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bla bre lda ldi sogs kyis brgyan/ phyogs mtshams brgyad kar mchod pa rnam lnga/

chu bzhi pa re re las mi nyung ba dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ sdong po bkod pa la sogs pa'i glegs bam dang*/ rin po ches gang ba'i bum pa bzhi/ 'bru dang*/ dri dang*/ sha khar dang*/ 'o thug dang*/ mig sman gyis gang ba'i bum pa dang*/ dur pa dang bcas pa'i mchod pa bshams pa rig pa'i bdag po'i sngags kyis bsngags pa'i bsangs chus gtor la/ oṃ las byung ba'i snod yangs par bsams la mchod pa rnams bskyed/ rang rang gi sngags rgya dang*/ dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ sku gzugs lhar gsal ba las 'od 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstims/ de nas mchod bstod rgya cher byas nas byin gyis rlob par gsol ba gdab/ de nas gdong byang du phyogs pas pad+ma'i skyil krung gis 'dug la/ skyabs su 'gro ba sogs byas nas/ bdag gi de kho na nyid la yun ring du nan tan du byas te/ stong pa'i lha/ oṃ shū n+ya ta stong pa de'i ngang las nā da gsang sngags thams cad kyi sgra dang bcas pa sgra'i lha/ de las zla bar tāṃḥbasam pa yi ge'i lha/ de gnyis ro mnyam las 'phags ma dang*/ de'i thugs ka nas lha mo gnyis spros nas rdul rnyed kyi sprul pas 'gro don mdzad par bsam pa gzugs kyi lha/ 'di las brtsams te thun mtshams su yang lha snang rjes su dran bzhin pa ni mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan ma'i lha/ 'di ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran bzhin pas sku gzugs lhar shes pa'i dbang las/ chu shing gcig stong par shes na thams cad kyang rig pa lta bur snang ba kun+da ltar shes pa'i gnad dam pa'o/ /de nas phyag rgyas lha/ pad+ma'i phyag rgya snying gar gtugs te/ rig pa lan gsum brjod/ rang gi sems dang mdun gyi lha dbyer mi phyed par bsam pa ni/ lha de yang sems su gtogs pa'i thabs te/ de nas dbang gi lha pad+ma'i rigs spyan drangs gsol ba gdab/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag brtan par byas par bsams la/

pad+ma'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag ste rig pa lan gcig bzlas pa'i cod pan gyi dbang bskur ro/ /de nas rje btsun ma'i thugs kar zla ba la sngags phreng bsgom nas rlung nang du bsdams/ sngags zla ba/ lha sku gsum la rtse gcig tu dmigs la yid bzlas bya/ de nas rlung 'byung ba na/ rang lhar gsal tsam la dmigs la shub bur sngags bzla ste/ na mo ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ mahā satwā ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi ka ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ na maḥtā re na mo ha re hūṃ ha re swāhā/ zhes bzla/ de la brtan pa thob nas lha'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin la/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni rang stong pa'i lha'i ngang las gzugs kyi lhar dmigs la mdun gyi thugs kar sngags phreng sngar bzhin/ bsgoms nas rlung nang du 'jug pa na rang gi snying ga dang*/ phar 'gro na mdun gyi thugs kar bkod de sngar bzhin bzla/ de la goms nas snga ma bzhin tshar gcig sgom ste/ sgra tsam la dmigs nas bzla ste bzlas brjod dang*/ de'i mthar mdun gyi thugs kar 'od 'bar ba'i dbus na sngags phreng tsam bsgom nas gzhan mi bsam par 'byung rngub bkag la yid bzlas bya/ dbugs 'byung ba na ci yang mi bsam par bya ba dang*/ de brtan nas/ thog mar zla ba la rig pa'i rgyal po bsgoms nas/ de nas ni de yang mi dmigs par sgra tsam la sems bzung ste/ bying rgod spangs nas bsgom par bya ba dang*/ de yang goms nas/ sgra de lus sems thog mtha' gang nas byung sogs dpyad na ci yang ma grub pa de'i ngang du ci yang mi bsam par 'jog pa bsam gtan gyi de nyid rnams te/ de nas tha mal pa'i gzugs kyis ldang bar bya'o/ /de ltar bzlas pa la sogs pa gnas skabs gang du sngar bshad pa ltar dmigs gsal gyi khrus dang nye reg sogs brtsams par bya zhing*/ thun mtshams su gsung rab bklags pa dang*/ 'byung ba chen po rnams dang*/ yi dwags rnams la gtor ma sbyin pa dang*/ sā tsa gdab pa sogs bya ste/

ji ltar legs grub kyis zhus pa las 'byung ba bzhin/ cha gsum gyi gtor ma thun mtshams bzhin sbyin la/ mi smra ba dang*/ bsnyung bar gnas pa dang*/ khrus dang bsreg blugs sogs ji ltar bzod par dka' thub kyang ngo*/ /zas la 'jug na yan lag lnga dang kha bkrus nas/ sha chang la phug sgog skya ke'u sogs 'byung po'i zas spangs pa'i kha zas gtsang zhing*/ kha na ma tho ba med pa lus gnas pa'i slad tsam du ji ltar 'os par spyad par bya mod kyi/ rgyags pa dang dregs pa'i don du ni nam yang ma yin no/ /tshul 'dis ni nyer mkho'i yo byad thams cad kyang rig par bya'o/ / de ltar zas zos nas chu klung la sogs par khrus dang nye reg byas nas/ slar ji ltar rigs pa la 'jug par bya ste/ skabs 'dir slob dpon 'dis/ nyal dang ldang dang bya ba la/ /sgrub po gang zhig 'jug 'dod na/ /rig pa'i rgyal po hu lu sogs/ /rta mchog rig sngags chen po rgyal/ /bdag gi lus ni rtag tu bsrung*// dbyug 'dzin snying gar gnas pa'o/ /dbyug pa rab bskul ka na ya/ /phyag rgya'i rdo rje de bzhin gnas/ /zhes pa'i mthar rta mchog gi rig pa sogs mdor na/ nyal ba ldang ba/ thun mtshams su 'jug pa rnams kyi tshe bsrung ba de bya bar gsung la/ des na rdo rje'i gdan la zhes gsungs pa gnas dang bdag bsrung ba la bya ste/ de'i dbang las mchod pa'i sngon du'ang bya dgos la/ de lta na yang bya rgyud spyi las 'byung ba'i gnas bdag bsrung ba'i cho ga'i khyad par mi ldan no snyam na/ de ltar zad mod/ spyi'i cho ga de dag ni gang du cho ga mi gsal ba rnams la sbyar zhing*/ rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par ni so sor spyad par bya dgos te/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel par/ 'dir ni re shig spyi'i gsang sngags kyi rnam par shes pa sgom pa'i rim pa'o/ / gang kha cig tu rnam pa gzhan du gsungs pa de dag tu yang de bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/

/zhes gsungs pa'i nges pa'o/ /rig pa'i rgyal po sogs kyi don bdag dang gnas bsrung ba'i tshul de nyid ci snyam na/ 'di lta ste/ rang gi snying gar pad nyi la/ na mo ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ mahā satwā ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ hu lu hu lu mahā kro dha bhi ṣā ṇa mu ṣī/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mahā daṃṣ+ta ka ra/ sa ha sra mu kha/ sa ha sra tsa rā ṇa/ sa ha sra ko ṭi pad+ma bhu dza/ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa/ mā ra ya/ mā ra ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha na/ dā ru ṇa kā ya/ ha ya gṛ ba/ mahā dā ru ṇa/ tsu ru ti/ gap+dza ti/ sarba bhū ta/ pre ta gra hā ṇaṃ/ ṛ k+ṣā ṇaṃ/ dz+wa la ṇaṃ/ pū tā ṇaṃ/ be ta ḍaṃ/ kin+na raṃ/ ga ru ḍaṃ/ nā gā naṃ/ sarba bhū ta/ ban+dha ban+dha/ hu lu hu lu/ ma tha ma tha/ bhasma ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sarba bhū ta trā sa ni/ pi shā tsi/ nā ra ya na/ shi ba/ in+d+ra ag+ni ya ma/ ma tā rī/ rak+ṣa sa/ yak+ṣo pa dra ba/ ba ru ṇa/ bā ya bya/ i sha na/ prah+ma/ pri th+wī/ pra ha/ rak+ṣa ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'phreng g.yas skor me 'bar ba yongs su gyur pa las rta mchog rol pa rta mgo can ha ha zhes bshad pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang thal mo/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang dbyug pa dkar po oṃ tshugs su byas pa/ dar dang stag lpags dang nor bu dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su bsgom nas rig pa lan drug brjod/ de nas gnas bsrung ba ni/ dbyug pa'i phyag rgya bskul bzhin pas/ ha ya gṛ ba'i rig pa brjod/ gra ha pūrba rak+ṣa zhes sogs kyi ming bcug nas brjod par bya ste/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas so/ /de nas bkan pa'i phyag rgya phyogs bcur bstan te rigs pa lan gcig brjod/ mdor na de ni bdag dang gnas bsrung ba zhes bya'o/ /de nas nyal ba na yang sangs rgyas rjes su dran bzhin pas snang ba'i 'du shes dang bcas nas nyal bar bya yis/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gis ni ma yin no/

/de ltar 'di ni bya rgyud kho na nas 'byung ba'i rim pa ste/ lam 'di la 'bad de/ sgrub pa dang grub pa'i spyod pa la sogs pas nye bar sbyar bas dbang po dang mthun par lus 'di'am/ bar dor lha'i lus rig pa 'dzin par gyur nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ba'o/ / ༈ gnyis pa/ nang rnal 'byor la mngon par gzhol ba'i don du rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang go mtshungs su sbyar ba ni 'di ltar/ mdor na 'chi med ting 'dzin ni/ /sngon 'gro yan lag rnam bzhi dang*/ /ting 'dzin rnam pa gnyis dngos gzhi/ /mjug dang thun mtshams bya ba'o/ /dang po la/ gzhi dang*/ rkyen dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ lam gyi yan lag bzhi'i/ dang po gzhi'i yan lag ni/ lus bsrang*/ kha shar du phyogs te/ oṃ a na d+ya sogs brjod/ de yang sems can rnams kyi sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba 'di ye nas bzhugs pas dang*/ de nyid 'dir ngo shes pa'i phyir du/ rnam rtog gis ma bcos par gsal 'debs pas na gzhi'i yan lag ces bya'o/ /de la a na di ni thog ma med pa ste/ des mtshon nas tha ma dang bar med la/ de med pa'i dus kyis ma bzung pa'i phyir na yul gyis kyang ma bzung ba ste/ mdor na/ ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa'o/ /a dī ni/ dang po dang thog ma dang gdod ma ste/ gsar du grub pa ma yin par thog ma nas 'gro ba rnams la rang rig par bzhugs pa yin la/ de yang bum pa dang bum pa thogs pa lta bur ni ma yin te/ bdag nyid gcig pa'i tshul gyi gshis nyid du gnas pa yin no/ /tsit+ta ni sems te/ de yang*/ dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin de nyid ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa yin mod kyang*/ stong pa sems med ni ma yin gyi/ 'o na ci snyam na/ rang bzhin shin tu dag pa'i 'od gsal ba'i shes pa'o/ /badz+ra satwa ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ sems 'di'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' ste rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes las gzhan ma yin la/ gnas skabs su glo bur gyi dri mas sgrib pa nyid na'ang*/

rang bzhin 'od gsal de'i ngo bo la ci yang ma gos pa'i phyir na mi shigs pa ste rdo rje sems dpa' 'o/ /a haṃ nga'o zhes pa ste/ sngar bshad pa rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ de yang*/ thog ma med pa/ dang po/ bem stong ma yin pa/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnam pa thams cad pa ni bdag gi de kho na nyid do zhes pa ste/ 'dir smras pa/ nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems ni gdod ma ste/ /stong pa chen po rang gi ngo bo gang*/ /'di ni dam pa'i don de mu stegs kyi//

rab brtags bdag tu 'khrul bar ma bgyis shig /de ltar 'di ni rje btsun byams pas/ dag dang nyon mongs dang ldan phyir/ /kun nas nyon mongs med dag phyir/ /rnam par dbye ba med chos phyir/ /lhun grub rnam par mi rtog phyir// zhes gsungs pa'i/ dag dang nyon mongs dang ldan phyir zhes pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /da ni rkyen gyi yan lag las/ kun nas nyon mongs med dag phyir/ zhes pa'i dbang du byas te/ dri ma dag par byed pa khrus te/ badz+rod ke rdo rje'i chu/ sems kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin nyid du shes par bya bas na de skad ces bya'o/ /oṃ tap+te sogs kyi lha'i chu bo gaṅgā bkug par bsam ste/ rdo rje'i chu de dag byed du sad par byas pa bzhin du/ sems kyang dri ma rang dag ste kun nas nyon mongs nyid med par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas kha bkrus pas nyon yid dang*/ gdong bkrus pas yid kyi rnam shes dang*/ yan lag lnga bkrus pas sgo lnga'i rnam shes dang*/ lus kun bkrus pas sems byung phra mo rnams dang*/ khrus khu dor bas kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/ glo bur ba rnams med par ngo shes pa'i tshul gyis dag par bsams par bya'o/ /de nas rlung byin gyis brlabs pa ste 'di nas dngos gzhi la ma reg gi bar ni/ rnam par dbye ba med chos phyir/ /zhes pa'i dbang du byas te/ de la/ badz+ra satwa bā yu ni rdo rje sems dpa'i rlung ste/ de ni sems gzugs sogs yul la g.yo ba'i rang bzhin yin la/ de yang kun gzhi ye shes bag chags dang bcas pa'i dbang las yul du 'dzin pa'i bag chags de rkyen gyis brtas pa las gzugs la sogs pa snang ba 'byung*/ de las nyon mongs 'byung*/ des las byas/ des kyang sems rgyud bag chags kyis sbags par byed de/ /sa bon dang sdong po dang 'bras bu bzhin du/ lus can rnams 'khor bar 'khor ba dang*/ bag chags de dag pa na/ bag chags de'i rang bzhin chos nyid ni rdo rje sems dpa' longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhugs pas na/

rdo rje sems dpa' rlung zhes gsungs pa ste/ 'di shin tu rtog dka' ba'i phyir/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rnams las/ rlung sems phra mo dang*/ mi shigs pa'i thig le dang*/ 'pho ba'i bag chags dang*/ lus sems kyi 'brel ba'am/ rten brten pa'i 'brel ba sogs rgya cher gsungs par shes par bya ste/ mdor na rlung ni de yin no/ /g.yas nas rngub cing g.yon nas dbyung ba ni/ 'di ltar/ g.yas nas 'byung ba na sa chu me rlung rnams phyi ma phyi ma ring ba ni/ sa chu la thim pa sogs la bsdud rim dang*/ g.yon nas nam mkha' la rlung chags pa la sogs pa skye ba'i rim pas rlung me chu sa rnams rgyu la/ rlung nang du 'gro ba na de gnyis ka'ang ldog nas 'byung bas/ g.yas nas rngub pa dang*/ g.yon nas dbyung ba na gnyis ka yang bskyed rim yin pa'i nges pas/ 'chi med sgrubs pa'i thabs kyi snying po can du rig par bya'o/ /de gnyis gyi bar du rlung cung zad bzung nas srog rtsol dgag pa ste/ 'di ni mnyam rgyu ye shes kyi rlung 'gog par byed pas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba 'thob par bla med nas bshad pas kyang rig par bya ste/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rlung zhes bya ba dang shin tu 'brel to/ /'dir smras pa/ don dam nges pa'i man ngag dang bral ba/ /'di ni rlung sogs bem po'i chos su blta/ /theg mchog rdzogs rim ma nor lag len bcas/ /shes par rlom gang brtags tshe ga zha'i rgyu/ /nyes gang gdod nas med kyang gnyen po yis/ /gsar du dag pa'i tshul chen de shes nas/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i mig 'phrul mkhan/ /rlung gi gnad kyang gnas 'dir shes na ko /de ltar rlung ni longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rang bzhin du shes nas/ khyad par gsal 'debs pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs/ de yang longs spyod rdzogs sku bde chen snying rje'i rang bzhin/ de'i sku gsung thugs ngo bo gcig kyang ldog pas phye na sku sems can la dmigs pa dang*/

gsung chos la dmigs pa/ thugs dmigs med kyi snying rje rnams sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin glo bur rnam dag ste/ rang gi sgo gsum yang rang bzhin der shes par bya ba yin no/ /oṃ āḥsogs ni rang gi ngag gzhom med kyi sgra dang oṃ hūṃ sogs kyi sems kyi rdo rje 'di stong nyid dang*/ bde ba gnyis min thugs rdo rje dang*/ oṃ oṃ sogs kyis lus 'di'i rang bzhin ni chos nyid kyang*/ bem chos las 'das pa'i sgyu ma sangs rgyas kyi skur ye nas bzhugs pa de nyid/ 'dir gsal gdab pa ste/ de gsum 'dzin zhes mtshon par rdzas kyi rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa dang 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya yang bya'o/ /gong du gzhi'i de nyid tshe rdo rje snying gar 'dzin pa'i gnad kyang des shes te/ yang na 'dir ngag grag stong rnam pa thams cad pa/ sems byang chub sems kun tu bzang po/ lus lha skur dran pa rnams rnal 'byor gyi rgyud de nyid bsdus pa sogs las 'byung ba bzhin no zhes dbang po'i dbye bas rig par bya ste/ mdor na dam tshig gsum gyi don no/ /de ltar bshad pas grub pa'i don bsgom bya'i rim pa ni/ gzhi'i yan lag gi skabs su rang sems kyi ngo bo la cher gyi mnyam par bzhag /de las langs nas/ sems 'di rang bzhin gyi dag pa'o snyam du bsgom/ dag byed kyi chu byin gyis rlob na yang*/ sems kyi dri ma ye nas ci yang ma grub bo snyam pa'i gdangs dang bcas pas/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin chu bo'i rnam par bsam mo/ /de nas sngar bshad pa'i dri ma rnams dag par bsam pa dang*/ rlung byin rlabs kyi tshe/ thog mar rlung de la sems gtad nas dmigs med du mnyam par bzhag /de las langs te rlung 'di'i rang bzhin ni longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'o zhes rtog pa dang*/ sgo gsum byin gyis rlob pa na/ oṃ zhes pa'i tshe 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal snying rje dang*/ āḥzhes pa'i tshe snang ba sgyu ma lta bu la sems mnyam par bzhag

hūṃ zhes pa na/ kun kyang ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa'i ngang der yul gyi snang ba med par mnyam par 'jog oṃ āḥswāhā gaṇ+ḍaṃ sogs gsum ni/ thog mar lus kyi rang bzhin/ ngag gi gdangs/ sems kyi ngo bo rnams la cher gyis bltas/ de nas sngar bshad pa rnams rnam rtog gi tshul gyis dran par bya ste/ rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin cung zad mngon du gyur nas/ ngag gzhom med kyi nā dar shes pa sogs rjes su mthun pa tsam zhig yod na ni de la nan tan du bya yi/ rnam rtog gi don gyi sman yon du 'gyur ba ci/ 'dir smras pa/ byis pa'i tshig gi phreng brgyud u dum bur/ /chen po'i mgul brgyan 'os zhes ci tol 'ga'/ /ci tol kho nas rab smra de bzhin gzhan/ /ya mtshan can gyi rang lugs 'dzin pa'ang mthong*/ /rnam par ma bslad chos kun gcig gyur pa//lam bzang 'di la ci phyir 'bad mi byed/ /gzhan du gdug pa'i slob dpon rjes 'brangs nas/ /ngal brgyas khyim pa bas kyang dman par spyod/ /e ma mang du smras pas ci zhig bgyi/ /'di na rlung yang 'od gsal sems kyi mdangs/ / yongs su dag sku bde ba chen po ste/ /gzhom med sgra gdangs 'gyur med chu zla'i gshis/ /de ltar don dam pa'i rkyen gyi yan lag bshad nas/ da ni kun rdzob kyi rkyen gyi yan lag ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs/ yan lag bdun pa sogs bya ste/ de ni go sla ba'o/ /de dag ni rkyen gyi yan lag ste/ ci'i phyir rkyen gyi yan lag zhe na/ dag byed khrus ni mi mthun phyogs bsal ba/ rlung byin gyis brlabs pa ni dmigs pa'i rkyen gyi lam dang*/ sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs pa de ma thag rkyen gyi lam dang*/ rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig dran pa bdag rkyen gyi lam ste gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ 'di'i nges pa ni/ longs spyod rdzogs sku la dmigs pa ste/ su yin na/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gyis dang*/

ji ltar dmigs na snying rje gsum gyi tshul ltar dang*/ gang du dmigs pa ni dam tshig gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin du ste/ mdor na rgyu mtshan de'i phyir rkyen gyi yan lag go /'dir smras pa/ dpal ldan khyab bdag longs spyod rdzogs/ /zhing dang sems can spyod pa dang*/ /mi shigs sku la dmigs med kyis/ /rab tu dmigs pa nyid du bya/ /tha mal rtog pas nam yang ma bsnyengs par/ /yin lugs mchog la mnyam par bzhag gyur na/ /lus ngag yid kyi rang bzhin rnam dag de/ /rang bzhin rnam dag nyid du ngang gis rig /de nas ngo bo'i yan lag ni/ oṃ shū n+ya ta sogs ste/ de'i don stong nyid ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin nga yin no zhes pa ste/ rang bzhin 'od gsal de nyid rab tu myong zhing rig pa nyid na yang myong zhing rig pa de'i ngo bo'am/ gshis gang du yang grub pa med pas na/ ngo bo'i yan lag stong par bzhag pa yin la/ stong pa de la/ rgyal ba gnyis pa klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ ji skad du/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtsal 'gag med mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen du 'char bas na ye shes rdo rje yin la/ de'i rang bzhin zhes pa ni/ rang bzhin dang ni bcos min dang*/ /gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin/ /zhes dbu mar gang gsungs pa ste/ rgyu rkyen gang gis kyang ma byas par gdod ma nas yin pa ste me tsha ba bzhin no/ /su zhe na/ nga yin no zhes pa ste/ gzhi'i yan lag gi skabs su bshad pa'o/ /sgom tshul ni/ shū n+ya ta sogs brjod pa na/ thog mar dngos po thams cad sgyu ma lta bu snang yang ma grub pa'o snyam pa'i mthar/ rig pas brtags na ci yang ma rnyed pa de'i ngang du mi bsam par mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ snang ba dgag ni mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang sems snang med stong pa gtso che ba yin par rig par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ bden gnyis 'od gsal chu zla'i rol rtsed mkhan/ / brgya phrag ting 'dzin sgyu ma'i zlos gar gyis/

/zung 'jug 'phrog pa'i grong khyer nyams dga' byas/ /ris med kun tu 'char ba sgyu ma'i gshis/ /da ni lam gyi yan lag ni/ bsrung pa'i 'khor lo sogs/ de yang thog mar rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol nas/ hūṃ lan gsum glur len te/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum srung ba bdag bsrung ba dang*/ hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas in+d+ra sogs kyis phyogs skyong la sogs pa'i bgegs bskrad nas/ phyogs mtshams su rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng du gur/ 'og tu sa gzhi rnams bsgom par bya ste gnas bsrung ba'o/ /skabs 'dir rang rtsa ba'i lha skur sgom pa 'di'o zhes pa ma byung la/ 'on kyang slob dpon nyid kyis 'dir rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bcas/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rnam par brtag /'khyil ba chen po dam tshig rgyal/ /'byung po'i gdon rnams brlag par mdzad/ /de bzhin khro bo hūṃ ka ra/ /rang gi phyag rgya yan lag bcas/ /bgegs rnams gzhom zhing rtag tu yang*/ /bdag gnas rnal 'byor rab tu bsrung*/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di ni bya rgyud dang ma mthun mod kyi/ 'di rnal 'byor bla med go bstun du gnas pa'i phyir na/ rang khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gi bzhugs par skad cig gis sgom nas gnas bsrung ngam/ yang na hūṃ mdzad du bsgom pa ste 'di la 'gal ba med do/ / rdo rje khu tshur kha sprad pa phyogs bcur bskor te/ s+tha na sogs gnas dang*/ snying gar bzhag pas yo ga sogs rnal 'byor dang*/ dpral bar bzhag pas āt+ma sogs bdag bsrung ba'o/ /rdo rje rtse lnga sogs kyi bdag gnas rnal 'byor bsrung ba thams cad lan gcig yid la byas te brtan par bsam nas/ de mthar bgegs dang*/ bsrung 'khor/ bar du gcod pa gsum gang yang mi dmigs par bsam te/ don dam gyi srung ba'i 'khor lo yin la/ gong du oṃ s+tha na sogs kyi tshe/ gnas/ rnal 'byor/ bdag bsrung gsum ga dran par bya dgos pa las bdag gnas bsrung ba dngos su byung yang*/

rnal 'byor bsrung ba 'di lta'i gsal kha dngos su ma byung la/ de bas na zla gsang thig le/ o ḍ+ya ya na/ rnam par rtsen pa sogs su/ dam tshig gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin rnal 'byor bsrung bar gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir yang oṃ āḥswāhā/ kaṇ+ḍaṃ sogs rnal 'byor bsrung bar rigs te/ bya spyod las ni gnas bdag bsrung ba tsam las ma gsungs shing*/ yo ga las 'byung ba dang*/ 'dus par tshad med bzhi las gsungs pa sogs dang phyogs 'dra ba ni 'dir ma byung ba la/ gzhan yang 'di ni bla med dang cha mtshungs pa'i nges pa las so/ / 'dir smras pa/ sems gang kun gzhi rnam shes kyis sgrubs pa'i/ /tshogs drug brdzun pa'i dug chus myos las slar/ /stong nyid bdud rtsi'i chu bo rtag 'thung bas/ /ris bral dag pa'i lang tsho rgyas par 'gyur/ /'di ni bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nges pa'o/ /de nas lha bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ dngos por snang ba thams cad rang la bsdu/ rang yang stong par bsams te/ de nas kun rdzob kyi snang ba tha mal pa mi dmigs shing*/ stong pa de'i gdangs ma bral bar 'ja' tshon ltar stong bzhin du snang ba ni/ dngos po rnams kyi rang bzhin nyid pas na de nyid sngar ma rtogs pa deng nas rtogs pa'i slad du ste/ sgom tshul ni sgrub thabs su gsal bas 'dir spro bar mi 'dod la/ zhing khams rgya mtsho sgom pa ni/ zhing sbyong ba yin zhing*/ tāṃḥgi sgras sems can rnams byang chub la bkod nas/ bdud rtsir gyur nas bsdu ba ni sems can smin pa'i slad du'o/ /rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du gtugs nas rig pa lan gsum brjod pa ni/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ pad+ma/ rdo rje'i rigs gsum gyi bdag nyid gcig tu byas pa yin la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥrdo rje bzhi byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ sku dang gsung dang thugs dang ye shes rdo rje rnams so/ /de nas ni ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs ro mnyam du bsams nas/

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ de nas dbang bskur ba ste rnam pa bcu las/ cod pan ni 'od dpag med dang*/ brtan par brjod pa ni/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs brjod pas so/ /de dag ni lam gyi yan lag ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na tshogs rdzogs par byed pa'i lam yin pas na te/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin las/ phyi ma gnyis sngar bshad pa dang*/ lhag ma rnams dang po ste/ de yang bsrung 'khor ni/ nges par 'byung ba'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ lhar gsal ba ni rdo rje theg par sems bskyed pa dang*/ rigs gsum mam/ rdo rje gsum byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag sogs kyi nges pas/ tshogs kyi lam che chung gsum dang*/ rdo rje bzhi ni drod la sogs pa sbyor lam bzhi dang*/ ye shes spyan 'dren ni sa dang po'i mnyam bzhag mthong lam dang*/ sa bon 'od 'phros sogs ni sa dang po'i rjes thob sogs sa bcu dang*/ chos mthun pa'o zhes pa ste/ de'i phyir lam gyi yan lag go /'dir skabs su babs pa'i don re shig de tsam la bya ste/ nges pa dang bcas pa'i 'thad pa rgyas par rnams yi ge mangs kyi dogs dang*/ skabs su ma gyur pas ma bris so/

/'dir smras pa/ rnam pa kun ldan stong nyid dam pa'i don/ /nges pa'i lha ste gzhan ni dri ma'o/ /de bas res 'jog tshul du ma 'khrul bar/ /stong pa'i ring las lha sku 'dir shes bya/ /zhing sbyong pa dang sems can smin pa'i tshul/ /kun kyang sgyu ma'i rnam rol stong pa'i ngang*/ dbang po'i gzhu la reg thogs med pa ltar/ /rgyal ba'i sku yang tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa na'o/ /rigs gsum 'gyur med rdo rje chen po bzhi/ /ye shes 'khor lo de bzhin dbang bskur dang*/ /byang chub phyogs mthun de bzhin 'od gsal gnad/ /bsdus pa'i tshig la'ang don rgyas rig par byos/ /da ni/ lhun grub rnam par mi rtog phyir/ /zhes pa'i dbang du byas te/ dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gnyis kyi dmigs pa ni/ sgrub thabs nyid du bris zin la/ gang dag tu du ba dang smig rgyu sogs kyi mtshan ma sngar brtan por mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pas rang lhar gsal ba'i lus nang du zhing rnams dmigs tsam byas te mnyam par bzhag pa na/ stong gzugs la zhing mang nyung dbang po dang mtshams par dngos su snang la/ de nas 'chi med kyi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya ba dang*/ las dang po pa'i sgom tshul la yang rnam rtog gi rtsol ba yod mod kyi/ de lta na yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnad shes pas/ zhing dang 'chi med kyi rnal 'byor la/ gang dmigs bcas yod kyi bar du sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam pa dang*/ zhing yang rab 'byams te/ che chung phra sbom mang nyung sogs tshad bzung mi nus pa mtha' yas pa shes pa dang*/ 'chi med kyi mthar/ dmigs med ni gang yang mi sgom par rig tsam snang tsam la ring du mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ skabs 'dir slob dpon gyis/ /mchan khung srog rtsol bsdams dang bcas/ /sgyu ma'i lam mchog gang mthong ba/ /des ni re shig dmigs bcas pa'o/ /de mthar dmigs pa med gang dang*/ /'od zer dra'ang ma mthong gang*// rtag tu rnam par rtogs pas brtag /zhes gsungs pa'i nges pa las so//rnal 'byor 'di gnyis ka'ang 'chi med sgrub pa'i nges pa las stong pa nyid sgom pa'i rig pa yin la/

de lta mod kyi rnam med dam stong nyid/ med dgag tsam la ni rtag par dam pa'i nges tshig ma zhugs shing*/ stong nyid rnam pa thams cad pa ste/ rnam pa ci yang 'char ba ni rtag pa dam pa yin la/ de yang zhing gi rnal 'byor ni sna tshogs su snang ba rnam pa thams cad pa dang*/ 'chi med kyi rnal 'byor ni bde ba dam pa dang*/ 'od gsal gtso che ste/ phyi ma snga ma la/ rten nas 'byung gi gzhan du ma yin no/ /de yang rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid las 'od gsal dang 'gyur med bde ba chen po thob pa ni/ bla med kyi rgyud rnams kyi nges gsang dam par shes par gyis shig gu/ de ltar de gnyis kyi phyi mas rang don chos sku dang*/ dang pos gzhan don gzugs skus 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yin la/ de gnyis tha dad pa yang ma yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyal ba'i yon tan zab cing rgya che rnams/ /lhun grub nyid na'ang gsar du thob pa yi/ /tshul de shes nas rnam par rtog med kyang*/ /'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul 'di'o/ /phyag rgya chen po rnam kun stong nyid dang*/ /zhu bde las 'das bde chen 'od gsal ba'o/ /nges gsang de gnyis rig na 'chi med dang*/ /zhing gi rnal 'byor ris med 'khor lo'ang rig /rmi lam dag las bde ba sbyin pa dang*/ brag cha'i glu dbyangs byis rnams yid bde'i rgyu/ /lam bzang mchog kyang de 'drar myong ba las/ /mkha' bzhin kun la go skabs sbyin na ko /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams kun rtog med gzigs nas/ /don dam mi 'chi bcud byed rtag rol yang*/ /rab 'byams zhing du dpag med zlos gar can/ /gdul dka'i zhing du'ang ngur smrig thun mtshams kyi/ /des ldan rnams la'ang lhan skyes bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /skabs dbyer gyur bzhin rig par byos a re/ /shī ba'i ring lugs skyong ba'i cher rlom 'ga'/ /zab cing rgya che'i tshig rnams ma rtogs par/ /las rgya nges pa'i lam dang rim pa ste/

/gong ma'i dbang gsum 'gyur med bde ba bral// de bzhin rtag tu 'dod la brkam pa'i tshig /'jig rten dmod tsam spangs phyir spros med kyi/ /spyod pa gsungs zhes smra mod de lta bu'i/ /phyag chen rtogs pa chig gcod tshig tu bas/ /yang smras pa/ ka ye nam mkha'i me tog su yis mthong*/ /'phrog pa'i grong du gang gi ltad mo sbyin/ /rmad byung don de bla ma'i zhal las dris/ /mi bsrun shing rtar 'jug pa'i ngal bas ci/¿/de ltar bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin te/ de nas ldang bar 'dod na/ rang dam ye gnyis med du gsal ba mchod cing bstod pas bstod pa ste/ de la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam sogs kyi don cung zad bshad na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam ni dngos po thams cad la khyab pa ste/ gzhi'i chos nyid do/ /mnyam nyid ni lam ste/ /chos nyid de'i rang bzhin stong pa dang snying rje mi phyed pa goms par byed pa/ ro mnyam ni de ltar goms pa'i mthus 'bras bu ste/ don dam rnam med chos sku dang*/ kun rdzob rnam bcas gzugs sku ro mnyam pa'o/ /de'i phyir sku mnga' ba ste/ chosanyid de 'phags ma'o zhes pa'o/ /dngos rnams sogs ni/ dper na bum pa grub pa na/ de thad kyi nam mkha' gzhan du ma song la/ zhig pa na yang gzhan nas ma 'ongs pas bum pa song yang nam mkha' mi 'gro ba ltar/ gzhi lam sogs kun/ bum sogs ngo bo dang 'dra ba dang*/ chos nyid nam mkha' dang 'dra bar bzhag go /'jig dang sogs nam mkha' dang 'dra bas te/ zhig mi srid pas mtshar mod ma 'ongs pa'i phyir 'jig rgyu med pas de tsam du ngo mtshar ci/ de ltar na ya mtshan sogs te go sla'o/ /srid dang sogs 'bras bu la sbyar ba ste/ srid pa ste kun rdzob gdod ma nas med par gzigs kyang*/ sngon snying rjes kun nas blangs te smon lam bgyis pa'i dbang gis 'gro ba la btang snyoms med par gzigs nas/ rnam par 'phrul pa yul dus chad pa med par 'byung bas/

khams gsum gyi 'gro ba kun la bde chen ste thar pa sbyin pa zhes pa'o/ khyod zhabs sogs go sla ste/ khyed kyi zhabs la 'dud pa rnams kyang byang chub chen por nges pa'o/ /de'i phyir phyag 'os so zhes pa'i don no/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa bzlas nas bzod pa gsol/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba ste/ dbyings su thim par bsam/ de nas rig pa lan gsum brjod/ sngar bshad pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig dran par byas te/ sku gsung thugs mi phyed par byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+re sogs ni bdag nyid bsrung ba/ de nas ni dge ba bsngos nas ldang bar bya ste/ thams cad du yang lhar snang dang ma bral bar bya la/ lam 'di la yang yang goms pas lhur blangs pas lus 'di la mchog gi dngos grub ster bar byed de/ gzhi dang*/ rkyen gyi yan lag dang*/ dngos gzhi gtso bor goms pas rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po skye bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ bden gnyis mi phyed ting 'dzin goms las nam mkha'i gzugs mthong zhing*/ /gang du brtan zhing yangs par gyur dang thabs mang de tshe'o/ /a re byang phyogs 'di na sde snod spangs shing rgyud sde ring du dor/ /ngal bas gnas kyang ngan 'gro la gzhol kye hud gtum po ltar/ /dman pa las kyang dman pa'i spyod pa 'dzin/ /bzang po yi yang bzang po lta bur rlom/ /brtson pa chen pos brtson par 'bad mod kyi/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khor las thar mi 'gyur/ /de bas na lam bzang ma nor ba gnad ma bcos pa dag la 'bad pa chen pos ci'i phyir mi 'bad/ de ltar na 'di'i man ngag gi gnad rnal 'byor bla med ltar shes dgos/ smra na de ci snyam na/ bshad zin mod kyi/ de ltar na yang rlung byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ sgo gsum byin gy-is brlabs pa/ dam tshig gsum sgom pa/ lha bskyed zin nas rdo rje bzhi byin gyis brlabs pa/ dngos gzhi rnal 'byor gnyis rnams bla med kho na bzhin du yod la/

lha bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes 'khor lo spyan 'dren pa dang*/ gshegs pa rnams rnal 'byor rgyud bzhin dang*/ spyir zab gnad ni/ bzhi'i yan lag /rang bzhin gyi yan lag dag byed 'khrus dang*/ rlung dang*/ sgo gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ dam tshig gsum bsgom pa/ rdo rje bzhi'i byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor gnyis rnams so/ / gtor ma dang*/ zas dang*/ nyal ba la sogs pa sngar bya rgyud kho na'i lugs kyi skabs bshad zin to/ /mchod pa byin rlabs ci 'dra bar gtor ma de 'dra la/ 'on kyang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas dbul bar bya'o/ /de ltar 'di ni lta sgom 'bras bu'i gnad rnal 'byor bla med kyi tshul zab cing rgya che ba dang*/ spyod pa kṛ ya bzhin du gtsang sbra dang*/ dka' thub dang sbyin bsreg sogs spyad pas/ lus 'di la mchog gi dngos grub thob cing*/ dbang po ches dman pas kyang shin tu nan tan tu byas na 'chi ba med pa'i rig 'dzin thob nas/ rim gyi sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /'dir slar yang de rnams 'di skad ces/ sems can gang dag srid pa la mos te/ /srid pas dge dang mi dge'i 'bras bu byed/ /de ni bde chen lam las gol ba ste/ /skad cig byung nas phyir yang nub par 'gyur/ /'dod dang dga' bde yongs su ma spangs gang*/ /mtshan ma mthong yang nyon mongs bcas pa yin/ /slob dpon mnyes byas nang gi rnam par 'byed/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid 'dod bde gnas 'thob// rdo rje sems dngos sems kyi rdo rje gang*/ /rang bzhin nyid de de phyir gzhi'i yan lag /dbang po yul dang lta 'dod rkyen gsum ste/ /de las dbang shes skye bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /'dir yang rkyen gyi yan lag gang gis na/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes mngon gsum pa'o/ /chos kun rang bzhin rdul bral stong nyid de/ /rnam kun de nyid bsgom phyir de skad brjod/ /sems kyi rdo rje dri ma med rtogs pa/

/ de tshe bsrung ba med na gnod byed ci/ /de nas sems kyi rdo rje lhar sad pa/ / rigs gsum rdo rje bzhi dag brtas par gyur/ /dbang bskur nas ni sa bcu'i bdag po ste/ /de phyir lam gyi yan lag ces bya'o/ /sgyu lus rab 'byams zhing gi rnal 'byor dang*/ /don dam bde chen rtag pa 'chi med yin/ /kye ma 'byung po'i ring lugs lhur byed la/ /byang phyogs 'di na kun kyang dga' zhing 'gro/ / tshul de spangs nas thabs mang gtsang sbrar bcas/ /yang dag lam la zhugs dang thar 'dod kye/ 'dir smras pa/ /'od gsal dam pa rtag tu mi 'gyur bdag dam pa/ /dam pa'i ting 'dzin ro mnyam mnyam pa bgrang yas kyis/ /rang gi tshul de rang gis rig byas gnas de na/ /dri ma ci zhig thar pa de ci ming tsam gyis/ / rnam par gnar dang 'ga' mgu rangs 'di byis pa'i gshis/ /bsam gyi mi khyab tshul bzhis 'khyud pa'i rang bzhin sems/ /bla ma'i drin las mkhas pa dag gi gnyug ma'i dngos/ /ring por mi thogs brtson pas bsgrubs na cis mi mthong*/ kha ba can 'dir deng sang dam pa'i chos/ /ming tsam 'dzin zhing phal cher log par mos/ /rgyal bas gdams pa'i rnam dag spyod pa dang*/ /zab cing rgya che'i thabs la rnam par smod/ /'dod pa'i dkrugs rnams mthon po'i lta skad kyis/ /yang dag lta ba rtsa ltar 'dor ba mthong*/ /mgon pos nam yang yon tan sba bya zhing*/ /skyon rnams mthol ba gyis zhes yang yang gsungs/ /de bas thar pa 'dod rnams kyis/ /rgyu 'bras theg mchog las gsungs pa'i/ /nges gsang thabs mang dang bcas pa/ /sangs rgyas gsungs bzhin sgrub pa'i rigs/ /bde ba'i rdo rje mkha' dbyings dam par chos kun bskyed pa po/ /ma lus shes bya'i bdag po nye dang ring ba min pa nyid/ /rtag cing bde ba rang bzhin dri med dngos kun za ma tog /rigs bral sems kyi rdo rje 'phags ma 'jig rten yum la 'dud/ /ces pa 'di ni gang yang dag pa'i lam 'di skal ba dang ldan pa dag gis nan tan du bya ba dang*/

rnam pa gzhan du yid gnyis kyi phyang mo yug tu gyur pa dag dang*/ nan tan du bgyi ba dag la nges pa sbyin pa'i phyir/ sgrub thabs 'di'i go don rnams yi ger gyis shig ces/ mkhyen yangs mi'i dbang po'i bka' yis bskul ba las/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' snying pos rang gi blo nus dang 'tshams par g.yar khral du 'tshal ba'o// // maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /bla med dang bya rgyud kyi sngags spyi'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i zab gnad ya ོda / ༈ bla med dang bya rgyud kyi sngags spyi'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i zab gnad yod/ na mo gu rwār+ya tā rā dwa t+yaḥ gang gi 'gyur med bde chen pos/ /yid kyi shing rta lhag par 'gengs/ /bla med bla ma'i zhabs pad ni/ /snying gi chu mtshor nges gyur cig /srid dang srid pa'i las ring por/ /gang dag mgron po ltar dub pa/ /de yang la yang lta ེ sa dbang gis/ /ji zhig ltar rnyed 'chi med lam/ /gang 'di thar 'dod rnams kyis nan tan du/ /bgyid par 'os pa nyid dang rnam gzhan du/ /dogs pa'i g.yang sar yun ring lhung rnams la/ /dam pa'i nges pa 'di rnams sbyin par bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon ji skad bshad pa yi/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa dag la dbang nod nas/ /brtul zhugs dam pa'ang yang dag blang bar bya/ /mi dge bcu dang ser sna dam chos spong*/ /byang chub sems spong de bzhin gnod sems skyed/ /bcu bzhi 'di rnams rtsa ba'i ltung ba yin/ /rab byung byang chub sems dpas rtsad nas spangs/ /blo ldan khyim na lhag par gnas rnams kyis/ /rtsa ba bzhi dang log ltas ma gos na/ /dgu po thabs la mkhas pas spang ba'ang rung*/ /rab byung nyid dam khyim pa yin na yang*/ /'di dag spangs na 'grub kyi gzhan du min/ /rang gi sems la rang gi ngo bo yis/ khyab brdal mi shigs ngang du mnyam par gzhag /'dir gang sems kyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas te/ /ngo shes tshul 'di gzhi yi yan lag go /rang sems rang gi ngo bor mnyam bzhag nas/

/dag byed chu sogs snang ba ma lus pa/ /sems las gzhan min dri ma rang dag dang*/ /slar yang dag par bsgom pa khrus kyi gnad/ /de ltar gnyis ni theg chen spyi yi tshul/ /rngub cing bsdams dang dbyung ba'i dus nyid na/ / myur 'gro'i ngo bo la ltas dmigs med du/ /mnyam par gzhag nas longs spyod rdzogs skur rig /'di ni kun gyi byed po rlung gi gnad/ /rlung gi rang bzhin lus ngag sems gsum po/ /snying rje gsum du dpal ldan bla mas mkhyen/ /'di ni rlung gi khyad par zhes bya ste/ /mdor na g.yo ba'i sems zhes sangs rgyas gsungs/ /phra rab rdul bral rlung sems phra mo'i sku/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs zhes 'dus par ste/ /gang yang snying rje rnam gsum sems dmigs dang*// dga' ba gsum du pha ma'i rgyud las gsungs/ /'gyur ba'i bde ba mi shigs thig le'am/ /de bzhin rlung gi 'brel ba spang bya ste/ /longs sku 'gyur med bde ba 'bras bur dran/ /gang zhig lus dang ngag sems gdod ma ste/ /'di la srid dang zhi ba bye brag med/ /don dam gdod ma'i gshis la rab brtags nas/ /nā da mchog dang rnam par rig pa yi/

/stong chen de bzhin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gzugs/ /'di dag rnams su ye nas rtogs na ko /de ltar gnad gsum rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /rgyud don zab dang rgya che'i nges gsang ste/ /dag byed la yang phyogs gcig mkhas pas rig /yang na phyi ma rnal 'byor rgyud bzhin shes/ / deng 'dir nges pa gzhan yang gnod byed dang*/ /las dang srung po gdod nas med rtogs pa/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'di ni dam pa'i don/ /'di ni rdo rje theg pa spyi yi lugs/ /pha rol phyin gzhung las kyang nges par byos/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ /dbang bskur sa bcu'i rim pa dang sbyor ba/ /de bzhin dngos gzhi'i ting 'dzin rnam gnyis dang*/ /rnal 'byor bla med ji bzhin 'di la mdzes/ /de ltar gsum las bar pa cha mthun tsam/ /rnam bzhi'i rdo rje byin gyis brlabs pa las/ /ye shes rdo rje 'gyur bral bde ba ste/ /thig ler lta dang rang ngo shes pa'i tshul/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin rnam gnyis/ / zhing gi rnal 'byor dbang po thams cad pa/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid dam pa'i don/ /'chi med rnal 'byor bde ba dam pa ste/ /rang rig rnam med stong pa nyid dbyer med/ /'dir ni mchan khung bsdams pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ /srog rtsol bkag dang lce'u chung sbyor ba dang*/ /rlung gi gnad kyang rnal 'byor ldan pas bya// dus 'khor rdo rje gdan bzhi sogs dang mthun/ /'dir ni mdor bsdus bshad pa ste/ /mang bas 'jigs pa'i blo ldan la'o/ /'thad par bcas pa rnams gzhan du/ /bris dang rgyud sde rnams su ltos/ /de ltar bshad nas bla ma la/ / 'gro 'di 'chi med gnas la dengs/ /bkod ces bdag ni phyag 'tshal zhing*/ / nga ro ring du 'bod par byed/ /gang la bsnyen pas 'jigs pa kun/ skyobs mdzad 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*/ /gang gi lam 'di gsal mdzad pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu sbyin pa la'ang*/ /dge 'dis sa skyong rnams kyang rigs pa'i lam zhugs shing*/

/skye dgu rnams kyang dge bar mos shing rab sbyor la/ /nyer 'tshe kun zhi bde ba'i nyin dang nyin la spyad/ /mi ring bar yang thams cad g.yung drung dpal thob 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di yang shākya'i dge slong kun dga' snying pos sbyar ba ste 'gro la phan pa'i slad du'o// //bkra shis/ rgyas par dga' na rgyas par rgyud sde las/ /'bring du dga' na gzhan du bris la ltos/ /'di ni bsdus pa dga' ba'i don du ste/ /'chi med rdo rje lam bzang mtshon dpe'o/ /'di rnams myur du bri 'dod yod kyang*/ le lo'i ngang du ring mor 'khyam pa las/ slar yang myur du gyis zhes bkas bskul ba na/ sngar gyi 'bri 'phro dman ma yang myur du grub par bgyis pa/ legs bshad phra mor gyur pa te por shin te ma nyid du bas pas/ mkhas pa rnams kyi gzigs na sgra don gyi gnas la nyes pa mang du yod mod/ de lta na yang bla ma mchog las man ngag phra mo rig cing*/ nges pa'i don la cung zad yid phyogs shing go ba rnyed pas/ deng sang gi chen po 'gas dpe sna mang po'i tshig bsdus nas/ rang gi byas zhes bris pa dag : dug £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· du ma £© bsdus pa'i gos lta bu rnams gzhan la med pa'i khyad 'phags su 'dod pa rnams las ni mchog go /gzhan yang 'di sems can la gcig tu phan sems kho nas byas pa'i phyir/ /ci nyes yod dam med kyang bla/ /'dzem pa med par smras pa la/ /ma yis bu la bya ba bzhin/ / mkhas pa rnams kyis bzod mdzad rigs// // shu bha mastu sarba dzā ga taṃ// ༅/ /de nas 'dir gzhan yang man ngag gi nges pa sbyin pa ni/ mchan khung sogs kyi don/ mchan khung sbyor ba/ srog rtsol bkag pa'i sbyor ba/ lce'u chung sbyor ba gsum ste/ 'di'i rim pa ni/ rnal 'byor gnyis kyi dang por gsal btab nas/ rlung lan gsum phyir bsal/ rlung sna g.yas nas rgyu na g.yas dang*/ g.yon nas rgyu na g.yon gyi srin lag gis/ rang rang phyogs kyi sna bug bkag ste/

sna bug gcig shos nas slar yang phyir lan gcig dbyung*/ de nas yang cig shos bkag nas/ sngar bkag pa'i phyogs nas rngubs pas/ zhing rnams cung zad g.yo bar bsam/ de nas lag gnyis dbus 'khyud ltar bsnol te/ sbar ba gnyis kyis mchan khung drag tu bsdams la/ zhing rab 'byams snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems bzungs/ rlung phyir 'bud pa na/ srin lag gi sbyor ba sngar bzhin la/ yid mi dmigs par 'jog /'di ni dus kyi mtshan ma ring ba dag byung na nyi phyed yan chad du brtson pas nan tan byas pa 'chi bslu nges pa ste/ dus gzhan du lan bdun sogs ci rigs pa'o/ / lce'u chung sbyor ba ni 'chi med kyi rnal 'byor la te rlung lan gsum phyir bsal nas/ lte bar rlung kha sbyar/ lce phugs su bzlog pas lce chung dril nas/ cung zad bskyod pa na/ zhing rnams bag tsam g.yo zhing*/ bdud rtsi 'babs pa sogs sgoms/ 'di yang lan bdun la sogs pa bya la/ srog rtsol bkag pa ni rnal 'byor gnyis kar te/ dmigs pa so so la sems bzung*/ sngags kyi sgra tsam dran bzhin pas srog rtsol bkag /rlung phyir 'gro ba sngags ngag tu brjod/ ji tsam nas sngags kyi sgra tsam la yid bzlas su byas nas/ dmigs med du mnyam par bzhag /'di bya spyod dang mthun la/ gong ma gnyis bla med bzhin te/ de la dang po gdan bzhir mchan khung sbyor ba zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo nu ma nyed pa'i sbyor ba zhes gsungs pa dang cha mthun zhing*/ nges pa yang de dag las rig dgos la/ gnyis a dī bud+dha ra bdud rtsi lce sbyor zhes kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yo ga'i yan lag tu gsungs pa dang cha mtshungs shing nges gsang ni de nyid dam/ au ḍha na las dzi hwa yo ga zhes gsungs pa las nges dgos la/ mdor na de rnams su rgyas par rtogs 'tshal la/ 'di ni dpe mkhyud du gyur na/ slob dpon nyid rnam par ltung bar 'gyur ba kho na la bsam nas man ngag gi rim pa tsam mo/

/ 'dir smras pa/ 'pho ba'i bag chags rang bzhin ye shes rlung*/ /dhū tī'i 'tsho ba 'gog par brtson pa gang*/ /bde chen dam pa'i don chen dpa' bo des// phyogs grol khyim du nam yang bcom par gyur/ /yul la shin tu g.yo dang chags pa ste/ /rdo rje ltung dang dbang po'i grong 'joms pa/ /'jug nas ldang ba'o ye shes rdo rje gang*/ /lce'u chung sbyor ldan 'gyur bral sa hā dzāṃ/ /gzhan yang lam 'di'i nges gsang shes 'dod na/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas theg pa kun gyi phul/ / de bzhin dpal ldan 'dus dang dra ba sdom/ /rdo rje slob dpon bsnyen byas mnyam par byos/ /'di zab gnad du bsam nas re shig mi 'bri'o snyam pa las/ gnad rnams ma sbas par bris shig ces bka' byung ba'i dbang las bris pa ste/ de'ang mgron gyi tshul du bris lags shing*/ /slad nas dkyus su btsud kyang mi rung ba med par sems/ 'on kyang cung zad gu h+ya ka to// // zhus so// ka l+yā ṇaṃ/ / ༄༅/ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i chog sgrig legs par bkod pa ngag 'don rab gsal bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs so/ / na mash+tsit+ta badz+ra ya/ lha mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ / yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la sogs pa/ gza' skar dus sbyor bzang ba la/ dben pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gis byugs la/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po bris pa'i lte bar lha mtshan nam/ /tāṃḥyig dkar po bris pa'i steng du khre'u'aṃ mañji'i steng du/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bkod pa'i nang du/ nas/ til/ gro/ sran ma/ 'bras te 'bru lnga/ gser/ dngul/ mu tig /mu men/ byi ru ste rin po che lnga/ tshu dag /dbang lag /sle tres/ kan+ha ka ri/ ut+pa la ste sman lnga dang*/ ga bur/ dzā ti/ gur gum/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ a ka ru ste dri lnga dang*/ til lam/ gser/ lan tshwa/ mar/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi ste snying po lnga/ mdor na sman bzang po ci 'dzom bcug /chu gtsang ma srog chags med pas sum gnyis tsam bkang la/

ras sam dar dkar po sna tshang la sogs pa'i mgul 'chings sprog gsum pa bya/ dpag bsam gyi shing ngam/ 'bras bu can gyi shing rlon pas kha brgyan/ med na ku sha'i myu gu bcug pa'i dbus su/ dung chos dri bzang po'i chus bkang ba bzhag /rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa bkod/ 'di nyid kyi rten bzhugs su gsol/ rten byin brlabs can gzhan yang mang du bca'o// maṇ+ḍal gyi mtha' mchod pas bskor/ rin po che'i snod du dkar gsum las grub pa'i gtor ma zlum po che chung ci rigs pa gang 'byor bshams la/ dpon slob stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ las kyi slob mas sngon 'gro gtor ma bshams pa la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ gsum brjod/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ 'od du zhi ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang khyab pa/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par byed pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhriḥ phyag rgya dang bcas pas lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ de nas sde brgyad spyan drangs bar bsam la/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang*/ /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bum smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la/ /bdag gi pus mo sa la gtsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyis/ /gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /gtor ma'i phyogs 'tshams brgyad du 'khod par gyur/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ de ba/ nā ga yak+ṣa/ gan dhar+bha/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin na ra/ ma ho rā ga /ma nu ṣ+ya/ a ma nu ṣ+ya sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥ bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ/ urga de s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/

gh-ih+ṇa daṃ ba liṃ t+ye swāhā/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ pā t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ dhu pe hūṃ/ oṃ ā lo ke hūṃ/ oṃ ghan+dhe hūṃ/ oṃ n+ye wi t+ye hūṃ/ oṃ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*/ /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*/ /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*/ /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang*/ /rin chen gling na lhag par gnas pa dang*/ /chu bo kun dang chu yi mdo rnams dang*/ /mtsho dang rdzing bu lding ka chu ngogs dang*/ /g.ya' chu sil ma can na gang gnas dang*/ /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang*/ khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang*/ /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang*/ /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang*/ /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang*/ /lam srang gsum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang*/ /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung*/ /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang*/ /seng ge dres dang gcan gzan gnas dag dang*/ /'brog chen 'jigs su rung la gang gnas dang*/ /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang*/ /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas su/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang byug pa dang/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul bas/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang*/ / bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis pa mdzod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ / dam tshig can gyi bdag la bsrungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi gdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/
