/rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzo/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /'byung po mthu bo che dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar phyin par mdzod cig /gang dag nag po'i phyogs gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams/ 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig oṃ sum bha ni sum bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥn ya ho/ bha ga wān bid+ya rā dzā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud ta gad tsha/ bsdus pa na gong gi sngags kyis spyan 'dren/ sngags 'bul/ sngags mchod/ 'byung po gang dag nas/ bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod ces pa'i bar byas la/ oṃ sarba bud ta gad gnyis tsha zhes brjod do/ / mchod rdzas rnams la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ gis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūṃ hūṃ dpag tu med pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i khyad par can bskyed nus pa/ nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pā t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra n+ye we te ye āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/

oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe/ ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud ta k+ṣe ṭa pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta/ nā ta saṃ bha we ta/ badz+ra dharmā hri ta ya/ san+to ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho hoḥ.a khaṃ swāhā/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi/ ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang rgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// cho ga tshar re la lan brgya dang brgyad dam/ lnga bcu'am/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ bdun las nyung bar mi bya/ de nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / lan gsum bya/ rang skad cig gis sgrol ma dkar mor gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ rang sems tāṃḥyig dkar por gyur pa las 'od 'phros/ lus kyi nang dkar mer gang*/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ 'od phyir 'phros pas/ po ta la nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo la sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba la/ bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can gyi gtso mo'i dbu brgyan pa/ mdun gyi nam mkha' spyan drangs/

bsam la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥ.ār+ya tā re bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa la bh+yaḥ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad gcig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dang por me tog phog pa yi// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /ces phyag byas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ na mo gu ru ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ pā t+yeṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ghan+dhe/ n+ye we te ye/ shap+ta rnams kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ / sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab grub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig / ces pa lan gcig bya/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dhohaṃ/ rang bzhin gyi stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa nyid ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du rang gi sems tāṃḥyig dkar po las 'od 'phros/

sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ zhi ba'i ngang tshul can gyi dbu la spyan gsum dang phyag zhabs bzhi'i mthil du yang spyan re re ste/ ye shes kyi spyan bdun dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas mchod sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pal dkar po snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i yu ba mtheb srin gyi thugs kar 'dzin pa/ de yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mtshon pa'i brdar/ rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gsum gyes pa/ dbus kyi me tog kha shag bye ba/ g.yas kyi rtse mo me tog bung ba'i 'bras bu dang*/ g.yon gyi rtse mo me tog kha ma bye ba bum par yod pa/ dar dmar po'i shams thabs dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba/ dbu skra nag po spyi bor bcings shing*/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ gzhon nu'i nyams dang sgeg pa'i rnam pas yid 'phrog cing mdzes par gyur pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol dang*/ 'od zer dkar po spro zhing bsdu ba'i sku can/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ gi steng du zla ba'i gdan la 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs stong brgyad pa/ mu khyud lnga dang ldan pa'i lte bar tāṃḥyig gis mtshan pa/ thugs ka'i hūṃ dang tāṃḥlas 'od 'phros/ po ta la nas rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo la sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me ga sa mu tra s+pha ra na sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ pā t+yeṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ n+ye we te ye/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra shap+ta pū dza me ga sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/

dgug gzhugs bcing mnyes kyi phyag rgya byas la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ dang tāṃḥlas 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pā t+yeṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra n+ye we t+ye āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ zhes dbang lha la mchod nas/ oṃ sarba tā tha ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas/ oṃ badz+rir bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ zhes gsung zhing*/ bum chus dbang bskur bas/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyi dbu brgyan par gyur pa la/ snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ bdag nyid la mchod cing bstod par gyur/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa rī wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā t+yeṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ n+ye we te/ shap+ta rnams 'don pa spos la mchod/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /me tog ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /bdug spos ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /snang gsal ji snyed yod pa rnams/ dri chab ji snyed yod pa rnams/ / zhal zas ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /rol mo ji snyed pa rnams/ / zhes pa re re'i mtshams su bcug pas mchod do/ / lha dang lha min cod pan gyi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo la gtugs te/ /'phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod do/ / lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med par gyur pa'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo'i lte ba'i tāṃḥyig gi g.yas su oṃ/

g.yon du hā/ de'i mthar mdun nas g.yas skor gyi/ ma ma a yu puṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+tiṃ ku ru/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun nas g.yas bskor gyi tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā rnams rtsibs re'i steng du/ yi ge re re yod pa/ mu khyud dang po la mdun nas g.yon skor gyi/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ gnyis pa la g.yas skor gyi/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ gsum pa la g.yas bskor gyi/ ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wā/ he dun te ṣān ta thā ga to h+ya ba dad/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e baṃ bā tī mahā shra ma ṇaḥ bzhi pa la rdo rje ser po'i phreng ba dang*/ lnga pa la 'od zer dmar nag gi phreng bas skor ba/ yig 'bru rnams kha dog dkar po/ yig 'bru de rnams las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ lus kyi nang gang bas/ dus dang dus ma yin pas 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsal/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas/ sgrol ma dkar mo dang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang*/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs snying kar thim pas bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams yon tan thams cad rgyas par gyur/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes yi ge bar pa nyid myur bul sogs kyi skyon dang bral zhing*/ gsal la dag pa/ dmigs pa la sems ma g.yengs pa ci nus kyi cho ga tshar re la brgya stong sogs bzlas nas/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ ma ma a yu puṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+tiṃ ku ru swahā/ zhes pa bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ brgya'i bar du thun re la : 'das [ bzlas] pa'i rjes su/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ lan gsum/ ka kha ga gha nga/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/

ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ zhes lan gsum/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā/ he tun te/ ṣān ta thā ga to h+ya ba dad/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e baṃ wā tī mahā shra ma ṇaḥ lan gsum gyis lhag chad bskang*/ bsdus par 'dod na/ mdun bskyed/ bstod pa/ zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor/ /spyod lam zas kyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ thun mtshams su gtor ma gtong pa rnams gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /bum bskyed kyi mchod pa la dmigs nas bsangs sbyangs byin brlab sngar ltar byed/ bum pa la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas bgegs rnams bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa dkar po/ yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lha'i gos kyi mgul bcings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang lnga : mtshan £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· tshan £© lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du tāṃḥyig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ zhes pa nas/ 'od zer dkar po spro zhing bsdu ba'i sku can/ zhes pa'i bar gyi bdag bskyed bzhin dam tshig pa bskyed/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ gi steng du zla ba'i gdan la 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud lnga dang ldan pa'i lte bar tāṃḥyig gis mtshan pa/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ thugs ka'i hūṃ dang tāṃḥlas 'od 'phros/

po ta la nas rje btsun ma dkar mo la sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā t+yeṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ghan+dhe/ n+ye we te/ shap+ta/ yi bar gyis ye shes pa mchod/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yi rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas bstod par gyis/ / zhes pas ye shes pa la bstod/ a gu sha dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ gyis ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ dang tāṃḥlas 'od 'phros pa/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ pā t+yeṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra n+ye we te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta.āḥhūṃ/ zhes pas dbang gi lha rnams la mchod pa phul bar bsam/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyi ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes badz+rir bha wa ā bhī ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyi dbu brgyan par gyur/ pa ni lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su grub pa yin pas/ de la rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyi mchod cing bstod par bsams nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha tshogs dang*/

/rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ mchod yod gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /me tog ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /bdug spos ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /snang gsal ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /dri chab ji snyed yod pa dang*//zhal zas ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /rol mo ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha tshogs dang*/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ /ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā t+yeṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ghan+dhe/ n+ye we te/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma/ /tut+tā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ zhes sogs nas/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun/ /ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ / bsdu na lha dang lha min cod pan gyis zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ gzungs thag spyi la bkram pa'am slob dpon gyis bzung la/ bdag bskyed kyi thugs ka'i yig 'bru rnams las sngags phreng 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par byung ba/ gzungs thag la khril nas bum bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sku'i cha thams cad nas 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa cho ga tshar re la khri stong ngam brgya las nyung ba mi bzla/ de nas ma ma a yu puṇ+ye dang*/ a li ka li/ ye dharmā rnams kyi grangs gong du bshad pa ltar bzla'o/ / oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pā t+yeṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūṃ/

oṃ badz+ra n+ye we te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta aḥhūṃ/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi rdul snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yi rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas bstod par gyis/ / zhes mchod bstod nas/ gzungs thag bsdud pa dang bstun la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ 'ga' yar bzlas pas lhag chad kha bskang bar bsam nas/ dung chos kyi bum pa blug la/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ bum sgrub 'di ni skabs gzhan du yang byas la/ bum chu 'thung ba dang 'khrus byas nas phan yon dpag tu med do/ /zhes gzhung las byung ngo*/ /mdun bskyed byed pa ni/ mchod pa byin brlab sngar ltar byas la/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ gis mi gtsang ba dang bgegs rnams bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis stong par sbyangs bar bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las/ mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du/ tāṃḥlas ut+pal dkar po tāṃḥgyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo/

zhes sogs nas/ thugs ka'i hūṃ dang tāṃḥlas 'od 'phros/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ji lta ba byas la/ po ta la dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha tshogs dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas skor ba spyan drangs par gyur/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing*/ /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin brlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*/ / mtha' ya sems can tshogs rnams bsgral bya'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*/ /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/ / tshur byon tshur byon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ / shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan gcig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /mchog rnams legs par bstsal du gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.e h+ye hi/ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra tri sh+ya hoḥ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/

/bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ / mchod yon gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba'o/ /oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ga ga na sa ma ye hūṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gi khrus bgyi'o/ / dung chos sam bum pa nas 'thor yab kyi gtor la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ / pad+ma'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa la bsams nas/ zhing 'di'am rgya chen zhing gzhan na/ /lha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ba/ /chu dang thang las skyes pa rnams/ / sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /lha la sogs pa'i dri yi rdzas/ /phyogs rnams kun na gang yod pa/ /sim byed yid 'ong ldan pa 'di/ /sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /phyogs dus kun na bdug spos ni/ /lha rdzas spos kyi shing la sogs/ /dri zhim yid 'ong gang yod pa/ /sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /'jig rten 'di'am phyogs rnams na/ /lha dang mi la sogs pa'i rdzas// yon tan kun ldan gang yod de/ /sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu yi/ /rin chen mar me la sogs pa/ /snang ba'i khyad par gang yod de/ /sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / zhes pas mchod/ nyer spyod so so'i mthar sngags dang phyag rgya byas kyang rung*/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yi rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas bstod par gyis/ / zhes pas mchod nas/ dgugs gzhugs bcing mnyes kyi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ badz+ra a gu sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/

oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ཿ gnyis su med par gyur/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa ro gcig tu 'dres par bsams nas/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ dang tāṃḥlas 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug dang bcas pa pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pā t+yaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra n+ye we te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ / zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+rir bhā wa ā bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyi bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyi/ gur gum gyi char 'bebs/ spos kyi ngad thul/ rol mo'i sgra sgrag bzhin pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu zhabs gyen du 'khyil ba las/ 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyi dbu brgyan par gyur/ 'di'i mtshams su/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i yig 'bru rnams la dmigs nas/ yi ge bcu pa brgya la sogs gang grub dang*/ ma ma ā yu pūṇ+ye nyi shu rtsa gcig / dbyangs dang gsal byed/ rten 'brel snying po rnams lan gsum gsum yid ma yengs par myur bul gyi skyon spangs nas bzla'o/ / dri med gtsang zhing yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /thang skyes chu skyes chu chen me tog bcas/ /dri zhim yid 'ong ldan pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/

dri med gtsang zhing yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /thang skyes chu skyes chu chen me tog bcas/ /dri zhim yid 'ong ldan pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra pā t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i tāṃḥyig las mchod pa'i lha mo de dang de spros nas mdun bskyed la mchod par bsam/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbu la mchod 'bul ma// puṣ+pe dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /thang skyes chu skyes me tog dkon mang bsnams/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i shangs la mchod 'bul ma/ /spos ma dud kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ lhan cig sbyar dang yongs gyur spos khang bsnams/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra dhu pe pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan la mchod 'bul ma/ /dī paṃ dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /nyi zla rin chen snang gsal sna tshogs bsnams/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs la mchod 'bul ma/ /dri ma ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /a dkar tsan dan ga bur dung chos bsnams/ / rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ghan+dhe pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ljags la mchod 'bul ma/ /ro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /ro dang bcud ldan lha rdzas zhal zas bsnams/

/rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra nai we t+ye pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i snyan la mchod 'bul ma/ /sgra ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /pi wang gling bu sil snyan sna tshogs bsnams/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra shap+tapū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ 'dzam bu gling ngam gling gzhan na/ /gzugs mchog tshogs kyis gang ba yang*/ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la/ /zhum pa med par byas te 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra rū pa ka ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ sgra snyan/ dri mchog /ro mchog /reg 'jam tshogs kyi bkang ba yang*/ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la/ /zhum pa med par byas te 'bul/ / zhes pa dang*/ sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ rū pa 'i gnas su/ shap+ta/ ghan+dhe/ ra sa/ par sha /rnams bcug / 'dzam bu gling ngam gling gzhan na/ /'khor lo rin chen bkang ba yang*/ /stong gsum la sogs de bzhin te/ /zhum pa med par byas te 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ nor bu dang*/ ma ṇi/ btsun mo dang*/ : wa ṇi £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· wā sti/ blon po dang*/ mahā ta/ glang po dang*/ hasti/ rta mchog dang*/ tu raṃ ga a shwa/ dmag dpon dang*/ khad+ga/ rnams bcug pas mchod/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal te/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' la/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par gyis/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra maṅga laṃ aṣ+ta ḍa wi pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ bdag dang pha mas gtsor byas sems can thams cad lus ngag yid gsum gus pas rtse gcig tu/

mgrin sdebs te/ 'phags ma'i yon tan dran bzhin bstod par bsams nas/ 'khor ba las sgrol ta re ma/ /tut+tā ra yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ /tu res na ba rnams las sgrol/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa/ /zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas mdzad ma/ /mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog 'dra zhing*/ /zla ba la ni rgyab rten ma/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /ut+pal bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcu drug lo lon lus dang ldan// rdzogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras/ /'dod sbyin kun ni 'chang ba'i yum/ / 'phags ma sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo dkar po 'od zer dkar/ / rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad/ /yongs su bskor ba'i rnam pa can/ /'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing khams thams cad yongs su dag pa la/ /rin chen me tog mang po bcal du bkram/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /yum gyur sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma/ /lha mo khyod la gsol ba ni/ / bdag gi tshe yi bar chad dang*/ /nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las/ /nus ldan khyod kyi bskyab tu gsol /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun/ /ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /'phags ma khyed la dad byed pa/ /de la rtag tu bu bzhin dgongs/ /bdag kyang khyod la gsol 'debs kyi/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung du gsol/ /lha mo sku mdog zla 'dra'i mdog /sgeg cing dul ba'i cha byad can/ /gzugs bzang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /mdzes pa'i dar gyi smad g.yogs can/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan dbus su/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung mdzad/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bag can/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum/ /lha mo khyod la rtag tu 'dud/ khyod la bag tsam bstod pa 'dis/

/bdag cag byang chub bsgrub pa la/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi gyur te/ /mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs par shog / ces pa brgya stong ngam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ bdun la nyung mtha' byas pa cho ga tshar re'i skabs su brjod/ gtor ma dmigs pa gtad de/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhriḥ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rje btsun ma'i ljags 'od kyi sbu gus/ bdud rtsi gtor ma la zug nas gsol bas/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas mnyes par bsams te/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥ bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga de/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ/ ga ga na khaṃ/ gh+rih+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ t+ye swāhā/ zhes gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun gyis 'bul/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pāt+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra n+yai we t+ye āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ zhes sogs/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyi/ / zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ / zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / de nas gtor ma gnyis pa la dmigs nas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇa ād+ye nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ yul bdag /gnas bdagagazhi bdag /gnyug mar gnas pa/ sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ

sarba tat+kha ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ ba liṃ ta swā hā/ gang dag 'di ni gnas pa'i yul bdag /gnas bdag /gzhi bdag /gnyug mar gnas pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ gtor ma rgyas par bsngo ba 'dod na yang*/ 'di'i 'das gtor gyi rjes la rang gang byed kyi bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la sha khrag gis brgyan ba'i gtor ma yang byin brlabs gong du byas la bsngo'o// mdun bskyed la bzlas pa cung zad dang mchod pa rgyas pa/ gtor ma/ 'dod don la gsol ba rnams byas nas/ bdag 'jug kyang blang ngo zhes gsung pa la rten/ cho ga kha tshang ba dang*/ dam tshig sor chud cing dngos grub myur du 'byung bas na bdag 'jug bya ba ni/ mdun bskyed dang bla ma tha mi dad du bsams nas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/ maṇ+ḍal dbul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhu me āḥhūṃ/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūṃ/ phyi'i lcags ri khor yug gis skor ba'i dbus su/ hūṃ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi yi longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa/ lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo tha dad ma mchis pa'i drung du/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin brlab dang*/ rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gu ru i daṃ maṇ+ḍa la khaṃ/ nir+ya ta ya mi/

mdun bskyed dang bla ma tha mi dad par bsams nas/ dbang gi don du phyag 'tshal bar mos te/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad gcig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ / ces lan gsum/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma/ /tut+tā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ /tu res na ba rnams las sgrol/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lan gsum/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen por bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la bstsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la bstsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ / lan gsum brjod/ rgyas par spro na/ rtog pa bsdu ba/ snang ba sbyin pa/ rgyun bshags/ gnas gsum byin brlab/ sdom bzung*/ nang gi sems bskyed/ dam bzhag sogs kyang bya gsung*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces lan gsum brjod/ mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma dang tha mi dad pas/ rang nyid sbyangs nas/ rje btsun mar bskyed par bsam la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo/ zhes pa nas/ lnga pa la 'od zer dmar nag gis bskor ba

zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin mngon rtogs tshang bar gsal btab/ mdun bskyed la dmigs nas rang gi gsol ba btab pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po ches bdag cag dus dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsal nas/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin brlabs dang*/ rjes su gnang ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ zhes gsol ba gdab pas/ bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ nam mkha' la kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du byon/ rang gi snying ga'i 'khor lo dang yig 'bru la thim/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas kyang*/ 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa byon/ rang nyid la thim pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang khyad par rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i byin brlabs zhugs pas/ snying ga'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa'i 'od kyi lus thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ dus dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa/ bar chad thams cad bsal bar gyur/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes pa lan gsum gsum bya/ spos dang rol mo bya zhing gong gi dmigs pa gsal ba gal che'o/ /rdo rje spyi bor bzhag nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bsam mo/ / mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob la dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug dang bcas pa nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rdo rje bsdus pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pā t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/

oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra n+ye we te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchog chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ zhes gsol ba gdab pas/ dbang gi lha de rnams kyi rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi byang sems kyi bkang ba thogs nas/ spyi bor/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ tā re tut+tā te tu re swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i rtsa 'dab thams cad gang*/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lus sku rdo rjer gyur/ dbang dang po bum pa'i dbang thob/ bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ sprul sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ yang dbang gis lha de rnams kyi mgrin par/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ de bzhin bdag gi dbang bskur ro/ / zhes pa'i bar dang*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ghu h+ye a bhi ṣe ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas ngag gi sgrib pa dag /ngag gsung rdo rjer gyur/ dbang gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rtsa rlung thig le sgom pa la dbang*/ longs sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ yang dbang gi lha de rnams kyi snying gar/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ / zhes sogs nas/ de bzhin bdag gi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ tā re dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pradz+nyā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo mer gyis gang*/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag / sems thugs rdo rjer gyur/ dbang gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/

thabs shes snying rje sgom pa la dbang*/ chos sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ yang dbang gi lha de rnams kyi lte bar/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ / zhes sogs nas/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsa tur a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo mer gyis gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /sku gsung thugs mi : ched £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· phyed £© pa rdo rje gsum du gyur/ bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ rig stong dbyer med sgom pa la dbang*/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad kyi lus phyi nang thams cad gang bas 'phrin las bzhi thogs pa med par grub/ 'chi med tshe'i rigs 'dzin thob/ chu zhabs gyen du 'khyil ba las/ 'od dpag med sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyi dbu brgyan par gyur pa la/ dbang gi lha de rnams kyis rang nyid la mchod par bsams nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ nas shap+ta yi bar gyis mchod pa ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ mdun bskyed dang bla ma tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i yi ge bcu pa las sngags phreng mar me gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ zhal nas thon/ rang gi khar zhugs/ snying kha'i yi ge so so la thim par gyur/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ 'di'i rjes zlos la/ dpal ldan bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge dang*/ spyan snga rin po che chos kyi grags pa'i yi ge dang gnyis ka la yang brgya dang brgyad bzla'o gsung ngo*/ /'di nyid kyi gzhung las kyang yi ge bcu pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa'i rjes zlos skabs dang bstun nas bya zhes 'thun pa bzhin du/ brgya dang brgyad bzla'o/ /snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas/

bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma tha mi dad pas me tog spyi bor bzhag pas bsams nas/ dngos su rang gi spyi bora'ajogs pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /rje btsun sgrol ma'i byin brlabs kyis/ /mkha' spyod gnas su drangs su gsol/ / 'phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes pa ni gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ / dbang gi lha de thams cad rang la thim pas/ rang lus lha sku snang la rang bzhin med par gyur/ pa yun ci gnas su bzhag pa ni/ zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po mngon du byas/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /'phrin las bzhi'i rjes gnang yang byas chog gsung yang*/ yig cha khungs ma chod pas 'dir ma bris so/ /dam tshig sdom pa bsgrags pa la sogs pa spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa dang dam tshig thams cad bsrung bar khas blangs par bsams nas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ / lan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra bhu me āḥhūṃ/ nas/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin brlabs dang*/ rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ / bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gu ru i daṃ maṇ+ḍa la kaṃ nir ya ta ya mi/ bdag gi lus kyang 'bul bar bsams nas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran pa/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*/ /cha yi kyang ni spyad du gsol/ / lan gsum/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa byin brlabs sngar ltar byas nas/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang*/ /mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/

/mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po sgrol ma 'khor bcas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du thog mtha' dang 'dra ba la/ mchod yon/ gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ sil snyan/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā t+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ n+ye we te/ shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ/ zhes pas mchod/ glog dang 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ma/ /dpa' mo tā re tut+tā re/ /sangs rgyas zhal gyi pad+mo yi/ /ge sar las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs zhal mnga' ba/ /mchog sbyin phyag rgya ut+pa la/ /bsnams ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i gzeb las tut+tā re/ /swāhās nyon mongs zhi bar mdzad/ /oṃ gyis ngo bo nyid kyi ni/ /tshangs pa'i sgo 'byed khyod la 'dud/ /'jigs pa chen po brgyad las ni/ /'jig rten thams cad skyob par mdzad*/ /kun gyi ma ru gyur pa yi/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang lha min cod pan gyi/ /zhabs kyi pad+ma la btud de/ /'phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstod par 'os pa nas/ mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyis/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can/ / zhes sogs nas/ yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /ca ེsa pa'i bar gyi gsol ba btab/ oṃ badz+ra tā re sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra tā re twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karmā su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaṃḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wan/ badz+ra tā re mā me muñca/ badz+ra tā re bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥ lan gsum byas la/

snying kar thal mo sbyar te/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yi ni/ / nyes pa bgyis dang bgyid bstsal ba/ de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ / lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang*/ /cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang*/ /bdag gis brjed ngas ci bgyis pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ / nub snga ma rnams la/ bdag mdun bum gsum gyi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /ye shes pa 'khor bcas badz+ra muḥ rdul tshon gyi dam tshig pa rnams/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse phyir/ / nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yi ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma ka ma la ya staṃ/dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag / yid bzhin 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ khyod kyi sa la 'khod par shog /nub tha ma yin na/ badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes pa gshegs pa'i rjes su/ mdun bskyed kyi dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ bsngo ba dang smon lam bkra shis sngar ltar bya/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gshegs/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la/ sa phyogs de dag tu shis pa rgyas par bya'o/ / rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gi rgyal po ltar// lhag par lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bdag gis tshe rabs kun tu bsgrubs pa'i lha/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las ma/ /sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi/ /yum gyur ut+pal bsnams pa'i bkra shis shog /che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med/ /chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin brlabs kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog

/chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med/ /dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnams 'phel ba'i/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba/ /rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /tshangs dang lha dbang bsrung ma'i byin brlabs kyis/ /phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur te/ / bde legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /tshe ring nad med bde dang ldan par shog /mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog /yan lag drug cu gsung gi bkra shis shog /mtha' bral don rtogs thugs kyi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ / nyin ma'i gung la bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ / dkon mchog gsum gyi bde legs shog /sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin brlabs dang*/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin brlabs dang*/ /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos bzhin smon lam 'grub par shog

/ 'dod don gsol bas dngos grub grub par bsam nas sbyin bsreg byed na sbyin bsreg la 'jug ste zhi ba'i thab khung mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i g.yas su bsreg rdzas/ g.yon du mchod rdzas/ mdun du rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang gzar blugs gzar kha sbyar la bzhag /kha shar du bltas te sku+il krung ngam/ tsog pur 'dug la lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas me sbar shing gis thab la g.yas su skor zhing*/ tā re tut+tā re tu re 'i sngags lan gsum gyi rjes su dz+wa la raṃ zhes pas me sbar/ yang dz+wa la gsum gyis dgang blugs kyi mar blug yo ga ltar/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas thab dang*/ yo byad bsangs/ oṃ āḥswāhā/ oṃ ṣ+tiṃ swāhā/ oṃ dziṃ swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ yo byad dang thab sbyangs/ swa bhā was/ stong pa'i ngang las/ thab paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las thab khung dkar po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyar khru gang pa/ dpangs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi rol kyi grwa bzhir rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ dbyibs zlum pa/ mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ yang mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas kyang*/ swa bhā was/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med pa sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyi mi khyab par mos la/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+te 'i bar dang*/ oṃ bho dhi bh+rik+ṣa la sogs pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas thab kyi nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ me lha sku mdog dmar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du ba/ ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon gyi spyi blugs 'dzin pa/

gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ ag tshoms 'phyang ba/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ shar lho nas me lha spyan drangs par mos te/ dbyug gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna drung du bcas la/ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ / 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ ag+ne ye mahā te dza sarba karmā pra swa da ka mahā bhu ta de wā ri shi dwi dza/ sa da ma gra ha/ a hū ti/ a ha ra/ asmin san+ni hi to bha wa/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ gi me tog gtor la gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā sa mchod/ pā t+yaṃ gyi zhabs bsil phul nas/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra a na la mahā bhu ta dz+wa la ya bhasmin ku ru sarba duṣ+tan hūṃ phaṭa/ dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ gyis dam la bzhag / oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ la sogs pas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya/ gong ltar dbang bskur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ / tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ /'di ni bdag cag gi bgegs zhi zhing*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes pas ku sha rtse mo g.yas su bstan te thab kyi phyogs brgyad du bskor zhing*/ yak+ṣa bzlas pa'i chu dang rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bsangs/ de nas me lha'i lce hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ pa'i kha dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la raṃ bkod de/ oṃ ag+ne ye swāhā sa lan bdun mar gyis bkang ste/

gzar bu kha sbyar la/ oṃ ag+ne ye di byā di byā bi shud+dhe mahā shrī ha byā ka byā bha ya ha na ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā sa mer blugs pa lan gsum gyis/ me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po kho bos dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /zhi byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ / ces pas bstod/ oṃ ag+ne ye 'ba' zhig gis rdzas thams cad phul nas/ rin po che re re'i mjug tu spel zhing tshig brjod de/ yam shing la gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ mar la 'byor pa/ til la dge ba/ zas mchog la bde ba/ 'bras la bsod nams rgyas pa/ so ba la nor dang 'bru/ nas la shugs/ sran ma la stobs/ gro la nad med pa/ dur ba la tshe/ ku sha la bsrung ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ spel rdzas so so'i sngags kyis 'bul na/ rim pa bzhin/ oṃ bo dhi bh+rik+ṣa ya swāhā/ oṃ ag+ne ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba pa paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ bha de swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ta ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swāhā/ oṃ ma hā be gā ye swāhā/ oṃ ma hā pā la ye swāhā/ oṃ ghasma ri swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ oṃ āḥpra ti he ta ya swā hā sa phul la/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod/ bsang gtor dang zhabs bsil phul la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ gyi me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ de nas thab kyi dbus su bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar dam tshig pa bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku/ /chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang*/ /thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/

/ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ / zhes pa dang*/ sngar gyi sngags la sogs pas spyan drangs/ ye shes pa gzhug /dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa bdag bskyed ltar byas la/ lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs par bsam la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ mar la bsngags te/ oṃ gan+dhe ye swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis bkang la/ oṃ ag+ne ye di bya di bya bi shud+dhe mahā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyi 'gal rkyen mi dang mi ma yin pa'i nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā sa mar blugs la lan gsum bya/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod/ de nas rdzas la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā sa 'bul ba las/ spel tshig me lha'i skabs dang 'dra la/ til sum brgya la sogs pa mang du 'bul/ gzhan brgya dang re re 'bul/ mthar lan bdun 'bul ba gong bzhin dang*/ 'og ltar gtor ma btang*/ 'dod don gsol la bzod pa zhu/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ badz+ra dz+wa la 'i sngags kyi mar dgang blugs gsum thab tu blugs la me lha'i skur bzhengs par bsam la/ gong gi me lha'i skabs ltar lhag ma bsreg rdzas nyi shu rtsa re dang*/ mar byin zan ltar phul lam mchod/ gtor ma oṃ ag+ne 'i mthar/ ā ka ro btags la 'bul/ sngar gyi bstod pa'i rjes su/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog / 'byung po yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa/ / rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong mchog /nyon mongs bsregs pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs/

/rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghun+ṭe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsis yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ zhes pas bstod/ 'dod don bsam/ bsang gtor sngar bzhin 'thor 'thung prok+ṣa naṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā sa phul la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyi sgrubs kyi gshegs/ /ji ltar gnas su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi 'dod pa thams cad bsgrubs/ /oṃ ag+ne ye ya hi zhes pa dang*/ spyan drangs ba'i phyag rgya las/ mdzub mo dang lag pa phyir bskyed de/ me lha gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ lhag chad kha skang ba'i yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ ston mchog dam pa'i bkra shis brjod/ de nas gtor ma bzhi bshams pa'i dang po rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bsangs/ rdo rje me yi phyag rgyas sbyangs/ rdo rje bsdams pa 'debs tshul dang*/ a kā ra ོsa bdud rtsir gyur/ lha'i ljags rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing snying po'i mthar/ bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes brjod pas 'bul/ mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ sogs kyi phrin las gzhol/ de nas gtor ma gnyis phyogs skyong*/ gsum pa 'byung po/ bzhi pa bgegs la cha gsum ltar bsngos la/ mchod bstod/ 'dod don zhu/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ zhes pa la sogs pas bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / la sogs pa'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra muḥ/ rang dang mdun gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ mdun gyi dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ rten yod na gshegs gsol mi dgos brtan bzhugs bya/ smon lam dang bkra shis brjod/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis bsrung*/ rjes bsdu'o/ /de dag gi rang bzhin gyi don du lha mnyes pa'i cho ga sbyin bsreg dang bcas pa bstan zin to/

/'phags ma zhi ba rin chen bzhi grags las/ /phan bde chos can mda' chen 'phangs pa nga*/ / mnyam du blo yi mun tshogs dpung bcoms nas/ /bdag blo thar pa'i grong du 'dren la 'dud/ /rgyal bas chos kyi sgo mo mtha' yas kyis/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i snying po rnams las ni/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo man ngag gdams pa mchog /deng 'dir rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /chos tshul ngo mtshar 'thung ba'i puṇ+yai bi dza yis/ /ngo mtshar chos rigs rkang 'thung rtse mo der/ /gsum brtsen lha mi'i rgyal po rnam 'phrul ba/ /mnga' 'bangs bde ba'i sar 'god 'dzum zhal can/ /lugs gnyis mngon par mtho zhing dbang 'byor bas/ /bdag gi phu bo sa skyong dam pa byung*/ /rnam dkar dad dang lhag bsam 'byor pa'i dpal/ /'di dang phyi mar 'chi med tshe bsgrub phyir/ /rab spel par gyis 'phrul yig 'di bsgrubs so/ /yi ge'i byed po shes rab kun dgas bris/ /sor mo'i zlos gar 'phrul las byung ba'i brkos/ /sgo gsum brtson pas bsgrubs pa'i dpon chen ni/ /bsod nams bstan pa zhes pas legs par bgyis/ /yi ge dag byed bkra shis bzang po dang*/ /bkra shis byang chub gnyis kyis rnam dpyod legs/ /'dir 'bad dge tshogs 'od dkar gang mchis pa/ /pha mas gtso byas 'gro kun ji snyed dang*/ /bdag cag mched lcam ma lus 'khor bcas rnams/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i go 'phang thob par shog /'di ltar bsgrubs las byung ba'i dge ba dang*/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /tshe ring nad med bde ba thob pa dang*/ /chab srid dbang phyug rnams ni gong du 'phel/ /rang 'byung pad+ma'i chos tshul rab rgyas nas/ /'phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' ru khyab nas kyang*/ /'gro kun sems can mtha' yas thams cad kyis/ /skyabs dang skyob pa'i bla mar bdag gyur cig/// shu bhaṃ stu sarba dza ga taṃ/ bkra shis so/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/
sgrub thabs sna tshogs kyi skor bzhugs/ -PAGE 2--PAGE 11--PAGE 1-
